196207ba.title: Applied AI Architect, Partnerships
196207ba.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Partners Solutions Architect on the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on cultivating technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs), and our cloud partners . You will strengthen our relationships with key partners to accelerate indirect revenue, enable their AI practices, and execute on long-term GTM strategy.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* **Strategic Technical Partnership**: Be a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team, providing technical expertise to better understand the partner landscape, driving key strategic programs, and identifying opportunities to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
* **Joint Solution Development:** Collaborate with partners to identify high value industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures / best practices to accelerate time to deployment
* **Customer Deal Support:** Intervene directly to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance.
* **Partner Ecosystem & Events**: Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities.
* **Product Feedback:** Validate and gather feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns, and deliver this feedback to relevant Anthropic teams to inform product roadmap and partner strategy.

**You may be a good fit if you have:**
--------------------------------------

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing/partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer
* Track record of successfully partnering with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong presentation & technical communication skills with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

**How we're different**
-----------------------

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

**Come work with us!**
----------------------

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

a9bd16d0.title: Solution Architect – Python with GenAI
a9bd16d0.description:
Our growing organization needs a Solution Architect with expertise in Python and Generative AI to engineer and roll out enterprise-level GenAI solutions capable of operating reliably in production. Within our Solution Architecture team, you'll steer technical exploration projects, develop reusable building blocks, and contribute to shaping standards for LLM-powered applications. Submit your application now to join forward-looking GenAI initiatives and help clients realize meaningful, transformative outcomes.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Develop end-to-end GenAI architecture solutions, covering RAG approaches, Agents, and Multi-Agent designs, tailored to large enterprise needs
* Build reusable accelerator assets and reference solutions to create consistency across delivery
* Head up technical discovery meetings and give practical, on-the-ground support to engineering teams
* Establish evaluation frameworks and outline standards guiding the creation of LLM-based applications
* Work with multiple teams to confirm that architectural approaches remain scalable and manageable over the long haul
* Engineer microservices systems by drawing on recognized patterns and modern technology frameworks
* Oversee integration efforts tied to cloud infrastructure across platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Handle container deployment and orchestration responsibilities via Docker and Kubernetes
* Assess and determine fitting vector database technologies, like Pinecone, Weaviate, or Chroma, to power GenAI solutions
* Roll out LLMOps techniques and monitoring systems to elevate the quality of production releases
* Aid in prompt engineering work and RAG evaluation to strengthen application dependability
* Take part in mentoring programs and share insights across the architecture community
* Maintain rigorous coding practices for Python applications intended for production use
* Guide ongoing efforts to enhance system architecture design and solution scalability

**Requirements**

* Experience spanning 9 to 14 years in software development, with strong expertise in solution architecture and system design
* Advanced Python capabilities focused on writing code fit for production environments
* Skill set covering microservices architecture, design patterns, FastAPI, Redis, Elasticsearch, and Kafka
* Deep hands-on experience creating GenAI applications, including Agents, MCP, RAG, Agentic RAG, and GraphRAG
* Strong knowledge of LangGraph, LangChain, and other orchestration technologies
* Practical background evaluating LLMs and RAG frameworks, along with handling prompt management tasks
* Proven capability delivering GenAI applications that scale effectively in production
* Direct experience with cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Familiarity with containerization approaches, particularly Docker and Kubernetes
* Understanding of vector database platforms, such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or Chroma
* Solid comprehension of LLMOps principles and the monitoring tools tied to them
* Strong leadership abilities appropriate for directing engineering teams
* Capability to work in client-facing scenarios while collaborating effectively with teams
* Solid English language skills, both spoken and written, at a B2 level or higher

**Nice to have**

* Experience with conventional machine learning techniques, including feature engineering, model training, and evaluation
* Familiarity with knowledge graph principles and fine-tuning strategies
* Previous exposure to consulting work or roles centered on direct client interaction

00f8530a.title: Lead/Senior Software Engineering - AI Solution Engineering
00f8530a.description:
We are seeking a **Lead/Senior Software Engineer** specializing in AI Solution Engineering to design, build, and deploy full-stack LLM-powered AI applications while driving best practices in cloud architecture, coding standards, and responsible AI delivery across enterprise systems.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Build full-stack LLM-powered AI applications using Azure (prompt engineering, grounding, RAG) or vector databases
* Develop APIs/microservices with Python, .NET, or Node and integrate them with UIs and enterprise systems
* Drive agentic AI development using Azure AI Foundry and Copilot Studio
* Implement CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps and manage cloud deployments across AKS, App Service, and Functions
* Build data and feature pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Synapse, or Databricks and manage embeddings and prompt versioning
* Deploy models into production and maintain them over time
* Adhere to coding standards and AI principles by conducting regular health checks, audits, and code reviews to ensure clean, maintainable, production-level code across project teams

**Requirements**

* 6-14 years of overall IT experience
* Strong coding skills in Python, C#, and REST/GraphQL APIs, along with experience in testing and code reviews
* Hands-on expertise in the Azure AI stack, including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure Cognitive Services
* Familiarity with Azure AI Search, NLP, and Azure ML, along with vector databases such as AI Search vector index, Cosmos DB, or PostgreSQL
* Experience in agentic development using the Azure AI stack
* Proficiency in CI/CD with GitHub, branching strategies, and coding standards such as linters, formatters, and PEP8, along with GitHub Actions pipelines
* Skills in containerization with Docker and deployment to AKS, App Service, or Functions
* Knowledge of secrets management via Key Vault and Managed Identity, along with RBAC and network security basics
* Understanding of Responsible AI, privacy, and data security in enterprise settings

**Nice to have**

* Experience with GitHub Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Studio (Power Platform)
* Familiarity with PromptFlow, MLflow, Databricks, and Streamlit or React
* Background in MLOps and/or LLMOps practices
* Azure certifications (AI-102, AZ-204)
* Experience working with one of the big cloud environments (e.g. Azure)
* Knowledge of RAG patterns, prompt design, tool/function calling, embeddings, retrieval, and caching
* Preferred experience working with Asset projects

**About The Role And Team**
Leading in a high-growth environment means setting direction in motion, not waiting for perfect conditions. As a Program Manager, Tech, you will support and drive the operational frameworks that maintain and scale our core business initiatives. This is a role for an organized, detail-oriented operator who can translate high-level goals into actionable project plans.
  
  
You will work in a fast-paced environment where you will need to organize information effectively and stay resilient through the challenges of scaling complex systems. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve problems and ensure programs remain on track. If you are a clear communicator, thrive on process optimization, and are motivated to build frameworks that impact the real world-this is where you will make your mark.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the execution of specific program workstreams, from defining requirements with stakeholders to ensuring successful delivery and rollout.
* Maintain detailed program plans, ensuring that milestones are met and that all operational documentation is kept up to date.
* Identify and track cross-functional dependencies, proactively flagging potential risks to program timelines.
* Help design and implement program workflows that improve the efficiency of team operations and organizational reliability.
* Champion established standards and program management best practices within your assigned workstreams.
* Use data to monitor program health, track key performance indicators (KPIs), and provide regular status updates to stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to streamline manual tasks and improve team workflows using modern program management tooling.

****Basic Qualifications****

* 2+ years of professional experience in program management, project management, or a related operational role.
* Proven ability to organize tasks, manage schedules, and drive cross-functional projects to completion.
* Foundational understanding of the program lifecycle and the ability to organize complex requirements into structured plans.
* Experience using program management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, or equivalent) to track progress and report metrics.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to provide clear updates to project stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Experience working in a high-growth or fast-paced corporate environment.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity and maintain organization across multiple workstreams.
* Proficiency in driving efficiencies through process definition, documentation, and runbooks.
* A proactive mindset: Eager to learn, detail-oriented, and ready to tackle hands-on operational challenges.

**Ready to Ride?**
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.
  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. **Start your journey with BCD: Grow, connect, collaborate and celebrate with our global team**
**Senior Security Compliance Program Manager Remote**
*Full time, Remote India, Costa Rica, Colombia, Mexico*
As a member of the Information Security team, you will lead the Security Compliance team and collaborate with stakeholders across Technology, Cybersecurity, HR, Internal Audit, External Audit, Legal/Privacy, and Business Operations. This role is responsible for leading and maturing the organization's global Information Security Compliance Program which includes multiple compliance projects, ensuring the successful delivery of compliance initiatives, certification renewals, audit readiness activities, compliance reporting, and continuous improvement efforts across multiple business units, geographic regions, and regulatory environments.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring strong cybersecurity compliance and program management expertise, along with a passion for developing high-performing teams. This individual will own a portfolio of global compliance programs, drive strategic initiatives from planning through execution, manage budget and resource priorities, and influence cross-functional stakeholders to achieve successful business and compliance outcomes. The role will also help advance operational efficiency through the adoption of automation, emerging technologies, and AI-enabled capabilities while partnering with technology and AI leaders to support responsible innovation.

* BA/BS in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, or similar field (or BA/BS in Business with a minor in Computer Science, Information Systems, or similar field), or equivalent work experience

* Demonstrated experience managing portfolios of strategic initiatives, including roadmap development, program governance, executive stakeholder engagement, and delivery of complex enterprise-wide programs
* Proven success leading complex multi-project programs, including resource planning, budget management, dependency management, risk management, and executive reporting

* Strong familiarity with enterprise Data, Analytics, and AI technologies, platforms, and transformation programs, and how they create business value.
* Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior client stakeholders across business and technology functions.
* Strong commercial sense, including experience supporting deal shaping, value positioning, pursuit strategy, and complex client opportunities.
* Proven ability to translate market signals and customer needs into solution opportunities, go-to-market priorities, and growth actions.
* Strong executive communication and storytelling skills, especially in client-facing and leadership-facing settings.

3f40c524.title: CTC Functional Solution Architect
3f40c524.description:
**Job Description**
**Purpose of the Role:**
**The Solution Architect — Functional, Credit to Cash is the functional design authority for the end-to-end Credit to Cash value chain.**
The outcome is a Credit to Cash process that is predictable, automated and controlled: faster and better credit decisions, higher straight-through cash application, risk-based and largely automated collections, fewer exceptions and disputes, lower DSO and overdue, and <1 Day Resolution wherever the process allows. Everything this role does serves that outcome.
  
  
The scope is the Credit to Cash value chain end to end, not a single module or platform — customer onboarding and credit risk assessment, credit limits, scoring, reviews and order hold or release; billing and invoice presentment as they feed receivables; customer statements and self-service portals; collections strategy, worklists and dunning; payment capture, bank statement and lockbox processing, remittance capture and cash application; unapplied and on-account cash; deductions, short-pays, claims and disputes; AR accounting, reconciliation, write-offs and bad-debt provisioning; and the period-end close, controls, reporting and KPIs that sit on top. The role designs across this scope as one integrated solution rather than as separate credit, collections and cash solutions.
  
  
A central part of the remit is bringing HighRadius into Diageo. The postholder leads the functional architecture and design for the HighRadius Cash Application, Collections and Credit Management modules — and the adjacent capabilities that touch them, such as deductions and integrates them with S/4HANA / ECC FI-AR and FSCM, banks, ClaimOne (under Control Tower) and the wider Customer Operations landscape. HighRadius is an enabler of the target design, not the design itself; the role decides what the process should be first, and then how the platform best delivers it.
  
  
The role combines four capabilities in one person. As a functional solution architect, they own the end-to-end Credit to Cash solution blueprint, the fit-gap against the global standard and the design decisions that hold it together. As a platform expert, they turn the blueprint into working configuration and integration design on HighRadius and SAP FSCM — matching rules, AI models, collection strategies, credit scoring and workflows. As a consultant, they diagnose where cash, credit and collection issues are really created and build the case for the fix. As a design authority, they set standards, review and assure the work of Specialists, system integrators and vendors, and keep the solution coherent as it scales across markets.
  
  
**The defining discipline of this role is architecting the value chain, not the module.**
A well-configured cash application engine is a smaller prize than a remittance that arrives clean; a sophisticated collections strategy is a smaller prize than a credit decision and invoice that never become overdue. The postholder is expected to design the hand-offs — order and credit, invoice and remittance, payment and dispute, AR and the ledger — as carefully as the modules themselves, and to push the fix upstream into O2I, Commercial, master data or the customer setup where that is where the problem starts.
  
  
**Understanding of markets and of upstream and downstream impact is central to the role.**
Credit to Cash outcomes are shaped by pricing, promotions, customer agreements, invoicing, banking practice, local regulation and the retained, GBO and BPO operating model. The postholder is expected to know how these differ across LAC, NAM, Europe, Africa and APAC, to define what must be global standard and what genuinely requires localisation, and to design accordingly.
  
  
**This is a transformation design and architecture role, not an operational one.**
The postholder does not run credit, collections or cash application; that stays with market, GBO and BPO run teams. The role changes how that work is done and ensures the solution handed to run is controlled, measurable and sustainable.
  
  
The role works independently within the frame set by the workstream lead, forms its own view and brings recommendations and design decisions rather than questions. It partners closely with D&T Enterprise and Solution Architecture, which own the technical architecture, and provides functional design direction to Specialists working on Credit to Cash fragments. Decisions are expected to be based on evidence rather than opinion, and every artefact is expected to meet the programme documentation, taxonomy and quality standards, including BPQMS.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities (3-5)**
**Own the end-to-end Credit to Cash functional architecture and target design — 25%.**
Define and maintain the Credit to Cash target process and solution architecture across credit, billing hand-off, collections, cash application, deductions and disputes, AR and close, aligned to the global standard and the target operating model. Lead current-state assessment and fit-gap across markets, platforms and controls, using exception, aging, matching, collection-effectiveness and dispute data to baseline the problem and size the opportunity. Own the solution blueprint, key design decisions and design principles; define what is global standard versus market localisation; and make sure the Credit to Cash design is joined up with O2I, Claims, Commercial and Customer Service.
  
  
**Lead the HighRadius functional solution design and deployment — 25%.**
Act as functional lead for bringing HighRadius into Diageo across Cash Application, Collections and Credit Management. Design remittance capture and cash-application rules toward straight-through posting — bank, lockbox, EDI 820, email and portal remittances, matching logic, auto-match and AI-led recommendations, unapplied-cash and exception handling. Design risk-based collection strategies, segmentation, prioritised worklists, automated dunning and correspondence, promise-to-pay and dispute routing. Design credit applications, scoring models, credit-limit setting and review cycles, blocked-order release and credit workflows. Lead fit-gap, configuration design, functional specifications and sign-off with HighRadius, system integrators and D&T, and shape the multi-market deployment approach and template.
  
  
**Design integration, data and controls across the Credit to Cash landscape — 20%.**
Own the functional design of data flows and integration between HighRadius, SAP S/4HANA / ECC FSCM, banks and payment providers, ClaimOne, customer portals and the reporting layer — customer master, open items, payments, postings, disputes, credit exposure and limits. Define master-data and reference-data requirements, reason-code frameworks and posting logic. Embed financial controls, segregation of duties, audit trail and SOX / internal-control requirements in the design, and define the KPIs and reporting — DSO, CEI, overdue, auto-match rate, unapplied cash, credit-decision cycle time, exception and resolution time — that let the business manage the process in BAU.
  
  
**Deliver the outcome and assure design quality through the value drops — 20%.**
Break the architecture into fragments that can be delivered on the two to four week value drop cadence, and act as design authority on each: review requirements, specifications, configuration and test coverage produced by Specialists, integrators and vendors. Define end-to-end test scenarios, lead integrated SIT and UAT across the value chain, and own resolution of design-level defects. Support cutover, data migration, deployment, hypercare and handover into run. Monitor post-go-live performance against the baseline and drive continuous improvement in automation rates, exception volume and resolution time. This is the accountability every other accountability serves.
  
  
**Shape the roadmap and lead across the programme — 10%.**
Own the Credit to Cash functional roadmap: sequencing of modules and markets, adoption of new HighRadius and SAP capability, AI and automation opportunities, and retirement of legacy tools and manual workarounds. Act as trusted adviser to the workstream lead, market Finance, Credit and Collections leaders, GBO, D&T and vendors. Coach and guide Specialists on Credit to Cash design, and surface cross-boundary impact with Order-to-Invoice, Claims, Customer Service and Record-to-Report before it becomes a deployment defect.
  
  
**Key Competencies (3)**

* End-to-end Credit to Cash mastery and functional architecture. Expert, end-to-end knowledge of the Credit to Cash value chain — credit risk and credit management, collections and dunning, payments and cash application, deductions, claims and disputes, AR accounting, reconciliation and close — and of how each step drives the next. Able to design an integrated target process and solution architecture, run a fit-gap, make and document design decisions, and balance global standard against local need. Built on a broad understanding of Customer Operations end to end (Order to Cash, Commercial and Supply) and of how markets actually work. Knows Consumer Products industry standards and the realities of Beer, Wine & Spirits — distributor and wholesaler concentration, complex customer agreements, deduction-laden remittances, multi-currency receipts and diverse banking practice. Working knowledge of Diageo BPQMS standards.
* HighRadius and SAP platform depth, integration and data. Hands-on functional depth in HighRadius Cash Application, Collections and Credit Management — configuration, matching and AI models, strategies, worklists, workflows and scoring — and in SAP FI-AR and FSCM (Credit, Collections and Dispute Management), including how the two integrate. Understands the data model, interfaces, bank formats, posting logic and controls beneath the process, and can work credibly with technical architects and integrators on integration patterns. Comfortable interrogating data directly to baseline problems and prove outcomes. Strong on solution design documentation, end-to-end testing, cutover and hypercare. Keeps up with the C2C technology market and can judge objectively where a platform fits and where it does not.
* Design authority, influence and leadership. Holds the design line with confidence and evidence — challenges solutions that would not work in the markets and is not satisfied with automating a workaround when the issue could be designed out. Strong stakeholder management and influencing across a global and local matrix, up to senior Finance and Customer Operations leaders, and with vendors and system integrators. Consultative by default: frames the problem before prescribing and drives stakeholders toward aligned decisions. Clear communicator able to explain complex design simply, manage conflict to a resolution and guide less experienced colleagues. Comfortable with ambiguity and with being redeployed across markets and workstreams. Resilient, collaborative and a visible role model for Diageo’s values.

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications and Experience Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Finance, Accounting, Business, IT or a related discipline; a professional accounting or MBA qualification is an advantage.
* HighRadius certification (Cash Application, Collections or Credit) and / or SAP S/4HANA FI-AR or FSCM certification is preferred. Solution-architecture, Agile / Scrum or Lean Six Sigma credentials are an advantage. Working knowledge of Diageo BPQMS standards.

**Experience — Essential**

* Overall. 12+ years in Credit to Cash / Order to Cash transformation, solution design and consultancy, including at least 5 years in a functional solution architect, solution lead or design authority role on large-scale, multi-market programmes.
* HighRadius. Functional lead or architect on at least two full-lifecycle HighRadius implementations covering Cash Application, Collections and / or Credit Management — from fit-gap and design through configuration, testing, deployment and stabilisation — ideally integrated with SAP.
* End-to-end Credit to Cash. Deep functional understanding of the whole value chain — credit, collections, cash application, deductions and disputes, AR and close — and evidence of designing across it as one solution, not only within a single module. Operational exposure is useful context; the requirement is designing the process, not running it.
* SAP and integration. Strong functional knowledge of SAP FI-AR and FSCM (Credit, Collections, Dispute Management) in S/4HANA or ECC, and experience defining functional integration with banks, lockbox / bank statement formats, EDI and third-party C2C platforms.
* Transformation. Experience in business process transformation across the full lifecycle, including current-state assessment, future-state operating model design, global template definition and multi-market rollout. Evidence of improving auto-match rates, DSO, overdue, exception volume or manual effort against a defensible baseline.
* Consultative and leadership. A track record as a trusted adviser to senior Finance and Operations stakeholders, leading design decisions across global and local teams, directing system integrators and vendors, and guiding analysts and specialists.
* Industry. FMCG or Consumer Products experience is essential. Beer, Wine & Spirits experience is strongly preferred.

**Experience — Desirable**

* Exposure to the wider HighRadius suite (Deductions, EIPP / invoice presentment, Cash Forecasting, Treasury) or to comparable C2C platforms
* Experience applying AI and machine learning in Credit to Cash — remittance capture, matching, collection prioritisation, payment prediction or credit scoring — and designing the controls around it.
* Experience designing for a retained / GBO / BPO operating model, or of a shared services transition or operating model consolidation.
* Experience with credit insurance, credit bureau and rating-agency integrations, e-invoicing and statutory requirements across multiple regions.
* Experience working in a pooled, on-demand or competency-based delivery model across multiple workstreams.

**About Us**
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.
  
  
Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.
  
  
Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
**About The Function**
**About the role:**
**Experience / Skills Required**
**Working with us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:
  
  
Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.
  
  
We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.
  
  
Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

d52ecf07.title: Technical Architect
d52ecf07.description:
**Technical Architect - ServiceNow (CSM, Integration & AI)**

**Department:**
ServiceNow Practice - Solution Architecture

**Location:**
Bangalore & Gurgaon

**Preferably looking for immediate joiners**

**Experience Required:**
12 - 15+ years (minimum 5 years in a ServiceNow architecture role)

**Role Summary**

The Technical Architect owns the end-to-end solution architecture across CSM, Integration, and AI capabilities for the engagement, ensuring design consistency, scalability, and alignment with the client's broader technology landscape. This role sets technical direction for multiple workstreams, governs architectural decisions, and acts as the senior-most technical point of contact for the client.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and own the overall solution architecture spanning CSM, Integration, and AI, ensuring coherence across workstreams and modules (CSM, FSM, ITSM, ITAM).
* Set integration architecture standards: patterns, middleware choices, data flow governance, and security posture across all system touchpoints.
* Define the AI/intelligent automation roadmap: which use cases justify Virtual Agent, Predictive Intelligence, Now Assist, or custom GenAI integration, and in what sequence.
* Lead architecture review boards and design walkthroughs with client technical leadership and enterprise architecture teams.
* Own non-functional requirements: performance, scalability, data retention, security, and compliance (including audit considerations for regulated engagements).
* Provide technical oversight and mentoring to Technology Leads across workstreams; resolve cross-workstream design conflicts.

3606cb80.title: Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead

**Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead**

**Employment Type: Full-Time**

**Experience: 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML, LLM application development, Generative AI, platform architecture, solution architecture, or technical product development.**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced
**Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead**
to drive the development and evolution of the Fluid AIQ Platform and lead AI-powered application development for upcoming client projects.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building production-ready applications using LLMs, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, and modern AI frameworks.

This role goes beyond traditional chatbot development, focusing on building intelligent agentic applications capable of reasoning, planning, interacting with enterprise systems, using tools, and operating within defined guardrails.

The position combines AI architecture, hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and product commercialization. You will help transform platform capabilities into modular commercial offerings that can be deployed independently and expanded based on client requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Development

* Design scalable architectures for agentic AI applications, including single-agent and multi-agent systems.
* Define agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, state management, and workflow patterns.
* Establish reusable reference architectures, implementation guides, client onboarding playbooks, and engineering standards.
* Evaluate AI technologies, models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on business and technical requirements.
* Contribute to the evolution and architecture of the Fluid AIQ Platform.

2. AI Application Development

* Build production-ready applications using AI agents, LLMs, RAG, and workflow automation.
* Implement tool/function calling, planning and reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop processes.
* Develop integrations with enterprise APIs, business applications, and external systems.
* Implement MCP Server/Client integrations and autonomous or semi-autonomous workflows.
* Build AI-powered decision-support solutions and reusable platform components.

3. LLM & Generative AI Engineering

* Work with LLM providers and models, including OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, and open-source or local models.
* Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, function calling, and model fallback strategies.
* Evaluate and benchmark models based on cost, performance, latency, privacy, and business use cases.
* Ensure flexibility in model and framework selection without unnecessary platform dependency on a single provider.

4. Product Leadership & Commercialization

* Take technical and product ownership of Fluid platform components and client AI programs.
* Help package platform capabilities into independent, commercially viable modules.
* Support the commercialization of reusable platform capabilities and technical IP.
* Develop sales-enablement materials and implementation guidance.
* Track and report platform health, adoption, and delivery metrics to leadership.

5. AI Safety, Reliability & Governance

* Implement guardrails and validation mechanisms to reduce hallucinations, incorrect tool usage, unauthorized actions, and unsafe outputs.
* Design human-approval workflows where required.
* Build reliable agent workflows with error handling, retries, fallback mechanisms, and observability.
* Support release management, environment management, service-level objectives, and production support models.
* Address security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI requirements.

6. Technical Leadership & Collaboration

* Lead and mentor architects and engineers working on agentic AI solutions.
* Collaborate with architecture, development, and cross-functional teams.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and build proof of concepts (POCs).
* Ensure solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and delivery timelines.

Mandatory Technical Skills

**Agentic AI & Generative AI**

* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and agentic AI architectures.
* Hands-on experience with RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, context management, and AI evaluation.
* Experience with agent orchestration, tool/function calling, multi-agent systems, agent memory and state, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Understanding of agent guardrails, reliability, and observability.

**Programming & Application Development**

* Strong programming skills in at least one of the following: Python or Node.js/TypeScript.
* Experience with REST APIs, microservices, authentication and authorization, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and database integration.

**AI Frameworks & SDKs**

* Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, Claude Agents SDK, or equivalent agent SDKs.
* Ability to evaluate and select frameworks based on solution requirements rather than relying on a single technology.

**LLM Integration**

* Experience integrating multiple LLM providers, preferably OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Ollama/open-source LLMs.

**Data Engineering & RAG**

* Experience with PostgreSQL, vector databases, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of embedding models, document processing, semantic search, and hybrid search.
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs and ontology design, including Neo4j, RDF/OWL, or GraphRAG.
* Understanding of multi-tenant data architecture.

**Cloud Platforms**

* Strong experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

Good-to-Have Skills

* Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
* Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other AI coding tools.
* Ollama and open-source LLMs.
* Multimodal AI, Voice AI, and AI workflow automation.
* AI observability, evaluation platforms, and model evaluation.
* Fine-tuning, AI security, prompt-injection protection, and PII/data protection.
* Enterprise SaaS, CRM, and ERP integrations.
* AI FinOps and FinOps Foundation practices.
* Cloud marketplace listings, including Azure Marketplace and AWS Marketplace.
* Product management experience and experience commercializing consulting IP as licensed software.
* Experience replacing or complementing traditional RPA solutions with AI-agent-based approaches.

What We're Looking For

* A hands-on technical leader who can translate business requirements into scalable agentic AI solutions.
* Someone who can combine architecture, engineering, platform development, and product thinking.
* A professional capable of taking AI capabilities from proof of concept to production-ready and commercially deployable solutions.
* Strong communication, technical decision-making, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills.

**Interested in building production-grade Agentic AI platforms and bringing AI-powered products to market? Apply now!**

e02c2cff.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
e02c2cff.description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.

**Role overview**
:

We are hiring an SAP Pre-Sales Consultant / Solution Architect to win and shape SAP deals across AMS, upgrades and migrations, and to build Zensar's in-house SAP IP. The role sits in the SAP Practice Pre-Sales & COE team and works closely with SAP as our alliance partner.

**Purpose of the role:**

Convert SAP opportunities into winning, well-priced solutions; represent Zensar credibly to customers and SAP; and turn repeatable delivery know-how into reusable IP, accelerators and offerings.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. SAP alliance partnership

* Act as the practice's day-to-day point of contact with SAP partner, account and industry teams.
* Run joint go-to-market activity: co-selling, joint account plans, partner-led and SAP-led opportunity registration.
* Track and use SAP partner programmes (PartnerEdge, RISE with SAP, GROW with SAP, SAP BTP) and associated funding and incentives.
* Keep Zensar's partner credentials current: certified consultants, solution validations, and listings on SAP Store / Partner Finder.
* Bring SAP solution experts into customer pursuits when needed, and position Zensar for SAP-referred deals.

2. Solutioning and proposals – AMS, upgrade, migration

* **SAP AMS:**
  design support models (L1–L3), service catalogues, SLA/KPI frameworks, staffing pyramids, onshore–offshore mix and continuous-improvement levers.
* **Upgrades:**
  scope ECC EHP and S/4HANA version upgrades, including readiness checks, custom code remediation, testing and cutover approach.
* **Migrations:**
  shape ECC-to-S/4HANA conversions (brownfield, greenfield, selective/bluefield), RISE with SAP moves and cloud migrations to hyperscalers.
* Lead end-to-end response to RFIs, RFPs and proactive proposals: solution, effort estimate, resource plan, timeline, assumptions, risks and commercials.
* Work with Finance and Delivery on pricing models (T&M, fixed price, managed service, outcome-based) and margin targets.
* Maintain a reusable library of proposal content, case studies, estimation models and win themes.

3. Customer walkthroughs and orals

* Present solutions, demos and proposals to customer CXOs, IT heads and business users.
* Run discovery workshops, assessments and proof-of-concepts to sharpen scope.
* Lead orals, defence sessions and due-diligence calls through to contract.
* Ensure a clean handover of the won deal to Delivery, with scope, assumptions and risks documented.

4. IP and in-house solution building

* Identify repeatable patterns from AMS, upgrade and migration deals and turn them into IP.
* Build accelerators: migration and upgrade assessment tools, custom code analysers, test automation packs, AMS monitoring dashboards, and industry templates.
* Co-develop solutions on SAP BTP (extensions, integration, analytics, AI) with the COE team.
* Package IP into marketable offerings with collateral, demo environments and pricing.
* Explore listing suitable assets as SAP-validated solutions or on SAP Store with the alliance team.

5. Practice contribution

* Support account mining and pipeline growth with Sales and Account teams.
* Contribute to thought leadership: blogs, webinars, events and SAP partner forums.
* Mentor junior consultants and the intern pool on solutioning and presentation skills.

**Required skills and experience:**

* 10–15 years in SAP, with at least 4 years in pre-sales, solution architecture or bid management at an SAP partner or SI.
* Hands-on background in at least one SAP functional or technical area (FI/CO, SD/MM, PP/QM, Basis, ABAP, BTP).
* Proven track record of winning SAP AMS, upgrade and S/4HANA migration deals, including deals above USD 1 million TCV.
* Strong grasp of S/4HANA conversion approaches, RISE with SAP, SAP Activate methodology and SAP's cloud roadmap.
* Experience building effort estimates, resource pyramids and commercial models for managed services and projects.
* Working experience with SAP as an alliance partner: co-selling, deal registration and partner programmes.
* Excellent proposal writing and storytelling; confident presenting to CXO-level audiences.
* Ability to manage several pursuits at once under tight bid deadlines.

**Preferred qualification:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Computer Science; MBA preferred.
* SAP certifications such as S/4HANA (functional), SAP BTP, or SAP Activate Project Manager.
* RISE with SAP or SAP Cloud ALM exposure; hyperscale awareness (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Experience creating IP, accelerators or productized offerings and taking them to market.
* Industry depth in one or more of: manufacturing, retail, insurance, hi-tech, utilities.
* Experience with global customers across the US, UK, Europe or South Africa.

1765a0ad.title: Tech Architect
1765a0ad.description:
**Position Details**

* Department: Engineering / Technology
* Reports to: VP of Engineering / CTO
* Location: Hyderabad, India
* Work arrangement: In-office only
* Employment type: Full-time

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on Tech Architect to define and drive the technical direction of our SaaS platform. You will architect and build scalable backend web services; design analytics pipelines for drone-captured images and videos; enable enterprise-grade single sign-on (SSO) and a secure, extensible integration layer; and turn proofs of concept (POCs) and prototypes into reliable, production-ready systems. You will also champion AI/LLM-powered agentic coding to improve engineering productivity, while setting high standards for security, quality, scalability, and operational readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define end-to-end architecture for a multi-tenant SaaS platform, balancing scalability, performance, security, availability, and cost.
* Assess existing POC and prototype code, determine what can be reused versus re-architected, and define a practical path to production and go-live.
* Production-harden prototypes through robust error handling, logging, monitoring, automated testing, security controls, configuration management, and performance tuning.
* Own production-readiness reviews, load and performance testing, CI/CD and deployment strategies (including blue-green and canary releases), rollback plans, and post-launch support.
* Architect scalable analytics pipelines for drone-captured imagery and video, covering live-stream and bulk-field-upload ingestion, processing, model inference, storage, and API-based delivery of results.
* Address drone-data constraints, including large high-resolution media, intermittent or low-bandwidth connectivity, GPS and flight telemetry, altitude, gimbal/camera orientation, timestamps, and mapping data to missions, sites, and assets.
* Make architecture decisions for real-time versus batch processing, GPU/accelerator utilization, edge versus cloud inference, and cost optimization for media-heavy workloads.
* Architect enterprise identity and SSO using SAML 2.0, OIDC, and OAuth 2.0; support per-tenant SSO configuration, integrations with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Google Workspace, SCIM provisioning, RBAC, and session management.
* Design and own the platform’s extensibility and integration layer, including public APIs, webhooks, SDKs, and plugin/extension models for customer, partner, third-party, drone-platform, and fleet-management integrations, with versioning, backward compatibility, and safe sandboxing.
* Own end-to-end security architecture, including API gateway and WAF controls, authentication and authorization, encryption in transit and at rest, secrets and key management, audit logging, and tenant data isolation.
* Drive secure-by-design practices through threat modelling, security reviews of designs and code, dependency and vulnerability management, and penetration-test remediation—including for AI-generated code and third-party extensions/integrations.
* Architect and oversee backend services, including REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, and service-to-service communication.
* Remain hands-on: write and review production-grade backend code, build POCs, and demonstrate engineering standards by example.
* Design core SaaS capabilities such as multi-tenancy, subscription and billing integration, tenant data isolation, rate limiting, and horizontal scalability.
* Lead adoption of AI/LLM agentic coding tools such as Claude Code for delivery acceleration, refactoring, and productionizing prototype code.
* Establish workflows and best practices for AI-assisted software development, including code-review standards, guardrails, and quality gates for AI-generated code.

**Tech Architect | Job Description**

* Define technical standards, coding guidelines, and architectural patterns across engineering teams; evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks, tools, and emerging AI/LLM and computer-vision capabilities.
* Partner with product managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Review and approve high-level designs (HLDs), guide low-level designs (LLDs), identify technical debt, and lead legacy-system modernization, using AI-assisted tools where beneficial.
* Ensure architecture meets non-functional requirements for scalability, availability, security, tenant isolation, and observability.
* Mentor senior engineers and tech leads on architecture, productionizing prototypes, and effective use of AI coding assistants.
* Lead POCs for new technologies, LLM/agentic workflows, vision models, and major system changes.
* Collaborate with DevOps/SRE teams on infrastructure, deployment, and CI/CD architecture.
* Own architecture documentation and keep it current across the organization.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills**

* 10–15 years of software engineering experience, including significant experience in architecture-focused roles.
* Proven experience building and scaling SaaS products end to end, ideally from early-stage development through growth.
* A demonstrated track record of taking POCs/prototypes to production through refactoring, re-architecture, hardening, and successful live launches with measurable reliability and performance.
* Strong backend engineering experience designing, building, and scaling production REST/GraphQL APIs and microservices.
* Experience designing or building systems that ingest and process drone-generated aerial imagery and video at scale, including use cases such as object detection, change detection, classification, tracking, and inspection.
* Understanding of video streaming protocols (RTSP, RTMP, WebRTC, HLS), encoding/transcoding, and large-scale media storage.
* Experience with drone data and metadata, including geo-tagged imagery, flight telemetry, geospatial context, and data flows from device or ground station to cloud.
* Familiarity with production deployment and serving of computer-vision/ML models, including inference optimization, GPU workloads, batching, and model versioning; exposure to OpenCV, FFmpeg, or similar frameworks.
* Hands-on experience implementing enterprise SSO and authentication using SAML, OIDC, OAuth2, and SCIM in multi-tenant SaaS products, including integration with major identity providers.
* Experience designing extensible platforms with public APIs, webhooks, SDKs, and plugin/extension or third-party integration frameworks, including versioning, rate limiting, and safe extension isolation.
* Strong security architecture skills covering API security, encryption, secrets management, tenant isolation, secure SDLC, threat modelling, and OWASP Top 10 risks and mitigations.
* Mandatory hands-on coding capability; this is an active engineering role, not solely an architecture-review position.
* Practical, demonstrable use of AI/LLM-based agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code) in real engineering workflows, beyond casual use.
* Strong expertise in system design, distributed systems, and microservices architecture.
* Experience with multi-tenant architecture, subscription billing systems, and SaaS scalability patterns.
* Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, including managed GPU/ML and media services.

1ce0ae65.title: Technical Lead- Architecture and Engineering
1ce0ae65.company: Smartkheti Products, Opulent Infotech Pvt. Ltd.
1ce0ae65.description:
Build the technology that helps solve India’s water crisis

Chandigarh Tricity | Full-time | On-site

7–10 years preferred | 6+ years can be considered for an exceptional candidate

At **Wattr.ai**, we are building technology for one of India's most important and complex challenges — **water**.

We are creating the digital intelligence layer for real-world water infrastructure, connecting sensors, field systems, data, software and AI to help organisations monitor, understand and manage water infrastructure at scale.

And we are looking for a Technical Lead who wants to **own the technology behind it.**

This is not a role where you simply receive requirements and write tickets.

You will work across the entire product-engineering chain:

**Business Requirement → Product Requirement → System Architecture → Technical Design → Engineering Sprints → Task Allocation → Development → Testing → Deployment → Production → Scale**

**You will architect it.**

**You will build it.**

**You will lead the engineering team that executes it.**

**You will own technical delivery against product goals, KPIs and deadlines.**

What you will own

You will be the technical bridge between the **Product team and Engineering team**, translating what the business needs into systems that can actually be built, deployed and scaled.

You will:

→ Understand business and product requirements and convert them into technical solutions

→ Design the overall system architecture — application, APIs, databases, data pipelines, cloud infrastructure and integrations

→ Break architecture and product requirements into engineering modules, technical tasks and deliverables

→ Plan and drive engineering sprints based on product priorities, dependencies and deadlines

→ Assign work across developers based on technical complexity, priorities and individual strengths

→ Track sprint execution and ensure engineering commitments translate into actual product delivery

→ Identify technical risks, dependencies and bottlenecks early and drive them to resolution

→ Remain hands-on with development, particularly on critical or complex components

→ Review architecture, code and implementation decisions to maintain engineering quality

→ Work closely with Product to balance speed, scalability, reliability and business priorities

→ Own technical delivery from **0→1 and beyond**, taking products from an idea to a field-tested production system

Technology you will work across

This is a broad technical ownership role. You should be comfortable going deep across multiple layers of the stack:

**Frontend → Backend → APIs → Data → Real-time Systems → IoT → Cloud → Infrastructure → AI**

Full-stack Engineering

Strong hands-on experience with:

* **Node.js** and modern backend development
* **React** and frontend application development
* REST APIs and service integrations
* Databases and data modelling
* Authentication, authorization and application security
* Performance optimisation and production debugging

Cloud & Infrastructure

Strong experience with **AWS** and production cloud systems.

You should understand and ideally have hands-on experience with:

* EC2, S3, RDS / time-series databases and relevant AWS services
* AWS IoT Core or equivalent IoT cloud platforms
* Docker and containerised applications
* Kubernetes / EKS or equivalent
* CI/CD pipelines
* Infrastructure as Code such as Terraform
* Monitoring, logging and observability
* Cloud security, networking and reliability

The expectation is not simply to consume cloud infrastructure — you should understand how to **design, provision and evolve the infrastructure on which the product runs.**

IoT, Real-time & Data Systems

Wattr works with real-world infrastructure and continuously generated data.

Experience with any of the following is highly valuable:

* IoT platforms and connected devices
* MQTT / pub-sub architectures
* Sensor telemetry and real-time data ingestion
* Event-driven systems
* Kafka or similar streaming technologies
* Data ingestion / ETL pipelines
* Time-series data
* High-volume event processing
* Real-time alerts, monitoring and reporting
* Edge/cloud architectures

You should be comfortable thinking about:

**Device → Data → Backend → Processing → Intelligence → Dashboard → Action**

AI & AI-assisted Engineering

AI is becoming an important part of how we build intelligent infrastructure.

Experience with:

* LLMs / GenAI
* AI APIs and integrations
* RAG / agentic systems
* ML/AI pipelines
* AI-assisted development using tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude or equivalent is a strong advantage.

We are particularly interested in engineers who use AI tools **practically to increase engineering velocity and solve problems better**, rather than simply having theoretical exposure.

Architecture & System Design

Architecture ownership is **mandatory** for this role.

We are looking for someone with at least **2–3 years of genuine hands-on architecture / system-design experience**.

You should have experience with:

* Designing production systems from business requirements
* Defining system and service boundaries
* Making technology and architecture decisions
* Designing APIs and integrations
* Database and data architecture
* Distributed and event-driven systems
* Scalability and performance
* Reliability and fault tolerance
* Security and observability
* Cloud architecture and infrastructure
* Evolving architecture as products scale

Importantly, you should have **built the systems you architected**.

We are not looking for a pure enterprise architect or consulting architect who primarily produces diagrams and documents.

Technical Leadership

You will lead the engineering team technically and drive execution.

This includes:

Translating product requirements into technical plans

Breaking large requirements into manageable engineering tasks

Planning sprints and sequencing technical dependencies

Assigning work to engineers

Reviewing progress against sprint commitments

Unblocking developers when technical issues arise

Conducting code and architecture reviews

Mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards

Working with Product to manage technical trade-offs and delivery priorities

Ensuring engineering execution remains aligned with business KPIs and product deadlines

You may lead a small team of engineers, but **your primary identity should remain that of a strong hands-on engineer and technical leader.**

0→1 Ownership

We want someone who has experienced the journey:

**Idea → Architecture → First Build → MVP → Production → Scale**

You should have personally contributed to taking at least one product, platform or major system from **0→1** and subsequently helped scale or productionise it.

Startup experience is a strong advantage, particularly experience working in environments where engineers have to make decisions independently and move quickly.

What makes this role different

You won't be responsible for just one layer of the technology stack.

You will have visibility into the **entire product**.

You will understand why the product needs to exist → decide how it should be built → architect the system → break it into engineering work → lead the team through execution → write critical code yourself → deploy it → see it working in the real world.

And the real-world application is meaningful.

Water infrastructure

Connected devices

Live operational data

AI-driven intelligence

Large-scale infrastructure

Real impact across India

This is an opportunity to build technology where the systems you design don't just live inside a software product — **they interact with the physical world.**

What success looks like

In your first 6–12 months, you should be able to:

Take ownership of the technical architecture of key Wattr products

Translate product requirements into clear engineering plans

Establish an effective sprint and engineering execution rhythm

Build and ship a field-tested MVP rapidly

Bring live sensor/device data into reliable production systems

Build scalable backend and frontend systems

Establish robust APIs, data pipelines, alerts and reporting

Improve automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring and observability

Identify architectural bottlenecks before they become production problems

Help build an engineering culture focused on ownership, quality and delivery

Most importantly:

**The technology you build should become a competitive advantage for Wattr.ai.**

What we're looking for

7–10 years of software engineering experience preferred

6+ years can be considered for an exceptional candidate

**2–3+ years of hands-on architecture / system-design ownership is mandatory**

Strong hands-on full-stack engineering experience

Strong **Node.js + React** experience

Strong AWS / cloud experience

Experience setting up and evolving infrastructure

Strong understanding of APIs, databases and distributed systems

Experience with data pipelines / high-volume or real-time systems

0→1 product or platform development experience

Experience leading or mentoring engineers

Strong sprint planning, task breakdown and engineering execution skills

IoT / MQTT / telemetry / real-time systems experience is a strong advantage

AI / GenAI and AI-assisted development experience is a strong advantage

Excellent problem-solving and communication skills

Strong ownership mindset and ability to operate independently

This role is NOT

A pure people-management role

A pure enterprise architect role

A consulting / documentation-heavy architecture role

A backend-only or frontend-only role

A role where requirements are simply converted into tickets

We want someone who can:

**Understand → Architect → Break Down → Assign → Build → Review → Ship → Scale**

Why Wattr.ai?

Because this is an opportunity to build something that matters.

You will be working at the intersection of:

**Software × Cloud × IoT × Data × AI × Physical Infrastructure**

and applying those technologies to one of India's biggest real-world challenges.

If you are the kind of engineer who looks at a complex problem and thinks:

**“Let me understand the whole system — and then let me build it.”**

We would love to hear from you.

Pay: From ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Expected CTC
