* Current CTC
* Are you willing to relocate to Zirakpur

Work Location: In person

933fe054.title: Technical Architect – AWS AI Architect
933fe054.description:
Experience: 12+ Years

**Role Summary**

* Architect agentic solutions end to end: task decomposition, tool/function design, memory and state models, orchestration topology (supervisor, hierarchical, sequential, parallel), and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* + Design and tune production RAG pipelines — chunking, hybrid retrieval, reranking, query rewriting, metadata filtering, grounding and citation — and own the retrieval quality metrics, not just the pipeline diagram.
* + Build the evaluation layer alongside the system: golden datasets, trace-level assertions, LLM-as-judge rubrics, regression suites that gate deployment.
* + Select and justify the AWS service composition for each workload, with an explicit view on cost, latency, data residency, and failure modes.
* + Define guardrails and the security posture for agents that take real actions: least-privilege tool permissions, prompt injection defenses, PII handling, audit trails.
* + Set engineering standards for the practice — reference architectures, reusable agent and tool patterns, observability conventions — and mentor engineers into them.
* + Partner with client stakeholders on solution shaping, technical discovery, effort estimation, and proof-of-value scoping.

**Why This Role Matters**

Agentic AI systems fail in production for predictable reasons: unmanaged context windows, brittle orchestration, unscoped tool permissions, and no observability into why an agent did what it did. This role exists to prevent that — designing agent architectures on AWS (Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker) that are secure by default, cost-bounded, evaluable, and built to scale past the POC stage

**What You’ll Do**

We are seeking a strong AWS AI architect with hands-on expertise with At least two agentic or RAG systems taken to production on AWS, with evidence of ownership through the operate phase — not pilots that stopped at demo**.**

**Must-Have Skills**

2-3 year experience in Agentic system design Planning and execution loops, ReAct and plan-execute patterns, tool/function calling design, short- and long-term memory, state persistence and recovery, multi-agent orchestration and handoff design, MCP and A2A for tool and agent interoperability. Practical judgment on when an agent is the wrong answer and a deterministic workflow is the right one.

2-3 year experience in Agent frameworks Deep hands-on experience with at least two of: Strands Agents SDK, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex. Comfortable dropping to a custom orchestration loop where a framework gets in the way.

3 year experience in RAG engineering Production experience with document processing and chunking strategy, embedding model selection, vector and hybrid (BM25 + dense) retrieval, reranking, query decomposition, GraphRAG and agentic RAG patterns, context-window budgeting, and grounding/citation enforcement. Able to diagnose whether a bad answer came from retrieval, ranking, or generation.

AWS AI stack – 3 years of experience –

Amazon Bedrock — Converse API, model selection and routing, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Flows, prompt caching, batch vs. real-time inference and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore — Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity, Observability, Code Interpreter, Browser

Amazon SageMaker AI for custom model hosting, training, and endpoint operations and Vector and search: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless, S3 Vectors, Aurora PostgreSQL with pgvector, Amazon Kendra.

5 years of experience in AWS core services Lambda, Step Functions, ECS/EKS/Fargate, API Gateway, EventBridge, SQS, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, VPC and PrivateLink. Able to design a VPC-isolated, private-endpoint deployment for a regulated client without help.

7+ years of experience in Python engineering Production-grade Python — async, typing, Pydantic, FastAPI, structured testing. Clean, reviewable code; not notebook-only.

2+ years of experience Evaluation and LLMOps Offline and online evaluation design, RAGAS or equivalent retrieval metrics, trace-based observability (OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions, CloudWatch, Langfuse/LangSmith or similar), prompt and model versioning, token and cost governance, drift and regression detection.

2+ years of experience AI security and responsible AI Prompt injection and tool-abuse threat modeling, scoped tool permissions and action approval design, data classification and PII handling, content filtering, auditability. Working familiarity with an AI governance framework such as NIST AI RMF.

**Good to Have**

Model optimization — fine-tuning and LoRA/QLoRA, distillation into smaller or open-weight models, SLM deployment, structured decoding, latency/cost optimization under SLA.

Multimodal and voice — Amazon Nova models, Transcribe, Polly, real-time voice agent architectures and Infrastructure as code and CI/CD — AWS CDK or Terraform, GitHub Actions or CodePipeline, containerization, environment promotion strategy.

Data engineering foundations — AWS Glue, Kinesis, Kafka/Confluent, Lake Formation, Iceberg; designing the ingestion layer that feeds retrieval and Enterprise integration — SharePoint, ServiceNow, Salesforce, SAP, Confluence/Jira connectors and their authentication realities.

Regulated-industry delivery — HIPAA, GxP, SOC 2, or FedRAMP contexts; EU AI Act awareness and Frontend for AI — React or Streamlit for rapid proofs of value, streaming UX (SSE/WebSocket), interrupt and approval interfaces.

**What Success Looks Like (6–12 Months)**

Agentic AI systems move from prototype to production with defined SLAs, scoped permissions, and continuous evaluation — not fragile demos that break under real usage. Your architectural patterns become the org’s reusable default, cutting time-to-production for every team that builds after you.

**Why Join WinWire: Your Path to Professional Excellence in the Age of AI**

As an **Employer of Choice,** WinWire offers an exceptional workplace culture, industry recognition, and an unwavering commitment to employee growth. Here is why top talent chooses us:

* **AI-First. Globally Recognized**: Honored at the World Economic Forum in Davos for our pioneering "Agentic AI @ Scale" work, cementing our position as a forward-thinking, AI-first services firm shaping the future of enterprise technology.
* **Microsoft Gold Standard**: A **6x Microsoft** Global Partner of the Year Winner/Finalist — reflecting our consistent delivery of industry-leading solutions and our deep, trusted partnership with Microsoft.
* **Joining the NTT DATA Family**: WinWire (Part of NTT DATA), a $30 billion global leader in AI, digital business, and technology services. This means greater career stability, broader client exposure, and access to a vast landscape of opportunities across a truly global organization.
* **Award-Winning Culture**: Certified as a Best Place to Work® four times, our workplace culture is not just a talking point — it is a proven, recognized commitment to creating an environment where people genuinely thrive.
* **People-First Environment**: With a strong 4.0 Glassdoor rating, our employees speak for themselves. We prioritize wellbeing, inclusivity, and a culture of respect at every level of the organization.
* **Invest in Your Growth**: From continuous learning programs to structured career development pathways, we equip our team with the skills, tools, and opportunities needed to grow and lead in the age of AI.

* 5+ years of experience in technical program management, software engineering, product development, or a related technical discipline.

bdcd0a9e.title: Solutions Engineer
bdcd0a9e.description:
**An Amazing Career Opportunity for Solutions Engineer
  
  
Location: Remote Or Hybrid / Office
  
  
Job ID: 49282**
**Profile Summary**
HID Global’s Biometric Identity Technologies division is seeking a skilled Solutions Engineer with a strong presales orientation, capable of delivering compelling demonstrations, managing strategic tenders, and guiding customers—particularly national authorities such as Police forces, Ministries, and other government institutions—through complex solution evaluations.
  
  
In this role, you will collaborate closely with Sales to understand customer challenges, shape technical requirements, and identify opportunities for HID’s hardware, software, and professional services. While a solid architecture and development foundation is required, the emphasis is on customer-facing activities, including presentations, proof‑of‑concepts, and presales technical leadership.
  
  
You will help articulate HID Global’s value, support technical aspects of the sales cycle, and ensure smooth transitions from presales engagement into project execution. The position is designed for a motivated professional who excels in remote/hybrid environments and thrives in a role that blends technical expertise with high-impact communication.
  
  
You will support Sales across Middle East and India regions, including travel for on‑site demonstrations, workshops, and government stakeholder engagements.
  
  
**Ideal Qualifications:**

* Proven experience designing end-to-end identity verification, biometric enrollment, adjudication, or credentialing workflows involving sensitive biometric and personally identifiable information (PII).
* Experience creating solution architectures for large government agencies involving identity management, biometric matching, data integration, case management, or digital identity platforms.
* Proven experience working on AADHAR and related projects for biometric identity solutions (such as STQC, MOSIP, etc…)

**Who are we?**
HID Global Biometric Identity Technologies is trusted by governments and enterprises worldwide. We support everyday identity verification use cases where performance, accuracy and continuity are non-negotiable. HID Global’s mission is to power the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely. We are a high-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,000 worldwide employees. Check us out: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo
  
  
LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/hidglobal/mycompany/
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities include the following.**
Other duties may be assigned.
  
  

* Serve as a technical presales expert within the Sales team, strengthening customer engagements through tailored demonstrations, technical guidance, and structured tender support.
* Develop and deliver high-impact solution demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and presentations that clearly communicate HID Global’s value to government and enterprise customers.
* Prepare detailed proposals and tender documentation for complex opportunities, ensuring compliance with government procurement requirements and alignment with customer technical needs.
* Interpret and refine customer requirements in collaboration with regional Sales, Product Management, and Engineering teams, ensuring proposed solutions address national authority use cases such as law enforcement, civil ID, and border management.
* Provide complete technical content for RFPs, RFIs, and government tenders, ensuring accuracy, competitiveness, and clarity.
* Architect, validate, and document biometric and identity‑management solutions across HID’s portfolio, ensuring alignment with mission‑critical government environments.
* Act as HID Global’s primary technical liaison throughout presales and post-sales phases, ensuring consistent communication, clarity on deliverables, and alignment between customer expectations and internal teams.
* Maintain deep awareness of market trends, biometric technologies, and public-sector digital transformation initiatives.
* Represent HID Global's technical capabilities at trade shows, partner events, and government briefings, delivering professional demonstrations and solution walkthroughs.

**Primary Duties:**

* Collaborate weekly with an international presales and solutions engineering team, sharing best practices and supporting cross-regional opportunities.
* Support Sales across Middle East, and India regions, including travel for on‑site demonstrations, workshops, and government stakeholder engagements.
* Focus on presales activities for HID’s commercial and ABIS solutions, especially for small-to-medium national authorities, civil registry agencies, and security ministries.

**Essential Qualifications (Required)**
To perform this role successfully, candidates must meet the following requirements:
  
  

* Fluent in English and Hindi
* Bachelor’s degree in computer information systems or related fields
* Minimum 5 years of presales and customer-facing technical experience, including demonstrations, requirements analysis, and support
* Proven experience engaging with national authorities, such as Police agencies, Ministries of Interior/Justice, civil ID programs, or similar public-sector clients.
* Minimum 3 years of experience with a focus on server / client solution architecture
* Excellent presentation and communication skills, particularly for non-technical and government audiences
* Strong problem-solving aptitude with an ability to engineer customer-centric solutions that drive sales success
* Deep understanding of the hardware and software development lifecycle and technical solution delivery
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage several presales engagements simultaneously in a hybrid/remote environment

**Education and/or Experience:**

* Master’s degree or relevant technical certifications
* Experience drafting Statements of Work and technical proposals
* Experience of working as a liaison between Sales and an Engineering team
* Able to manage technical solutions by performing basic project management functions including but not limited to scope, tracking deliverables, providing meeting minutes and tracking action items
* Experience with scripting or programming languages for adapting or creating demo environments
* Hands-on experience with development platforms or compilers (Android Studio, Visual Studio, etc.)
* Proven ability to configure, test, and validate server/client systems
* Ability to work as part of a team
* Familiarity with biometric systems (fingerprint, facial)
* Familiarity with document validation and proofing technologies for Passports or national IDs
* Experience with Enterprise and distributed system architecture
* Experience with collaboration and productivity tools: Salesforce, Confluence, Jira, SharePoint, Git
* Strong teamwork abilities and proficiency with Microsoft Office applications
* Proficient in MS Office applications, such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.
* Solid experience working within an MS Windows 11 environment

**Why apply?**

* Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
* Innovation: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part-time job seekers.
* Integrity: You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted.

This opportunity may be open to flexible working arrangements.
  
  
HID is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – Minority/Female/Disability/Veteran/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation
  
  
**We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!**
On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.
  
  
When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

. This role is primarily focused on understanding customer requirements, identifying business needs assisting in solution design, supporting solution development, and presenting solutions to customers.
  
  
We are seeking a motivated consultant to join our Supply Chain Consulting practice. In this role, you will build innovative technical solutions for complex supply chain challenges while maintaining and optimizing clients’ existing technology infrastructure.
  
  
The ideal candidate will work closely with customers and internal cross-functional teams to gather requirements, analyze data, develop business insights, and support solution presentations and consulting discussions. This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to customer success, solution consulting, and digital transformation initiatives.

95ea8928.title: Senior Pre-Sales Engineer Role (BMS & Fire Systems)
95ea8928.description:
We're enhancing the way we live and work by intelligently connecting energy systems, buildings and industries!!
  
  
Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place – where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered reliably and efficiently. It provides the flexible infrastructure to allow society to evolve and respond to changing conditions. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world. We do this from the macro to the micro level, from physical products, components and systems to connected, cloud-based digital offerings and services. Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building automation, fire safety and security, HVAC control and energy solutions.
  
  
Job Description: Senior Pre-Sales Engineer Role (BMS & Fire Systems)
  
  
We are looking for a professional with a minimum of 15 years of experience in Building Management Systems (BMS) and Fire Alarm Systems (FAS). The candidate must have an Associate Degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Mechanical Engineering.
  
  
This role will be based in India, providing pre-sales engineering support to regional teams, with close collaboration with local country experts for site-specific, regulatory, and commercial inputs.
  
  
The role of a Senior Pre-Sales Engineer involves the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Conducting both preliminary and detailed pre-sales engineering to assess project suitability, understand requirements, and quantify scope for BMS and Fire Alarm tenders, including service, retrofit (A&A), and system migration projects
* Reviewing tender documents, site information, and available as-built drawings to identify system requirements, HVAC equipment, fire alarm systems, field devices, and interface points
* Reviewing sequence of operations and fire cause & effect, identifying gaps in specifications related to I/O summary and system requirements
* Preparing key deliverables such as RFIs, equipment summaries, data point schedules, loop/device schedules, and bills of material, including:
* Selection and sizing of BMS devices (sensors, valves, actuators, controllers)
* Selection and configuration of fire alarm systems (detectors, modules, panels – e.g., Sinteso EN)
* Definition of system interfaces and licenses
* Developing BMS and Fire system architecture, including integration with existing and third-party systems
* Producing technical compliance statements aligned with project specifications
* Working closely with local country experts to:
* Validate local fire code and regulatory compliance
* Incorporate actual site conditions and operational constraints
* Define scope boundaries and interfaces with other systems
* Supporting cost development by:
* Structuring and defining scope packages for subcontractors and suppliers
* Working with local teams, who will engage subcontractors and obtain budgetary quotations for relevant portions of the works
* Consolidating technical scope and cost inputs into the overall solution
* Recognising that supplier and subcontractor coordination, including quotation requests and commercial engagement, will be led by local country teams
* Identifying and mitigating technical and operational risks (e.g., legacy systems, live environment constraints), while capturing opportunities during tendering
* Preparing accurate project cost estimates, considering site constraints, phasing, and migration strategy
* Performing thorough quality checks on all deliverables prior to submission

**The Candidate Should Possess The Following Skills And Knowledge**

* Strong knowledge of BMS, HVAC (ACMV), Electrical systems, and Fire Alarm Systems
* Understanding of fire system design principles, including cause & effect, zoning, and fail-safe operation
* Ability to work in a regional support model, collaborating effectively with local teams responsible for site validation, authority compliance, and supplier coordination
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills
* Understanding of basic instrumentation and control loops
* Ability to interpret single line diagrams, fire schematics, and floor plans (including incomplete as-built drawings)
* Knowledge of BACnet, Modbus, M-Bus, KNX, and system integration interfaces
* Proficiency in MS Office, Bluebeam, and AutoCAD/Groundplan tools
* Knowledge of Revit and BIM will be an added advantage
* Additional knowledge in IT networking, cybersecurity, and industry compliance practices is advantageous
* Experience in service/retrofit environments or regional/global project support will be an added advantage.

This role is based in Chennai, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.
  
  
Make your mark in our exciting world of Siemens
  
  
We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in across Gender, LGBTQ+, Abilities & Ethnicity. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination, and help us shape tomorrow.
  
  
Find out more about Smart Infrastructure at: https://new.siemens.com/global/en/company/topic-areas/smart-infrastructure.html and about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers #SL

ae57d416.title: Solutions Architect
ae57d416.description:
FEQ327R324
  
  
As a Solutions Architect part of a Global Capability Center(GCC) focused Field Engineering team, you will shape the future of the Data and AI landscape by working with the most sophisticated Data and AI teams in the world, including Fortune 500 enterprises and global AI-forward SaaS customers operating globally. In this role, you will be deeply embedded with our named strategic accounts, serving as a trusted long-term technical advisor while also collaborating with internal sales, product, and engineering teams.
  
  
You will help our customers achieve tangible data-driven outcomes through the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, helping data teams complete projects and integrate our platform into their enterprise ecosystem. You'll grow as a leader in your field, while finding solutions to our customers' biggest challenges in data engineering, analytics, AI and data science.
  
  
Reporting to the Field Engineering Manager, you will collaborate with our most strategic global prospects and customers, partner with regional field teams across geographies, work directly with product and engineering to drive the Databricks roadmap forward, and work with the broader customer-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform. You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.
  
  
**The impact you will have**

* Be the trusted technical advisor for one or more named strategic accounts — building deep, durable relationships with their data, AI/ML, and platform engineering leaders, and earning a seat at the table for their most important architectural decisions.
* Help shape and drive your customer's AI strategy — partnering with their data science, ML, and AI platform teams to design GenAI and ML architectures, evaluate build-vs-buy decisions, and turn AI ambitions into production systems deployed on Databricks.
* Partner with the sales team and provide hands-on technical leadership to help large enterprise customers understand how Databricks can help solve their business problems across the full data and AI lifecycle.
* Consult on modern Lakehouse architectures and implement proofs of concept for strategic projects spanning data engineering, data warehousing, machine learning, GenAI— including validating integrations with cloud services, in-house tools, and third-party applications.
* Work directly with the sales team to develop your book of business, define account strategies, and execute those strategies to help your customers and prospects solve their business problems with Databricks.
* Collaborate across regions with fellow Solutions Architects and account teams, supporting our customers with consistent architectural guidance across their international footprint.
* Become an expert in, promote, and recruit contributors for Databricks-inspired open-source projects (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow, Unity Catalog) across the developer community.

**What We Look For**

* 12+ years in data engineering, data science, technical architecture, or a similar pre-sales / consulting role.
* 8+ years hands-on experience with Big Data and AI technologies, including Apache Spark™, data engineering, data science, and modern AI/ML workloads.
* Strong hands-on architectural experience — able to whiteboard, design, and personally build end-to-end solutions, not just advise.
* Demonstrated experience working with large enterprise or Fortune 500 customers; experience supporting global accounts across multiple geographies strongly preferred.
* Experience working with digital-native or SaaS enterprises with mature data and AI practices is a strong plus.
* Strong consulting / customer-facing experience working with external clients across a variety of industries.
* Coding experience in Python, SQL, Scala, Java, or R.
* Experience building distributed data systems at enterprise scale.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Available to travel to customers in your region and occasionally internationally.
* Nice to have: prior experience working in or with a Global Capability Center model; Databricks Certification.

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
  
  
**Benefits**

768bf550.description:
Couchbase, the operational data platform for AI, empowers businesses to succeed by bringing data to life in new ways. Major market-leading companies rely on Couchbase for mission critical operational, analytical, mobile and AI workloads. Built to replace legacy infrastructure and fragmented data services, Couchbase empowers enterprises with a unified platform architected for performance, flexibility and global scale.
  
  
With Couchbase, organizations bring their data to life, launching game‑changing customer experiences, exploring the limitless potential of AI, and seamlessly extending applications from the cloud to the edge and beyond. Couchbase’s AI‑ready technology and enterprise partnership model eliminate complexity and reduce total cost of ownership, enabling teams to stay agile, innovative and secure.
  
  
Couchbase believes data should never slow you down, but act as the foundation for your next breakthrough. Discover why Couchbase is trusted to help the world’s biggest players scale, move fast and stay resilient, no matter what’s next on their roadmap. Visit couchbase.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
Want to be part of our story? Apply today!
  
  
As a
**Solutions Architect**
, you will be the trusted advisor helping our customers unlock the ultimate value of Couchbase. You will work directly with customer engineering teams, blending high-level architectural coaching with hands-on professional service delivery. If you love solving complex, real-world data challenges, designing cutting-edge AI-ready architectures, and guiding enterprise customers from design to production, this role is for you.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Responsibilities)**

* Lead Customer Engagements: Guide short- to medium-term on-site and remote client engagements. You will lead architecture and use case reviews, sizing, performance tuning, and deployment topology planning to get Couchbase up, running, and optimized.
* Solve Complex Technical Challenges: Work hand-in-hand with customers to solve deep technical problems from initial design through to production operations, managing hands-on troubleshooting and escalating issues when necessary.
* Architect for the Future of AI: Help customers implement AI solutions and data platforming best practices, leveraging Couchbase’s advanced features like indexing, SQL++, Full-Text Search, Vector Search, and Columnar technologies.
* Own the Lifecycle: Assist with all phases of Couchbase implementations, including installation, deployment topology planning, and establishing operational best practices.
* Be a Trusted Advisor: Act as the technical product expert, comfortably communicating and presenting complex architectural concepts to audiences ranging from developers and architects to C-level managers.
* Drive Internal Innovation: Contribute to internal technical projects, including software development, benchmarking, and troubleshooting.
* Collaborate Globally: Partner closely with sales and pre-sales teams to handle technical escalations and identify growth opportunities within existing accounts.
* Share Knowledge: Author internal and external technical collateral, such as reference architectures, whitepapers, and best-practice guides.

**What You’ll Bring (Qualifications)**

* Database Expertise: 5+ years of experience in enterprise back-end software consulting, with a strong focus on database technologies (SQL, NoSQL, or Distributed Databases).
* Cloud Proficiency: 2+ years of experience working with major Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including cloud troubleshooting and performance tuning.
* Development Background: A strong foundation in application design and development, with familiarity in traditional RDBMS schema modeling and configuration.
* AI & Modern Tech Savvy: Experience engaging with developers and utilizing AI-assisted development/evaluation techniques (e.g., Gemini, Claude).
* Problem-Solving Mindset: A rigorous diagnostic and troubleshooting process, with a proven track record of resolving complex, end-to-end technical issues.
* Exceptional Communication: Stellar presentation and communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical solutions concisely to both highly technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Education: BSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent technical field.
* Languages: Fluency in English is required.

**Working at Couchbase**
At Couchbase, Innovation Thrives When Diverse Perspectives Come Together. Our Culture Is Driven By Four Core Values That Guide How We Build Mission-critical Technology And Collaborate Every Day
  
  

* Put the Customer First: The customer must be at the center of everything we do.
* Be a Good Human, Always: Integrity, empathy, and respect are our non-negotiable bedrock.
* Win as One Team: No one wins alone. Collaboration is how we erase silos.
* Build for Mission Critical: Our product earned customer trust. We honor it by relentlessly pushing what’s technically possible.

We actively encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds—including women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ professionals, veterans, and individuals with disabilities. We also value unconventional career paths and unique life experiences.
  
  
**A note on qualifications:**
Studies show that underrepresented talent is less likely to apply unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If you are excited about this role and feel you can make strong contributions to our team,
**please apply**
—even if your experience doesn't check every single box.
  
  
*If you require reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let your recruiter know. We are happy to support you.*
**Why Couchbase?**
Modern customer experiences demand a flexible cloud database platform that powers applications from the cloud to the edge and everywhere in between. Couchbase’s mission is to simplify how developers and architects build, deploy, and consume modern applications. With
**Capella**
—our fast, flexible, and affordable cloud database platform—we enable organizations to deliver premium user experiences backed by best-in-class price performance.
  
  
More than
**30% of the Fortune 100**
trust Couchbase to power their mission-critical applications. We’re also proud to be consistently recognized as a
**Best Place to Work**
in both the Bay Area and the UK.
  
  
**What We Offer (Total Rewards)**
We offer a holistic approach to benefits that recognizes the value you create, helping you care for yourself and your family:
  
  

* Generous Time Off: Flexible programs designed to support your work-life balance.
* Health & Wellness: World-class medical, dental, vision, mental health, life insurance, and employee assistance programs.\*
* Financial Security: Competitive retirement plans\* and business travel coverage.

**Remote Job**

**Shift Time : 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM**

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a highly experienced EDA Solutions Architect / Technical Lead to support a global data center consolidation and infrastructure migration initiative focused on Electronic Design Automation (EDA) environments. This individual will play a critical role in assessing existing infrastructure, defining migration strategies, and developing technical execution plans for complex workload migrations across multiple international sites.

Evaluate compute, storage, network, and application dependencies to determine migration readiness.

Create migration strategies and technical execution plans for workload consolidation initiatives.

Experience coordinating with global infrastructure and operations teams.

Strong communication skills with the ability to present technical recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.

c0756e79.description:

**Job Description**
-------------------

**About the role**
==================

The People Solutions Advisor Lead provides manager-of-managers leadership for the People Solutions Advisor service.

The role is accountable for collective service outcomes across these clusters. Approximately 2-4 People Solutions Advisor Cluster Leads report directly into the role. Each cluster comprises around 12–20 Advisors.

The focus is on consistent, human-centric employee and manager support, capable leadership and a resilient service.

The role is based in a Global Capability Centre (GCC) in Łódź, Mexico City or Bengaluru. It leads Tier 1 human support and employee lifecycle delivery, connecting the Advisor service with Tier 0 Direct Access, self-service and AI front door, People Experience Partners and specialist teams. Leadership centres on service performance, workforce planning, governance and continuous improvement.

**How you will contribute**
===========================

**Lead leaders and build organisational capability**
----------------------------------------------------

* Lead, coach and hold Cluster Leads accountable for service outcomes, people leadership and consistent delivery standards.
* Set clear objectives and review performance across clusters.
* Build a culture of inclusion, collaboration and continuous learning.
* Develop leadership capability and succession plans.
* Address capability gaps and share effective practices across clusters.
* Work through Cluster Leads to strengthen Advisor skills, onboarding and training.
* Support build-operate-transfer (BOT) joiners as part of capability building.
* Ensure teams can support sensitive employee situations with empathy, sound judgement and appropriate escalation.
* Maintain clear boundaries so Advisor responsibilities do not extend into specialist HR partnering.

**Plan capacity and protect service continuity**
------------------------------------------------

* Develop cross-cluster workforce and capacity plans.
* Use demand forecasts, case complexity, language needs, skills and local requirements to inform planning.
* Agree priorities and capacity allocation with Cluster Leads.
* Balance workload, resilience and service coverage across clusters.
* Identify recruitment, training and resource needs.
* Make evidence-based recommendations through the appropriate approval routes.
* Establish continuity and cross-cover arrangements for absence, demand peaks, system disruption and service transitions.
* Anticipate backlogs and resourcing risks.
* Agree recovery plans and monitor delivery.
* Leave daily queue allocation and routine case oversight with Cluster Leads.
* Intervene where issues require cross-cluster decisions.

**Deliver reliable service and resolve systemic issues**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Own collective Advisor service performance against agreed KPIs, SLAs, quality standards and experience measures.
* Review demand, resolution, backlog, data accuracy and recurring contact trends.
* Provide consolidated reporting on performance, risks and resourcing.
* Ensure corrective actions have clear owners and follow-through.
* Lead resolution of systemic or high-risk delivery escalations beyond the authority or capacity of individual Cluster Leads.
* Coordinate the right operational, People Experience Partner and specialist involvement.
* Protect confidentiality and clear case ownership.
* Use root-cause analysis to prevent recurrence rather than relying on repeated case-by-case intervention.

**Strengthen quality, compliance and process governance**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Oversee consistent lifecycle execution across hiring, onboarding, job changes, leave, severance administration and offboarding.
* Ensure appropriate controls, documentation, data quality and audit readiness.
* Apply global standards with authorised local variation.
* Coordinate timely downstream handoffs with payroll, mobility and benefits teams.
* Coordinate named process and system ownership across clusters.
* Cover lifecycle processes, case and knowledge content, compliance documentation and HR systems data quality.
* Work with global process owners and COEI to clarify accountability and close control gaps.
* Implement approved changes in a consistent way.
* Maintain shared quality reviews and knowledge governance rather than requiring each cluster to develop separate standards.

**Enable digital transformation and better access to support**
--------------------------------------------------------------

* Partner with the HR Digital Partner, Direct Access and relevant process and technology teams.
* Improve the Tier 0 front door and its connection to Tier 1 Advisor support.
* Use service insights to prioritise self-service, knowledge and automation improvements.
* Enable employees and managers to complete appropriate activities independently.
* Retain accessible human support where it is needed.
* Lead adoption of approved changes across clusters.
* Ensure readiness, training and benefits measurement are in place.
* Apply responsible human review of AI-assisted content and outputs before they inform advice or knowledge publication.
* Promote accurate, current guidance.
* Ensure safe handling of employee data across Workday, ServiceNow, SAP and associated service channels.

**Build One HR partnerships and stakeholder accountability**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Represent the Advisor service with People Experience Partners, Direct Access, specialist teams and other delivery stakeholders.
* Agree clear handoffs, escalation routes and service expectations.
* Maintain boundaries between transactional support and specialist HR partnering.
* Ensure a consistent employee and manager experience across calls, video, portal and email.
* Communicate service performance, priorities and risks transparently.
* Seek stakeholder input and agree actions where expectations or dependencies are misaligned.
* Build effective working relationships across GCC locations and supported markets.
* Resolve cross-cluster issues within the Advisor service mandate.
* Escalate decisions that sit outside the Advisor service mandate.

**Skills and qualifications**
=============================

* Demonstrated experience leading HR service delivery or comparable people operations through other managers.
* Ability to coach leaders, manage performance and build succession.
* Strong workforce planning and service continuity skills.
* Experience balancing demand, capacity and capability across multiple teams.
* Sound understanding of employee lifecycle operations and multi-channel case management.
* Strong grasp of HR data quality, confidentiality and compliance controls.
* Ability to interpret KPIs and SLAs.
* Ability to diagnose systemic issues and translate evidence into practical service improvements.
* Familiarity with Workday, ServiceNow, SAP or comparable HR and case-management platforms.
* Effective stakeholder management, influencing and change leadership across markets and functions.
* Human-centric approach to sensitive situations.
* Clear judgement about when to involve People Experience Partners or specialist teams.
* Experience enabling self-service, knowledge governance and automation.
* Awareness of responsible AI use and human review requirements.
* Strong written and spoken English.
* Ability to communicate clearly with diverse employee, manager and HR audiences.
* Additional languages relevant to supported markets are advantageous.

**Locations**
-------------

IND - Bengaluru

**Worker Type**
---------------

Employee

**Worker Sub-Type**
-------------------

Regular

**Time Type**
-------------

Full time

404e275e.description:
**Eaton’s EITC division is currently seeking a Program and Delivery Manager - AI and Data Delivery.**
**What You’ll Do**
This position leads the delivery of data and artificial intelligence products for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions. The role owns the portfolio from demand intake through design, build, deployment and adoption, and is accountable for the scope, schedule, cost and quality of every initiative within it. It is a new role, created to give these functions a dedicated delivery leader as the demand for data and AI capability continues to grow.
  
  
The leader manages the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team and acts as the primary point of contact for functional leadership. Working closely with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security, the role ensures that solutions handling sensitive employee and legal information meet Eaton architecture, privacy and security standards. The position also serves as secondary owner of the AI Navigator idea-to-disposition process for ideas raised by these functions.
  
  

* Lead end-to-end data and artificial intelligence delivery for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions, covering demand intake, prioritization, execution, deployment and value realization.
* Own the delivery roadmap and release plan for every product in the portfolio, and hold delivery teams accountable to committed scope, schedule, cost and quality.
* Lead engagement with senior functional stakeholders to identify business priorities, shape demand into fundable initiatives, and secure agreement on outcomes and success measures.
* Manage the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, capability building and retention of employees and contractors.
* Act as secondary owner for AI Navigator idea-to-disposition for ideas originating in HR, Legal and Corporate Development, ensuring each idea is assessed, dispositioned and tracked to closure.
* Build and manage the financial plan for the portfolio, including annual budget, project and run forecasting, platform consumption, contractor cost control and variance reporting.
* Partner with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security so that solutions comply with architecture guardrails, data privacy obligations and information security standards applicable to employee and legal data.
* Establish and operate delivery governance, covering status reporting, risk and issue management, dependency management, change control and steering reviews.
* Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices and improve predictability, cycle time and quality through objective delivery metrics.
* Manage supplier and partner relationships, including statements of work, resource onboarding and performance against agreed service levels.
* Champion organizational change management and user adoption for AI products, and ensure realised benefits are measured and communicated to stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor degree in a technical discipline such as B.E. / B.Tech / MCA, or B.S. in Computer Science, Mathematics or Engineering. A master degree or MBA is preferred.
* 14 or more years of relevant industry experience in information technology delivery.
* 8 or more years leading program or project delivery for data, analytics or application products in a global organization.
* 4 or more years of direct people leadership of engineering teams that include employees and contract resources.

**Skills**

* Project or program management certification such as PMP, PgMP, Scrum Master or SAFe is preferred.
* Experience delivering technology for HR, Legal or Corporate Development functions, including work with confidential employee or legal data, is preferred.
* Working knowledge of data engineering and analytics platforms, including data pipelines, data warehousing and reporting on Microsoft Azure.
* Practical understanding of artificial intelligence and generative AI solution patterns, including large language models, retrieval augmented generation, prompt design and accuracy evaluation.
* Strong command of program and portfolio management disciplines covering scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality and benefits management.
* Experience running Agile delivery at scale using Scrum, Kanban or SAFe, with hands-on use of Azure DevOps or equivalent tooling.
* Understanding of enterprise application integration, application programming interfaces and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with data privacy, records retention and information security requirements that apply to employee, legal and corporate development data.
* Financial management capability covering budgeting, forecasting, vendor contracting and cost control.
* Executive communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to translate technical work into business outcomes.
* Ability to lead through influence across a matrixed, global organization and across time zones.
* Proven capability in coaching, developing talent and building inclusive, high-performing teams.
* Structured problem solving and sound decision making in conditions of ambiguity.
* Customer focus, solution orientation and a strong drive for results.

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.
  
  
We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

**Preferred qualifications:**

Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.
  
  
Google’s Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) team is keeping Google employees safe and secure to manage disruptive incidents and crises, and to anticipate, deter, detect, and act.
  
  
In this role, you will help develop a culture where safety, security and resiliency are integrated into every facet of Google, including the creative process. You will help us continually identify, evaluate and monitor enterprise risks that could affect business activities and provide business leaders the information they need to make critical decisions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to create innovative strategies and develop exceptional programs that drive sustainable effectiveness. You will be responsible for completing initiatives that improve Google’s ability to anticipate, deter, detect, and act on security risks globally. You will partner internally to prototype and develop solutions on accelerated timelines against stakeholder requirements, owning the full end to end delivery and support of those solutions throughout their lifecycle. Your delivery will enable GSRS operations to keep Google and Google employees safe and secure across the global office locations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

021ad789.title: Sr. Technical Architect
021ad789.description:
**A career that’s the whole package!**
At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.
  
  
**Conga**
lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Sr. Technical Architect, PS
  
  
**Locations:**
Ahmedabad
  
  
**Reports to**
: Director, Professional Services
  
  
**A quick snapshot…**
Conga is seeking an experienced Technical Architect with over 12+ years of work experience who will play a key role in implementing Quote-to-Cash suite of products, including CPQ (configure/price/quote), contract management, revenue management and other related solutions. Perform hands-on design, solution architectures, architecture roadmaps, prototyping, proof-of-concepts, development tasks and integrating Conga products as required in support of current and new projects. Ensuring the solution is scalable and meets overall business requirements. Working with global teams actively for implementation. Be recognized as an expert in CPQ and/or Contract Management domain. Leading technical teams to deliver flexible and scalable solutions.
  
  
**Why it’s a big deal…**
A Technical Architect will help us design and deliver solutions for enterprise-grade customers using Conga products. The intention is to recommend the best solution for a given set of requirements and articulate the trade-offs involved in choosing one solution over another. Leading design sessions and writing design documents by managing the delivery of integrations and custom extensions will be most critical. This person should also be highly proficient and successful in managing the technical and overall scope of the client’s expectations.
  
  
**Are you the person we’re looking for?**
**Related experience.**
You should understand business requirements regarding product management and develop solution design and enhancements using different configurations, using Salesforce or Dot Net platform (APEX, Visual Force, C#, Angular / React JS or equivalent front-end technologies). Thorough unit testing with a high level of code coverage is necessary. You should have demonstrated experience of working as part of an Agile development team. Experience automated deployment process will help score more.
  
  
**Implementation and Integrations.**
The ability to drive deep-level technical discussions with prospects and help set expectations for potential project efforts is a must. A Technical Architect would interact directly with clients and end-users on a regular basis to analyze project objectives and capability requirements, including specifications for user interfaces, customized applications, and interactions with internal / external applications.
  
  
**Design and Pre-Sales Activities.**
You would be responsible for providing hands-on expert level assistance to developers for any issues. Designing and managing the execution deployment and testing ensuring a quality solution is delivered will be the key. Ability to lead a requirement gathering session, write requirements, architecture documents and manage integrations. This role will include participation in pre-sales activities as and when required.
  
  
**Education**
. A bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent.
  
  
**Here’s What Will Give You An Edge…**
**Champion of the Customer**
. You understand that customers are one of business’ most important assets and you take that seriously. With more than 11,000 customers around the globe entrusting Conga with their business we make a commitment to their success and would love to hear how you will too!
  
  
**Analytical thinker and creative problem solver.**
You can see issues holistically and follow the flow of the stack to get to the root of the matter - a key skill in this role. But where you really shine is with your ability to identify creative solutions to unique customer requirements. This is critical for ensuring our customer issues are resolved in a manner that meets or exceeds their expectations without increasing their costs.
  
  
**Quality oriented**
. You rarely make mistakes because you have good processes in place to ensure that every detail is correct. But in those rare occasions when errors are realized (let’s face it, it happens to the best of us from time to time), you own them, correct them, learn from them, and then quickly adjust and communicate processes to ensure the same mistake doesn’t happen twice. It’s your transparency, authenticity and humility are what sets you apart from the rest
  
  
**Tools and certifications.**
Be recognized as an expert in CPQ and/or Contract Management domain. Working experience with Atlassian Suite. Salesforce Platform Developer certifications (level I and II are preferred) or Microsoft Solutions Developer (MCSD) / Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE)
  
  
**Industry expertise.**
Let’s face it, understanding of the software as a service industry would allow you to hit the ground running.
  
  
**Did we pique your interest?**
If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. We'd love to hear from you!
  
  
**Preferred Resume Format**
We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly.
  
  
**Don’t meet every requirement for the role?**


Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We understand interviewing can be stressful for those with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to allow you to show us your best self, please let your recruiter know as soon as possible. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Conga is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complimentary.
  
  
**Conga's Applicant Privacy Statement**
The information you provide during the application process will be used in accordance with Conga’s Applicant Privacy Statement (https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement). By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined in this privacy statement.

208a7349.description:
**About Persistent**
We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries.
  
  
**About Position**
We are seeking an experienced AWS Cloud Solution Architect to lead the design, implementation, and modernization of enterprise cloud solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in cloud architecture, Azure services, Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud networking, and enterprise transformation initiatives. This role requires a combination of technical leadership, hands-on architecture experience, stakeholder management, and delivery excellence to build scalable, secure, and business-aligned cloud solutions.
  
  

* Role: AWS Cloud Solution Architect
* Location: Pune
* Experience: Between 12 to 15 Years

* Mentor development and cloud engineering teams to promote best practices, reusable patterns, and engineering excellence.

**Expertise You'll Bring**

* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.

* Experience with cloud migration, modernization, and transformation programs.

* Experience leading architecture reviews, technical assessments, proof-of-concepts, and design governance activities.
* Expertise in stakeholder management, technical leadership, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.

* Experience driving continuous improvement and engineering quality initiatives.

**Benefits**

* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment**
Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.
  
  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.

1cc3abc0.title: Solutions Architect, ISV
1cc3abc0.description:
**Description**
AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
  
  
Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
  
  
AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud-based solutions.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
  
  
Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
  
  
You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
  
  
As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
  
  
To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
  
  
Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9).
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
  
  
**About The Team**
ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
* 4+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
* Can create proof of concepts, demos, and/or scripts from scratch or leveraging reusable components.
* Able to create technical content that is easily adopted and reusable by others.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS, or experience implementing a cloud-based technology solution
* Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Cloud Technology Certification
* Able to present to technical and business audiences (training, workshops, publications)
* 4 years’ experience as a Solution Architect or related role.

**Job Title: Cloud Engineering Manager – API**
**Job Summary:**
We are seeking a highly experienced Cloud Engineering Manager – API, Full Stack & AI/ML with 12+ years of strong experience in cloud engineering, enterprise application development, API-led architecture, Full Stack development, and AI/ML solution delivery across multi-cloud environments. The role focuses on leading the design, development, and modernization of cloud-native applications, enterprise API ecosystems, and AI-powered business solutions to drive digital transformation, innovation, and operational excellence for enterprise clients.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise combined with strong consulting and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to lead large engineering teams, define technology roadmaps, drive AI/ML adoption, and deliver scalable cloud and API solutions across complex enterprise landscapes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the architecture, design, development, and modernization of cloud-native applications, enterprise API platforms, and AI-powered solutions across Azure, AWS, and GCP environments.
* Define and execute API-first, cloud-native, and platform engineering strategies aligned with enterprise digital transformation objectives.

* Strong competency in enterprise API design, development, integration, lifecycle management, security, and governance using API Management platforms.
* Drive implementation of enterprise integration solutions leveraging REST APIs, GraphQL, event streaming, and hybrid cloud integration patterns.
* Lead development and operationalization of AI/ML, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG architectures, AI Agents, and intelligent automation solutions.
* Collaborate with data science, cloud, platform, and business teams to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications and business processes.

* Drive cloud application modernization initiatives utilizing Kubernetes, Containers, DevSecOps, Platform Engineering, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Lead Proof of Concepts (PoCs), innovation initiatives, solution accelerators, and technology assessments for Cloud, API, and AI transformation programs.
* Develop business cases, executive dashboards, technology roadmaps, and solution recommendations for client engagements.
* Collaborate with Architecture, Security, Data, DevOps, and Platform teams to align technology initiatives with enterprise governance and operational objectives.
* Support pre-sales opportunities, solutioning workshops, RFP responses, technical proposals, and strategic consulting engagements.

**Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, Enterprise Application Development, API Engineering, Full Stack Development, and Technology Delivery.
* 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, architecture programs, and large-scale cloud transformation initiatives.
* Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture principles including microservices, serverless computing, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems.
* Proven expertise in API strategy, API governance, integration architecture, and enterprise modernization initiatives.
* Strong experience leading AI/ML and Generative AI solution development and enterprise adoption programs.
* Experience working in client-facing consulting, advisory, or enterprise transformation roles.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, application security, governance, compliance, DevSecOps, and operational excellence practices.
* Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Master’s degree preferred.

**Technical Expertise:**

* Strong expertise in Cloud Platforms including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Deep hands-on experience in Python, FastAPI, Flask, Django, and backend service development.
* Strong Full Stack development expertise using React.js, Angular, Node.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
* Strong competency in designing and implementing REST APIs, GraphQL services, Microservices, and Enterprise Integration frameworks.
* Experience with API Management platforms including Apigee, Kong, Azure API Management, MuleSoft, or equivalent solutions.
* Strong knowledge of Event-Driven Architecture, Kafka, RabbitMQ, and enterprise messaging platforms.
* Proven expertise in AI/ML technologies including Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, and MLOps.
* Strong competency in developing solutions using LLMs, RAG Architectures, AI Agents, Prompt Engineering, Embeddings, and Vector Databases.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration platforms including Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.
* Strong competency in DevSecOps, CI/CD, GitOps, Platform Engineering, and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and ArgoCD.
* Experience with relational, NoSQL, and vector databases including PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Cosmos DB, Redis, Pinecone, ChromaDB, and FAISS.
