bf66839c.title: Technical Solutions Consultant
bf66839c.description:
**Tier 2 Technical Solutions Consultant**
*GCC India | TreadNet and B2B Platform Support*
**Position Summary**
The Tier 2 Technical Solutions Consultant provides advanced customer and technical support for TreadNet and related B2B platforms. Based in the Bridgestone GCC India office, this role serves internal users and external customers across the United States and Canada, resolving complex access, functional, and technical issues that cannot be resolved through Tier 1 support. The consultant combines strong troubleshooting capability with clear, professional customer communication and owns issues through resolution or appropriate escalation.
  
  
This role is customer-facing and requires confident verbal and written English communication, including the ability to lead calls, communicate technical issues in business-friendly language, and build trust with U.S.-based customers and stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide high-quality Tier 2 support to internal users and external B2B customers across the United States and Canada.
* Investigate, diagnose, and resolve escalated issues involving TreadNet, supporting systems, user access, browser behavior, integrations, and functional workflows.
* Support user provisioning and access management in accordance with established user-management controls and procedures.
* Engage customers by phone, email, chat, and video conference to gather details, troubleshoot issues, communicate status, and confirm resolution.
* Provide technical assistance for common issues, including password resets, browser and cache clearing, account access, and basic platform navigation.
* Provide user guidance and basic training on TreadNet and supporting-system functionality.
* Follow established Incident Management, Problem Management, knowledge-management, and escalation processes.
* Document incidents accurately, including issue details, troubleshooting performed, customer communication, root cause where known, and resolution steps.
* Escalate unresolved or high-impact issues to Tier 3, Product, Engineering, Platform, or vendor teams; track progress through closure and keep customers informed.
* Identify recurring incident patterns, customer pain points, and enhancement opportunities; document and route feedback through established processes.
* Contribute to and maintain support guides, knowledge articles, troubleshooting playbooks, user instructions, and training materials.
* Participate in support triage, operational reviews, and continuous-improvement activities to improve service quality, resolution time, and customer experience.
* Maintain awareness of service-level expectations and support team metrics, including response time, resolution time, ticket quality, and backlog aging.

**Shift Coverage and Work Schedule**
The Tier 2 GCC India support team will provide coverage for the U.S. business day from 6:00 AM Central Time through 8:00 PM Central Time (UTC -6). Coverage will be split between two consultants, with planned overlap to support handoffs, triage, collaboration, and peak customer demand. Candidates must be willing and able to work assigned India-based shifts that align to this U.S. coverage window, including overlap hours as required.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* At least 4 years of experience in technical support, application support, service desk, customer support, or a related technology-support role.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to engage professionally and confidently with U.S.-based customers and stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot issues methodically, ask effective diagnostic questions, and explain solutions clearly to technical and non-technical users.
* Experience managing incidents and escalations through ticketing systems and following issues through to resolution.
* Strong analytical, diagnostic, problem-solving, time-management, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, customer-focused, deadline-oriented environment.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively within a distributed team.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; ability to create clear support documentation.
* Ability to receive feedback constructively and apply it to improve individual and team performance.
* Willingness to work the assigned shift schedule supporting North American business hours.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting B2B commerce, customer portals, order-management, pricing, billing, or dealer/fleet-facing platforms.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Freshdesk, Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar ticketing and support delivery tools.
* Experience supporting users in the automotive, transportation, retail, distribution, or service industries.
* Knowledge of ITIL practices, including incident, problem, change, and knowledge management.
* Experience working with U.S.-based customers or global, cross-cultural teams.

**Core Competencies**

* Customer-first mindset and ownership through resolution
* Clear and concise written and verbal communication
* Technical curiosity and structured problem solving
* Professionalism, empathy, and sound judgment during escalations
* Collaboration across support, product, engineering, and business teams
* Attention to detail and disciplined documentation
* Adaptability and continuous-improvement mindset

0bd212c7.title: Service Delivery Manager
0bd212c7.description:
Work Your Magic with us!
  
  
Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
  
  
**Service Delivery Manager**
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Service Delivery Manager is responsible for establishing, operating, and continuously improving Service Level Management for the assigned SAP and ERP application services. The role ensures reliable service delivery, effective lifecycle management, compliance, security, and ongoing alignment with business requirements.
  
  
The incumbent will work closely with business stakeholders, internal technology teams, SAP functional teams, infrastructure teams, and external service providers to design sustainable solutions, manage service performance, and drive continuous improvement across the SAP application landscape. The role includes ownership of service governance, vendor performance, service reporting, incident and problem management, application lifecycle management, and operational readiness.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**SAP Application and Functional Service Management**

* Manage the end-to-end service delivery of SAP applications and related ERP services.
* Work with business stakeholders and SAP functional teams to understand business requirements, service expectations, and improvement opportunities.
* Ensure that SAP services are designed, transitioned, operated, and retired in line with established service management processes.
* Coordinate SAP application enhancements, releases, upgrades, maintenance activities, and improvement initiatives.
* Ensure appropriate integration between SAP applications and connected systems, platforms, and business processes.
* Support the successful transition of new or enhanced SAP solutions into production with minimal business disruption.
* Ensure operational readiness, including support documentation, monitoring, knowledge transfer, support models, and formal handover.
* Monitor application availability, performance, capacity, stability, adoption, and user satisfaction.

**Service Level and Performance Management**

* Establish and manage Service Level Agreements, Operational Level Agreements, and related service targets.
* Define meaningful service performance indicators and ensure that agreed KPIs are measured and reported consistently.
* Lead periodic service reviews with business stakeholders, internal teams, and strategic service providers.
* Prepare and deliver service performance reports, management dashboards, annual service reviews, and improvement plans.
* Identify service gaps, agree corrective actions, and track improvement initiatives through to completion.
* Ensure that service-related information is maintained accurately in relevant repositories and IT service management tools, such as ServiceNow, CMDB, monitoring platforms, and reporting solutions.
* Drive consistent implementation of the service management framework across the assigned SAP service portfolio.

**Incident, Problem, and Change Management**

* Ensure effective management of major incidents, recurring incidents, problems, and service requests.
* Coordinate root-cause analysis, corrective actions, preventive actions, and post-incident reviews.
* Track application outages, downtime, service interruptions, and business impact.
* Ensure that changes to SAP applications are assessed, approved, communicated, tested, and implemented in accordance with change management procedures.
* Work with relevant teams to reduce recurring incidents and improve service stability.
* Support automation and process optimisation opportunities across service management and SAP operations.

**Vendor and Partner Management**

* Manage the operational performance of SAP service providers and strategic partners.
* Review vendor performance against agreed SLAs, KPIs, quality targets, and contractual obligations.
* Ensure timely delivery of service reports, improvement plans, corrective actions, and annual service reviews.
* Facilitate governance meetings and maintain clear escalation and communication paths.
* Ensure that suppliers meet applicable security, quality, compliance, and service management expectations.

**Compliance, Risk, and Business Continuity**

* Ensure that SAP services comply with applicable internal policies and external requirements, including security, vulnerability management, data protection, licensing, GxP, and GDPR obligations, where relevant.
* Support risk identification, mitigation planning, audit readiness, and compliance reporting.
* Develop and maintain Disaster Recovery and business continuity plans for the assigned SAP applications.
* Plan, coordinate, and document Disaster Recovery tests and follow up on identified actions.
* Ensure that service operations support business continuity and minimise disruption to critical business processes.

**SAP Functional Background**
A good understanding of SAP functional processes and the ability to collaborate effectively with SAP business process owners and functional consultants is required.
  
  
Experience in
**two or more of the following SAP functional modules**
will be considered an added advantage:
  
  

* SAP FI – Financial Accounting
* SAP CO – Controlling
* SAP MM – Materials Management
* SAP SD – Sales and Distribution
* SAP PP – Production Planning
* SAP PM – Plant Maintenance
* SAP QM – Quality Management
* SAP PS – Project System
* SAP WM / EWM – Warehouse Management / Extended Warehouse Management
* SAP Ariba – Procurement and Supplier Management

**Education And Professional Experience**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in software services, application management, ERP operations, or IT service delivery.
* At least 5 years of experience working in an international or globally distributed environment.
* Experience managing SAP applications, enterprise platforms, or complex business-critical application services.
* Strong experience working with internal stakeholders, business teams, technology functions, and external service providers.
* Fluency in written and spoken English is mandatory.
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience is required.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of IT service management principles, particularly Service Level Management, Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Capacity Management, and Service Continuity Management.
* Practical understanding of SAP application landscapes, functional processes, integrations, and operational dependencies.
* Ability to translate business requirements into sustainable service and application management solutions.
* Strong capability to develop concepts, establish governance models, and drive pragmatic implementation.
* Experience with service performance management, KPI frameworks, dashboards, and reporting solutions.
* Familiarity with ITSM tools, CMDBs, monitoring solutions, ticketing systems, and service repositories.
* Strong vendor management, negotiation, escalation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good understanding of information security, risk management, data protection, quality standards, and regulatory compliance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical, organisational, and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex, international, and matrixed environment.
* Proactive approach to automation, standardisation, service improvement, and operational excellence.

**What we offer:**
We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
  
  
Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

ae31cb4e.title: Service Delivery Manager - HR Service Desk
ae31cb4e.description:
**BUREAU VERITAS | HR SHARED SERVICES HUB, NOIDA**

**Service Delivery Manager – HR Service Desk**

*Global Process Owner, HR Service Desk & Case Management (Q2R)*

**Tower**

Query to Resolution (Q2R)

  

**Location**

Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

  

**Reports to**

HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

  

**Role type**

People manager

  

**Scope**

Multi-channel HR contact centre (Tier 0–2), case management, knowledge management and employee self-service

  

**Grade**

**ABOUT THE HUB**

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You own the front door of HR. You will turn country help desks, shared inboxes and informal routes into one tiered, multilingual service desk. Employees will get fast, accurate answers, and every query will be tracked, measured and used to improve how HR works.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Map each country's current query channels, volumes, query types and resolution paths, and set the baseline.
* Design the Q2R tiered model: Tier 0 self-service and chatbot, Tier 1 hub desk, Tier 2 hub specialists, and Tier 3 CoE or country HR, with clear handoff rules.
* Set up the service desk for each transition wave, covering language coverage, time-zone rostering, channel setup and routing rules.
* Build the knowledge base before each go-live so that every in-scope query type has approved content from day one.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Act as Global Process Owner for Q2R. Own case categorisation, priority and SLA matrices, and escalation paths.
* Own the central knowledge base and keep it current. Target 95%+ coverage of Tier 1 queries and track content accuracy.
* Run weekly triage and trend reviews with HR business partners and GPOs. Turn repeat queries into process fixes in other towers.
* Plan workforce needs using volume forecasting and real-time management to meet service levels.
* Handle sensitive and VIP cases with discretion. Apply clear routing for ER, grievance and wellbeing matters.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Run a quality assurance framework covering random case audits, calibration sessions, customer-feedback sampling and SLA scoring.
* Enforce data-privacy controls on case content, access and retention.
* Maintain a service catalogue and SLA agreements with each receiving country and CoE.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Increase self-service and chatbot deflection through better content and design.
* Use case and sentiment analytics to find the top drivers of contact and remove them at source.
* Deploy generative-AI agent assist and knowledge tools, with human quality control.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: tier model, service catalogue, and case taxonomy with SLA matrix signed off.
* By go-live: service desk live for the first wave, with the knowledge base and QA framework running.
* Within 12–18 months: rising self-service deflection, FCR and CSAT at target, and falling repeat contacts.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

**KPI**

**Indicative target**

  

**First contact resolution**

* 75% at Tier 1

  

**Employee CSAT**

* 4.3 / 5

  

**SLA adherence (response and resolution)**

* 95%

  

**Self-service / chatbot deflection**

Increased quarter on quarter

  

**Knowledge base coverage**

* 95% of Tier 1 query types

  

**QA score**

* 90%

  

**Repeat contact rate**

Reduced against baseline

*Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.*

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* HR service delivery and case management platforms (ServiceNow HRSD, Salesforce, Workday Help or similar, preferably Zendesk).
* Knowledge management covering content governance, article lifecycle and search optimisation.
* Contact-centre operations, including workforce management, forecasting, real-time management and multi-channel routing.
* ITIL v4 service management practices.
* Quality assurance and speech/text analytics.
* Conversational AI and chatbot design.

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

Customer-centric leadership • Builds teams from zero • Drives change and adoption • Sound judgement under pressure • Influences without authority across countries • Data-led decision making • Coaches and develops talent • Holds a high bar on control

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

**Essential**

* 15+ years in HR or employee services, including 7+ years leading a multi-country HR service desk.
* Has set up or transitioned an HR contact centre into shared services.
* Has led multilingual, multi-time-zone service operations.
* Master's degree in HR, Business or a related field.

**Preferred**

* ITIL v4 Foundation or higher
* COPC or similar contact-centre certification
* Experience implementing Zendesk HRSD

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**

Hub Director, other tower GPOs, HR business partners, CoEs, country HR, HR technology team, employee representatives where relevant.

Year-on-year reduction

No high-rated findings

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

**Essential**

* 15+ years in HR, including 7+ years leading HR administration in shared services.

Hub Director, R2P and R2H GPOs, HR business partners, country HR, HRIS team, Legal and Data Privacy, IT.

Recruit to Hire (R2H)

  

**Location**

Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

  

**Reports to**

HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

  

**Role type**

People manager

  

**Scope**

Requisition management, sourcing support, interview scheduling, offer management, pre-employment checks and onboarding

As per BV grading framework

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You own the recruitment and onboarding engine for every country moving into Noida. You will replace fragmented local practices with one standard, compliant and fast hiring process. Hiring managers should get the talent they need quickly, and every candidate should get a consistent, high-quality experience.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Map current recruitment and onboarding practice in each country, including steps, tools, vendors, volumes and cycle times, and set the baseline.
* Design the R2H target operating model. Define what moves to the hub, what stays with in-country recruiters and business partners, and what goes to vendors or RPO partners.
* Lead country-by-country transition, covering knowledge transfer, template and offer-letter harmonisation, and stabilisation after cutover.
* Set up the hub's scheduling, offer and onboarding desks, with capacity models tied to hiring forecasts.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Act as Global Process Owner for R2H. Own the standard process from requisition to day one, including approval rules and local variations.
* Manage recruitment and background-check vendors across markets. Scorecard them on time-to-fill, quality of hire, diversity and cost.
* Map the candidate journey from end to end, remove friction points, and lift offer acceptance and employer-brand scores.
* Deliver a consistent onboarding experience. New joiners should have their systems, equipment and paperwork ready on day one.
* Act as the escalation point for hiring managers and TA partners on service issues.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Work with Legal, Compliance and country HR to keep every step compliant with local labour law, right-to-work rules and data privacy law.
* Own controls over offer approvals, compensation within band, and the retention and deletion of candidate data.
* Embed BV's DEI standards in sourcing, shortlisting and vendor contracts, and report on them regularly.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Drive full ATS adoption and automate scheduling, offer generation and e-signature.
* Introduce AI-enabled tools for screening and scheduling, with fairness and privacy safeguards.
* Use funnel analytics to find where time is lost, and fix causes at their source.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: TA baseline, R2H operating model and vendor strategy agreed.
* By go-live: scheduling, offer and onboarding desks live for the first wave of countries.
* Within 12–18 months: measurable cuts in time-to-hire and higher candidate NPS across the regions in scope.

**KPI**

**Indicative target**

  

**Time to offer / time to fill**

Reduced against the country baseline

  

**Offer TAT**

* 95%

  

**Candidate NPS**

* +40

  

**Hiring manager satisfaction**

* 4.3 / 5

  

**Day-one readiness**

* 98% of joiners fully set up

  

**Vendor SLA adherence**

* 95%

  

**Cost per hire**

Reduced against baseline

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* End-to-end recruitment operations at volume, including high-volume and multi-country hiring.
* Management of recruitment vendors, RPO partners and background-screening providers.
* ATS and onboarding platforms (Workday Recruiting, SuccessFactors RCM/ONB, iCIMS or similar).
* Candidate experience design, journey mapping and employer-brand metrics.
* Recruitment compliance covering labour law, right to work and GDPR for candidate data.
* Recruitment analytics and capacity forecasting.

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

Customer-centric leadership • Builds teams from zero • Drives change and adoption • Sound judgement under pressure • Influences without authority across countries • Data-led decision making • Coaches and develops talent • Holds a high bar on control

**Essential**

* 15+ years in HR, including 8+ years leading talent acquisition operations.
* Has led a TA transition into shared services or an RPO model.
* Has managed hiring volumes of 3,000+ per year across several countries.
* Master's degree in HR, Business or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Experience in the testing, inspection and certification (TIC), engineering or professional services sectors
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt
* Experience deploying AI recruitment tools

Hub Director, Global TA leadership, hiring managers, country HR, Legal and Compliance, recruitment and screening vendors, IT.

Reward to Pay (R2P)

Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

People manager

Multi-country payroll, benefits administration, compensation changes, payroll accounting and tax filings

  

**Grade**

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You own payroll and reward delivery end to end for every country moving into Noida. You will move payroll from dozens of local vendors and in-country teams to a controlled, consolidated model. Employees must be paid accurately and on time, in every cycle and in every country, throughout the transition and after it.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Lead the payroll transition roadmap country by country, sequenced by risk, complexity, headcount and vendor contract dates.
* Run knowledge transfer from country payroll teams and vendors. This covers desk procedures, statutory calendars, pay elements and local exceptions.
* Plan and run parallel payroll runs for each country. Set clear go/no-go criteria based on variance thresholds, and use hypercare after cutover.
* Deliver the global payroll vendor consolidation programme. Rationalise the vendor portfolio, support selection, and manage exit and onboarding without disrupting pay.
* Design the target operating model for R2P, covering the split of work between hub, vendor and country HR, with RACI, handoffs and cut-off calendars.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Act as Global Process Owner for R2P. Own process standards, the global pay calendar, the design of allowed variations, and change control.
* Deliver zero critical payroll errors per cycle through pre-payroll reconciliations, input validation, dual approval and post-pay checks.
* Monitor data flows between the HRIS, time-and-attendance, payroll engines and the general ledger. Resolve interface breaks before cut-off.
* Manage payroll vendors against contractual SLAs, with monthly scorecards, quarterly business reviews and service credits where needed.
* Act as the escalation point for pay issues. Run root-cause analysis on every off-cycle payment and track the fix through to closure.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Build and maintain the R2P control framework, including key controls, segregation of duties, access reviews and evidence standards.
* Lead annual and ad-hoc audit readiness with Internal Audit, Tax and Finance. Close findings within the agreed timelines.
* Track statutory and regulatory change in every in-scope country. Implement change before its effective date.
* Protect employee pay data in line with GDPR and local privacy law.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Standardise pay elements and processes across countries. Reduce local exceptions to the minimum required by law.
* Automate reconciliations, variance analysis and exception reporting using RPA and analytics.
* Drive employee self-service for payslips, tax documents and pay queries to reduce inbound contacts.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.

* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: R2P operating model, country wave plan and control framework signed off.
* By go-live: first wave of countries live in Noida after successful parallel runs.
* Within 12–18 months: vendor consolidation on track, zero critical errors sustained, and a clean audit outcome.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

**KPI**

**Indicative target**

  

**Payroll accuracy**

* 99.5% of payslips error-free; zero critical errors

  

**On-time payment**

100% of payrolls paid on the scheduled date

  

**Off-cycle payments**

Reduced quarter on quarter; every case root-caused

  

**Statutory compliance**

Zero penalties; 100% filings on time

  

**Vendor SLA adherence**

* 98% against contracted SLAs

  

**Cost per payslip**

Year-on-year reduction against baseline

  

**Audit outcome**

No high-rated findings

* Deep multi-country payroll expertise covering gross-to-net, statutory deductions, tax and social security, and year-end.
* Payroll vendor and aggregator management (for example ADP, Ramco, Alight, or in-country providers), including contract and SLA governance.
* Payroll controls, SOX-style frameworks and audit management.
* Integration of HRIS (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors) with time and payroll systems, including interface monitoring.
* Payroll accounting, GL reconciliation and working knowledge of benefits administration.
* Parallel-run design, cutover planning and hypercare.

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

Customer-centric leadership • Builds teams from zero • Drives change and adoption • Sound judgement under pressure • Influences without authority across countries • Data-led decision making • Coaches and develops talent • Holds a high bar on control

**Essential**

* 15+ years in HR operations, including 8+ years leading multi-country payroll.
* Has led at least one payroll transition or vendor consolidation into a shared services centre.
* Has run payroll for 10,000+ employees across several jurisdictions.
* Master's degree in HR, Finance, Business or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Payroll certification (CPP, FPC, CIPP or equivalent)
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or above
* Experience across Europe, Middle East, Africa or APAC payroll

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**

Hub Director, Global Reward and Payroll leadership, Finance and Tax, Internal Audit, country HR leads, payroll vendors, HRIS team.

Closed within agreed timelines

350f2363.title: Sr. Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI
350f2363.description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise-level customers.
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
  
  
Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
* Bachelor's degree in STEM field
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
* Experience in leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of delivering customer engagements in a professional services role experience
* active project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2)
* AWS certification
* Experience in delivering customer engagements in a professional services role
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

What You Must Have

What Sets You Apart

0adeef54.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Ordering
0adeef54.description:
**Description**
It’s no secret that Amazon relies on its technology to deliver millions of packages every day to its customers – on time, with low cost. We build the complex software solutions that work across our vendors, warehouses and carriers to optimize both the time and cost of getting packages delivered. Our products and services already handle thousands of requests per second, make business decisions impacting billions of dollars a year, integrate with a network of small and large carriers worldwide, manage business rules for millions of unique products, and improve the ordering and delivery experience for millions of online shoppers.
  
  
We are looking for a Sr. Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our growing team! This position requires influencing across multiple teams, businesses, and senior leaders. The role requires a deep understanding of customer needs and thinking big about how we can make the purchase experience across online retail seamless and delightful. The ideal candidate is excited by technology, passionate about learning, must think big, translate complex technical concepts into actionable solutions, lead cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact prototypes, and maintain regular stakeholder communications through structured reporting and updates.
  
  
You will need to be entrepreneurial, and work in a highly collaborative environment. You have a track record of exceptional performance and love working in a dynamic, ambiguous, fast-paced environment in which managing multiple projects and priorities is the norm. You dive deep and like the complexity of systems but drive simple, innovative solutions for customer-facing experiences. You have excellent judgment and high standards. You are an articulate, persuasive communicator and a good writer. People trust and respect you and they like to work with you. You are eager to pioneer new experiences, putting the customer first and challenging conventional wisdom.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Drive the SDLC process end-to-end through structured mechanisms from ideation to launch of product features and post launch tracking of adoption and business metrics improvements
* Collaborate with wider stakeholders to identify customer pain points and influence the product and delivery roadmap to address the same.
* Inspect & adapt the delivery processes to bring continuous improvements in quality and speed.
* Share knowledge and best practices within and across SWA teams
* Driving technical programs related to invoicing/billing customers for the logistics services that Amazon Shipping provides to them, and the subsequent process around the collection management of the payments received from our customers will be one of the key area of responsibility

**About The Team**
Ordering stands at the heart of Amazon retail, guiding the journey from purchase to delivery to resolution. We started Ordering India site in 2025 and we are growing this team incrementally. This team will play a pivotal role in evolution of Ordering charter. Our team works on large programs cutting across multiple partner teams, production-scale systems handling billions of transactions across all Amazon worldwise marketplaces, coming up with innovative designs to help continuously make our platform ready for our current and future challenges.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
* Experience in FinTech domain with UPI, digital wallets, cards , driving programs involving Billing and Payment flows (Accounts Payable, Account Receivable) and having interface with accounting, tax systems, Ledger systems, is highly desired

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

5e105780.title: Technical Program Manager, AI & Cloud Efficiency
5e105780.description:
**About Glean**
Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.
  
  
At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
  
  
Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
  
  
If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.
  
  
**About The Role**
Glean is looking for a Technical Program Manager, AI & Cloud Efficiency to provide end-to-end oversight of these initiatives: maintain the portfolio, set priorities, drive the operating cadence, unblock owners, and ensure savings land. Glean delivers AI at enterprise scale across a deliberately open, provider-neutral stack. This breadth necessitates numerous efficiency initiatives running in parallel across engineering — token yield, compute right-sizing, LLM Gateway quotas, provider commitments to name a few.
  
  
**You Will**

* Drive Cloud and AI/LLM efficiency
* Own a single, prioritised source of truth for all cost initiatives and drive them to measurable efficiency and margin gains.
* Pressure-test savings claims: verify realised vs. projected savings post-launch, and prevent silent cost regressions from eroding prior wins
* Build cost-attribution discipline: per-service, per-team, per-customer, per-feature tagging and allocation so every dollar has an owner
* Oversee LLM spend across providers: procurement and commitment sizing
* Govern internal AI tooling spend with per-user visibility, quotas, and value assessment
* Build the observability & automation layer
* Treat cost like production telemetry: real-time cost attribution, anomaly detection, alerting, and automated triage
* Automate the toil: cost-triage agents, regression detection, and self-serve attribution so the program scales

**About You**

* Deep, hands-on understanding of cloud infrastructure and AI/LLM economics
* Proficient in driving efficiency, capacity, or FinOps-adjacent programs
* Eng operations instincts: you think in SLOs, error budgets, telemetry, and postmortems, and you apply that discipline to spend
* Strong SQL and data skills; you can query BigQuery, build a Sigma workbook, and model a scenario

**Location:**

* This role is hybrid (3 days a week in our Bangalore office)

**Compensation & Benefits**
Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
  
  
We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.
  
  
**AI-First Mindset At Glean**
At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work.
**As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.**
Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

21d77d2e.title: Technical Program Manager
21d77d2e.description:
Position: Technical Program Manager  
  
Location: Remote  
  
Role Overview: We are looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager to drive the planning, coordination and successful delivery of complex technology programs across our AI-powered SaaS platforms in the RegTech, ESG, Sustainability, Compliance and Financial Reporting domains.  
  
The role requires a strong technical background combined with excellent program management, execution, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills. You will work closely with Engineering, DevOps and Business teams to translate product strategy into executable technical programs, manage dependencies, track milestones, mitigate risks and ensure predictable, high-quality delivery.  
  
You will serve as a bridge between business objectives and engineering execution, ensuring alignment across teams, visibility into program progress and timely resolution of technical and operational challenges. A solid understanding of modern software architecture, cloud infrastructure, APIs and AI/LLM-based applications is essential to effectively manage technically complex initiatives.  
  
Key Responsibilities:  
  
1. Technical Program Management & Delivery  
  
Own end-to-end planning, coordination, execution and delivery of multiple technical programs and cross-functional initiatives.  
Translate business requirements and product roadmaps into program plans, milestones, deliverables, timelines and measurable outcomes.  
Coordinate with Engineering, DevOps and other stakeholders to ensure alignment on scope, priorities, dependencies and delivery commitments.  
Establish program governance, execution tracking, reporting mechanisms and regular review cadences.  
Monitor program progress against timelines, budgets, scope, quality standards and business objectives.  
Identify delivery bottlenecks, proactively resolve blockers and drive decisions to keep programs on track.  
Manage scope changes, competing priorities, resource constraints and cross-team dependencies.  
Drive Agile/Scrum execution, sprint coordination, release planning and continuous improvement in delivery processes.  
2. Technical Leadership & Architecture Coordination  
  
Work closely with engineering leaders and architects to understand solution designs, technical dependencies, implementation approaches and delivery risks.  
Facilitate technical discussions, architecture reviews, design decisions and cross-team alignment.  
Evaluate technical trade-offs involving scalability, performance, security, maintainability, integration complexity and time to market.  
Ensure technical decisions align with product objectives, architectural standards and long-term platform strategy.  
Coordinate initiatives involving microservices, APIs, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, cloud infrastructure, data processing and enterprise integrations.  
Identify technical risks early and drive mitigation plans in collaboration with engineering teams.  
Provide technical guidance and challenge assumptions where required without becoming the primary owner of day-to-day coding or people management.  
3. AI, Automation & Innovation Programs  
  
Drive the planning and delivery of AI-powered product initiatives involving LLMs, generative AI, NLP and intelligent workflow automation.  
Coordinate implementation of AI capabilities such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), document intelligence, structured output generation, data extraction and automated validation.  
Work with engineering and product teams to define technical milestones, acceptance criteria, dependencies and success metrics for AI initiatives.  
Ensure AI implementations address accuracy, reliability, performance, data privacy, security, explainability and operational requirements.  
Track model and provider integrations, evaluation activities, deployment readiness and production adoption.  
Facilitate the evaluation and adoption of emerging technologies that improve product capabilities, engineering efficiency and business outcomes.  
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication  
  
Act as the primary coordination point between technical teams, product leadership, business stakeholders and senior management for assigned programs.  
Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, resource requirements and delivery forecasts through clear and actionable reporting.  
Set expectations with stakeholders regarding timelines, scope, technical constraints and trade-offs.  
Facilitate program reviews, steering meetings, retrospectives and escalation discussions.  
Ensure business requirements are translated into clear technical deliverables and that engineering outcomes meet stakeholder expectations.  
Drive alignment across distributed teams and ensure accountability for commitments and decisions.  
5. Risk, Quality & Release Management  
  
Maintain program-level risk, assumption, issue and dependency tracking, with clear ownership and mitigation plans.  
Establish appropriate quality gates, acceptance criteria, testing milestones and release-readiness processes.  
Coordinate integration testing, user acceptance testing, performance testing, security assessments and production releases.  
Track critical defects, technical debt, operational concerns and unresolved issues that may affect delivery or product reliability.  
Ensure delivery processes support security, compliance, auditability and enterprise customer requirements.  
Conduct post-release reviews and drive corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives.

  

6. Process Improvement & Program Metrics  
  
Define and track meaningful delivery metrics, including milestone adherence, predictability, lead time, defect trends, dependency resolution and release quality.  
Improve planning, estimation, prioritization, resource coordination and cross-team execution practices.  
Standardize program documentation, decision logs, status reporting and escalation processes.  
Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity, delivery efficiency and collaboration.  
Promote a culture of ownership, transparency, accountability and continuous improvement.  
Required Skills & Experience  
  
10+ years of overall experience in software development, technical delivery, engineering or technology program management.  
5+ years of experience managing complex technical projects or programs involving multiple teams and stakeholders.  
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, Agile/Scrum methodologies, release management and program governance.  
Proven track record of delivering complex technology initiatives within agreed timelines and quality expectations.  
Strong technical understanding of enterprise application architecture, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.  
Experience managing dependencies, risks, competing priorities, scope changes and stakeholder expectations.  
Excellent written and verbal communication, analytical thinking, decision-making and problem-solving skills.  
Ability to engage effectively with both senior business stakeholders and hands-on engineering teams.  
Experience working with remote or geographically distributed teams.  
Technical Knowledge  
  
The candidate should have a strong working understanding of the following technologies and concepts:  
  
Backend: Node.js, Python, Flask, and/or FastAPI.  
Frontend: Angular or React, TypeScript, HTML and CSS.  
Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Azure or equivalent cloud platforms.  
Containers & Deployment: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and Linux environments.  
Architecture: REST APIs, microservices, event-driven systems, multi-tenant SaaS and distributed applications.  
Data & Storage: Relational databases, data modeling, caching, object storage and data integration patterns.  
Engineering Practices: Version control, code review processes, automated testing, observability and production release management.  
Note: This position requires technical fluency to guide and coordinate engineering delivery; expert hands-on proficiency in every technology is not mandatory.  
  
Preferred Experience  
  
Experience in Enterprise SaaS, FinTech, RegTech, ESG, Sustainability, Compliance or Financial Reporting platforms.  
Experience delivering regulatory reporting, disclosure management, financial data processing or audit-focused software.  
Familiarity with XBRL, iXBRL, regulatory taxonomies, validation workflows or structured reporting standards.  
Experience managing multi-team programs involving complex integrations, large datasets and enterprise customer requirements.  
Experience coordinating cloud migrations, platform modernization, system integrations or architecture transformations.  
Familiarity with information security, data privacy, regulatory compliance and enterprise software delivery controls.  
AI & LLM Experience  
  
Experience managing or delivering AI-powered applications involving some of the following:  
  
Large Language Models (LLMs), NLP and generative AI.  
Prompt engineering and structured output generation.  
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and retrieval pipelines.  
LangChain and/or LlamaIndex.  
Vector databases such as FAISS, ChromaDB or Pinecone.  
Embeddings, semantic search and document intelligence.  
AI model evaluation, accuracy measurement and quality assurance.  
Integration with managed AI services and model providers.  
AI security, privacy, governance and responsible deployment practices.  
Tools & Delivery Practices  
  
Experience with program and project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps or equivalent platforms.  
Proficiency in maintaining roadmaps, delivery plans, RAID logs, dependency trackers and executive status reports.  
Experience with Agile planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, release coordination and cross-functional governance.  
Ability to define measurable outcomes and use delivery metrics to improve execution predictability

As part of the sales team, a Solution Advisor is the “subject matter expert” responsible for the functional and technical knowledge within the sales cycle. A Solution Advisor provides deal support by participating in discovery sessions, executive meetings and presentations and delivers software demonstrations that help the customer understand SAP’s unique value proposition. In addition to deal support, the Solution Advisor participates in marketing events to generate demand, leads Design Thinking sessions, and collaborates with the broader sales team to identify whitespace opportunities at existing accounts.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
As a Solution Advisor within the SAP Next Gen - Academy for Customer Success, you will be responsible to:
  
  

* Successfully complete a 10-month program that strengthens the foundation for a successful customer-facing career at SAP.
* Participate in experiential learning opportunities with colleagues from all over the world and acquire a wide variety of business, industry and SAP solution skills while working with emerging and cutting-edge technologies.
* Receive on-the-job training under the mentorship of a senior Solution Advisor colleague while working with our customers to gain real world experience and acquire the skills necessary to help guide our customers through their Digital Transformation journey.

The program will enrich your knowledge of SAP and give you the professional experience to serve our customers. We offer full-time employment from day one with practical learning applications for your role. After successful completion of the program, you are expected to lead customer discovery sessions and survey activities to uncover business challenges and opportunities for innovation. You will create and deliver high impact and engaging software demonstrations that compel the customers to select SAP over other competitive offerings. You will also provide demand generation support through marketing events and deal execution support by responding to request for proposals
  
  
**What You Bring**

* 2-3 years of professional experience with a strong foundation in technical and business processes, exposure to relevant technologies/solutions, and customer-facing skills.
* Technical and business process knowledge, combined with hands-on experience using relevant technologies and industry-standard tools to support solution delivery and operational efficiency.
* A cooperative and productive approach to working relationships, internally and externally.
* A strong ability to quickly learn new concepts, adapt to changing environments, and apply knowledge to deliver results.
* An understanding of AI fundamentals, uses, and ethics, to identify business problems solvable with AI.
* Strong Business Acumen, including demonstrated knowledge of business processes and/or industries.
* Proficiency in English to engage with our global network.
* AI focus areas: (AI Adoption Mindset, Agentic AI Day-to Day Practice, and Context Engineering)
* A curious and agile mindset, with a passion for learning and the resilience to adapt in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* Strong problem-solving, project management, and creative thinking skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and communicate ideas clearly and effectively.
* Emotional intelligence and cultural awareness that support inclusive teamwork and thoughtful stakeholder engagement.
* A growing foundation in business acumen and emerging technologies, especially artificial intelligence, paired with a results-oriented approach and the courage to take initiative.

The SAP Academy for Customer Success offers a three-year journey that drives accountability and enhances productivity. It enables graduates to make a quick impact in customer-facing roles while fostering career longevity and leadership potential.
  
  
Join us for a unique opportunity to build a global network, collaborate with customers to solve real business challenges, and gain hands-on experience with world-class cloud solutions — all while learning in a dynamic environment and earning competitive pay and benefits.

5634adda.title: Lead Solutions Architecture Engineer
5634adda.description:
Overview:

**Atlassian Architect**

Job Description

**Department:**

Business Technology – Atlassian Products

**Reports To:**

Manager, Atlassian Products

**Location:**

India – Bangalore (On-site)

**Level:**

Individual Contributor – Senior/Principal

**About HealthEdge**
====================

HealthEdge is a leading healthcare SaaS company delivering modern, cloud-native solutions that transform how health plans operate. With a global workforce spanning the US, India, Philippines, Mexico, and the UK, our Business Technology team powers the tools and platforms that keep HealthEdge running at scale. Atlassian – Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence – is the connective tissue of how work gets planned, tracked, and executed across the entire organization.

**Role Overview**
=================

The Atlassian Architect is the highest-level individual contributor on the Atlassian Products team, responsible for defining platform architecture, setting technical standards, and solving the most complex problems in HealthEdge's Atlassian environment. This is not an administration role – it is a design and engineering role. You will own the decisions that shape how the platform is built, governed, and extended, and your work will directly influence how thousands of employees across the company plan, collaborate, and deliver. As HealthEdge moves fully to Atlassian Cloud Enterprise, the Architect will also shape the platform's AI readiness — ensuring the architecture supports Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo at enterprise scale.

You will serve as the technical authority for the Atlassian Products team – providing architectural guidance, mentoring Senior and regular Administrators, leading complex solution delivery, and acting as the primary point of escalation for problems that require deep platform expertise. You will also own strategic initiatives including instance governance, automation frameworks, API integrations, and migration or consolidation efforts.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Platform Architecture & Standards**
-------------------------------------

* Own the Atlassian platform architecture across Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and Atlassian Access – defining how these tools are structured, governed, and extended at scale
* Establish and maintain technical standards for project design, workflow architecture, permission models, field configuration, and Confluence space taxonomy across the organization
* Design scalable, maintainable solutions that balance user needs with platform health – avoiding configuration sprawl and technical debt
* Evaluate new Atlassian capabilities, product roadmap changes, and Marketplace apps – assessing fit, risk, and adoption strategy
* Produce and maintain architectural documentation including design decisions, standards references, and solution blueprints

**Complex Solution Design & Delivery**
--------------------------------------

* Lead discovery and solution design for the most complex stakeholder requests – those that require cross-project thinking, advanced automation, or architectural changes
* Translate ambiguous business requirements from engineering, IT, product, and business functions into well-structured, scalable Atlassian solutions
* Deliver end-to-end implementation of high-complexity configurations, including multi-project workflow frameworks, advanced JSM service architectures, and cross-tool integrations
* Partner with the Manager, Atlassian Products to define and manage the platform improvement roadmap, sequencing initiatives by impact and feasibility

**Automation & Scripting**
--------------------------

* Design and implement advanced automation frameworks using native Jira/JSM automation and ScriptRunner (Groovy) for complex workflow logic, validators, post-functions, and listeners
* Build and maintain REST API integrations between Atlassian tools and external systems including identity platforms, ITSM tools, and business applications
* Establish automation standards and reusable patterns that the broader admin team can follow and extend
* Review and quality-assure automation and scripting work produced by Senior Administrators, providing technical guidance and improvement feedback

**Migrations & Consolidations**
-------------------------------

* Lead or architect Atlassian migration and consolidation projects, including instance-to-instance migrations, Server/Data Center to Cloud transitions, and post-merger platform integrations
* Perform pre-migration assessments including configuration audits, data mapping, and risk analysis
* Design migration runbooks and execute or oversee technical migration steps with appropriate rollback planning
* Ensure data integrity, permission continuity, and minimal disruption to end users throughout migration events

**Enterprise Governance & Security**
------------------------------------

* Own Atlassian Access configuration including SSO, SCIM provisioning, authentication policies, IP allowlisting, and audit log management
* Design and enforce the organization-wide governance model for Atlassian – covering project creation standards, permission scheme governance, license management, and app approval processes
* Lead license optimization efforts, identifying consolidation opportunities and ensuring spend is aligned with actual usage
* Support security and compliance requirements including access reviews, data residency considerations, and audit evidence related to Atlassian platforms
* Serve as the technical lead for any Atlassian-related security incidents, misconfigurations, or compliance findings

**Team Mentorship & Technical Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Serve as the informal technical lead for the Atlassian Products team – the person Senior and regular Administrators bring their hardest problems to
* Mentor Senior Administrators on advanced configuration, automation, and solution design, actively developing their technical depth
* Conduct technical design reviews for significant platform changes proposed by team members
* Contribute to hiring by participating in technical assessments for Atlassian Administrator and Senior Administrator candidates
* Represent the Atlassian Products team in cross-functional technical forums and architecture discussions

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

**Required**
------------

* 7+ years of deep, hands-on Atlassian platform experience with expert-level proficiency in Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing Atlassian architectures for large, complex organizations (thousands of users, dozens of teams)
* Expert-level proficiency in ScriptRunner (Groovy) scripting for advanced workflow customization, automation, and platform extensions
* Strong REST API experience with Atlassian platforms — building integrations, automating administrative tasks, and extending platform capabilities
* Proven experience leading Atlassian migrations or consolidation projects, including Cloud migrations
* Deep understanding of Atlassian Cloud security and governance including Atlassian Access, SSO/SCIM, and enterprise-scale permission management
* Ability to communicate architectural decisions clearly to both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

**Preferred**
-------------

* Atlassian certifications strongly preferred – ACP-120, ACP-420, ACP-620, or Atlassian Certified Expert (ACE) designation
* Familiarity with how Atlassian platform architecture affects AI indexing quality and Rovo answer relevance
* Experience with advanced Marketplace apps at architectural scale (Insight/Assets, Advanced Roadmaps, ScriptRunner, Elements Connect, Tempo)
* Exposure to enterprise ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and applying them within JSM at an architectural level
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and DevOps tooling that integrates with Atlassian (AWS, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines)
* Experience in a healthcare, SaaS, or other regulated industry environment
* Background in post-merger IT platform integration or multi-instance Atlassian consolidation

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within 90 days, you have completed a thorough assessment of the current Atlassian environment, identified the top architectural gaps and technical debt priorities, and established yourself as the go-to technical authority on the team. Within six months, you have delivered at least one significant platform improvement, established or formalized key governance standards, and are actively mentoring the admin team. Within a year, the Atlassian platform at HealthEdge reflects clear architectural ownership — well-governed, well-documented, and built to scale — and you have meaningfully elevated the technical capability of everyone around you.

**About the Team**
==================

You'll join a dedicated Atlassian Products team that is central to how HealthEdge operates at scale. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role for someone who wants to be the definitive technical expert on a platform that touches every part of the business. You'll have the backing of an engaged manager, a growing team of administrators to mentor, and a real mandate to shape how the platform evolves. If you want to do the most technically interesting Atlassian work of your career, this is that role.

**Geographic Responsibility: This position is located in Bangalore**
  
**Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent**  
**FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt**  
**Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:**

* **The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.**
* **Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.**
* **Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.**
* **May require travel dependent on company needs.**

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.*  
  
*HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.*

**Meet the Team**
The Customer Experience (CX) team is a group of extraordinary technical guides whose main focus is delivering a world-class customer experience by solving the toughest business challenges with network-centric solutions. We accelerate customer and partner success through ground breaking technology design, implementation, and optimization across a broad range of Cisco technologies. Our team collaborates closely with Cisco account teams, partners, and multi-functional groups to drive meaningful technology transitions and deliver real business outcomes. We are a high-performing, globally connected team with a strong culture of continuous learning, mentorship, and knowledge sharing. Our impact is validated through strong financial results, industry recognition, and some of the highest customer and employee satisfaction scores at Cisco.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Customer Delivery Architect, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, leading the strategy, design, and implementation of sophisticated Data Center and networking solutions that directly accelerate business outcomes. You will own end-to-end delivery of high-impact engagements, translating customer business requirements into scalable architectures while influencing technology transitions at the highest levels. Partner with Cisco account teams, partners, and multi-functional collaborators to align solution designs with customer goals, driving measurable success across pre-sales and delivery phases. Advisor to help customers in achieving business outcomes, operational, program, or service objectives. Act as the primary escalation point for sophisticated problem resolution, demonstrating deep technical expertise to resolve sophisticated issues across a broad range of technologies. Develop and contribute digital intellectual capital, repeatable delivery frameworks, and knowledge-sharing practices that elevate the entire consulting practice. Responsible for the creation and sharing of intellectual property (content, training) including digital intellectual property (e.g., scripts, software assets) in the most productive manner for various audiences, customers. Mentorship that brings positive impact to the CX technical communities.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Requires BS/BE/BTech degree or equivalent with 15+ years of experience in a similar job role.
* Experienced in customer-facing roles including pre-sales and/or service delivery roles.
* Any Data Center related certification(CCIE, CCNP VCP, etc.) with a strong drive for continuous learning.
* Inspiring leader who can showcase the value, Cisco solutions and services bring to Customer business and ensure adoption.
* Ability to develop high-level migration and delivery strategies, driving decisions and seeing it through execution effectively and in an efficient manner.
* Strong Nexus 2K/5K/7K/9K platform knowledge and experience.
* Experience in designing Data Center solutions from traditional DC standalone Nexus design to VXLAN Fabric-based SDN solutions demonstrating Single-Site Fabrics, ACI MultiPod & Multisite Fabric architectures.

* Knowledgeable and experience in cloud computing, building multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud solutions involving multiple cloud providers like AWS, Azure, Google.
* Knowledge on Python, Ansible etc.

* Familiar with virtualization and container environments (VMware, Microsoft, Cisco CVIM, RHOSP, Kubernetes) and have technical exposure in integrating ACI with virtualization platforms through VMM integration.
