4f451f03.title: Service Delivery Manager - Performance & Continuous Improvement
4f451f03.description:
**Service Delivery Manager Performance & Continuous Improvement**

*Intelligent Command Centre (ICC) & Transformation Lead all towers*

  

**Tower:** Cross-tower: Performance, Governance & Continuous Improvement

**Location:** Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

**Reports to:** HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

**Role type:** People manager

**Scope:** Intelligent Command Centre, SLA and KPI governance, continuous improvement portfolio, transition PMO support and hub quality management

  

**ABOUT THE HUB**

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

  

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You are the hub's performance and improvement engine. You will build the Intelligent Command Centre that gives leaders one real-time view of service health across every tower. You will also run the continuous improvement system that moves the hub from stable operations to best-in-class service.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Design the hub's performance framework: a KPI tree, SLA definitions, data sources and a reporting cadence shared by all towers.
* Capture and certify the pre-transition baselines for each country, so the hub can prove its value against the starting point.
* Support the transition PMO with readiness scorecards, go/no-go dashboards and hypercare tracking for every wave.
* Set up the Intelligent Command Centre, covering architecture, data pipelines, dashboards and alerting.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Run the ICC day to day, with real-time SLA, volume, backlog and escalation monitoring across R2P, R2H, Q2R and A2W.
* Lead the hub's governance rhythm: daily stand-ups, weekly tower reviews, monthly service reviews and quarterly business reviews with stakeholders.
* Own the hub-wide customer voice programme, including CSAT and NPS surveys, closing the loop with respondents, and reporting insight.
* Run hub-level capacity and productivity analytics to support resourcing decisions.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Own the hub quality management system, covering process documentation standards, internal quality audits and control testing across towers.
* Maintain the hub risk register and the tracking of issues and actions.
* Build data governance for performance reporting so that there is one version of the truth.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Build and govern the hub-wide continuous improvement backlog. Prioritise by value and effort, and agree ownership with each GPO.
* Lead improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma and process mining. Track benefits through to realised savings.
* Run the hub's automation and AI pipeline, from idea intake to business case, delivery and benefits tracking.
* Build a continuous improvement culture through training, recognition and a simple way for every employee to raise ideas.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: hub KPI framework, baseline method and ICC design signed off.
* By go-live: ICC live with real-time dashboards for the first transition wave, and the governance rhythm running.
* Within 1218 months: continuous improvement portfolio delivering measurable, validated benefits, with hub-wide dashboards trusted by global stakeholders.

  

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

**Hub-wide SLA adherence:**  95% across towers

**Validated CI benefits:** Annual savings and hours released against target

**Automation hours released:** Increased year on year

**Reporting timeliness and accuracy:** 100% on schedule

**Hub CSAT / NPS:** At or above target

**Audit and quality findings:** Closed within agreed timelines

**CI participation:** % of employees who submitted or delivered an improvement

*Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.*

  

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* Performance management and command-centre design for multi-tower shared services.
* Lean Six Sigma methods, including DMAIC, value-stream mapping and root-cause analysis.
* Data analytics and visualisation (Power BI or Tableau). SQL or data-modelling skills are an advantage.
* Process mining (Celonis, Signavio or similar) and automation pipeline management (RPA, AI).
* ITIL service level management and quality management systems.
* Benefits realisation and business case development.

  

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

* Customer-centric leadership
* Builds teams from zero
* Drives change and adoption
* Sound judgement under pressure
* Influences without authority across countries
* Data-led decision making
* Coaches and develops talent
* Holds a high bar on control

  

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

**Essential**

* 15+ years of experience, including 7+ years in shared services performance, excellence or transformation roles.
* Has built and run an ICC, command centre or equivalent governance function.
* Has deployed continuous improvement frameworks across multi-tower shared services centres.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt.
* Master's degree in Business, HR, Engineering or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Transition PMO experience
* Process mining certification
* Change management certification (Prosci or equivalent)

  

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**

Hub Director, all tower GPOs, Global HR leadership, HR technology and data teams, Finance, Internal Audit, transformation partners.

**Service Delivery Manager Payroll**

*Global Process Owner, Payroll & Reward Operations (R2P)*

  

**Tower:** Reward to Pay (R2P)

**Location:** Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

**Reports to:** HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

**Role type:** People manager

**Scope:** Multi-country payroll, benefits administration, compensation changes, payroll accounting and tax filings

  

**ABOUT THE HUB**

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

  

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You own payroll and reward delivery end to end for every country moving into Noida. You will move payroll from dozens of local vendors and in-country teams to a controlled, consolidated model. Employees must be paid accurately and on time, in every cycle and in every country, throughout the transition and after it.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Lead the payroll transition roadmap country by country, sequenced by risk, complexity, headcount and vendor contract dates.
* Run knowledge transfer from country payroll teams and vendors. This covers desk procedures, statutory calendars, pay elements and local exceptions.
* Plan and run parallel payroll runs for each country. Set clear go/no-go criteria based on variance thresholds, and use hypercare after cutover.
* Deliver the global payroll vendor consolidation programme. Rationalise the vendor portfolio, support selection, and manage exit and onboarding without disrupting pay.
* Design the target operating model for R2P, covering the split of work between hub, vendor and country HR, with RACI, handoffs and cut-off calendars.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Act as Global Process Owner for R2P. Own process standards, the global pay calendar, the design of allowed variations, and change control.
* Deliver zero critical payroll errors per cycle through pre-payroll reconciliations, input validation, dual approval and post-pay checks.
* Monitor data flows between the HRIS, time-and-attendance, payroll engines and the general ledger. Resolve interface breaks before cut-off.
* Manage payroll vendors against contractual SLAs, with monthly scorecards, quarterly business reviews and service credits where needed.
* Act as the escalation point for pay issues. Run root-cause analysis on every off-cycle payment and track the fix through to closure.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Build and maintain the R2P control framework, including key controls, segregation of duties, access reviews and evidence standards.
* Lead annual and ad-hoc audit readiness with Internal Audit, Tax and Finance. Close findings within the agreed timelines.
* Track statutory and regulatory change in every in-scope country. Implement change before its effective date.
* Protect employee pay data in line with GDPR and local privacy law.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Standardise pay elements and processes across countries. Reduce local exceptions to the minimum required by law.
* Automate reconciliations, variance analysis and exception reporting using RPA and analytics.
* Drive employee self-service for payslips, tax documents and pay queries to reduce inbound contacts.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: R2P operating model, country wave plan and control framework signed off.
* By go-live: first wave of countries live in Noida after successful parallel runs.
* Within 12–18 months: vendor consolidation on track, zero critical errors sustained, and a clean audit outcome.

  

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

**Indicative target**

**Payroll accuracy:**  99.5% of payslips error-free; zero critical errors

**On-time payment:** 100% of payrolls paid on the scheduled date

**Off-cycle payments:** Reduced quarter on quarter; every case root-caused

**Statutory compliance:** Zero penalties; 100% filings on time

**Vendor SLA adherence:**  98% against contracted SLAs

**Cost per payslip:** Year-on-year reduction against baseline

**Audit outcome:** No high-rated findings

  

*Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.*

  

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* Deep multi-country payroll expertise covering gross-to-net, statutory deductions, tax and social security, and year-end.
* Payroll vendor and aggregator management (for example ADP, Ramco, Alight, or in-country providers), including contract and SLA governance.
* Payroll controls, SOX-style frameworks and audit management.
* Integration of HRIS (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors) with time and payroll systems, including interface monitoring.
* Payroll accounting, GL reconciliation and working knowledge of benefits administration.
* Parallel-run design, cutover planning and hypercare.

  

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

* Builds teams from zero
* Customer-centric leadership
* Drives change and adoption
* Sound judgement under pressure
* Influences without authority across countries
* Data-led decision making
* Coaches and develops talent
* Holds a high bar on control

  

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

**Essential**

* 15+ years in HR operations, including 8+ years leading multi-country payroll.
* Has led at least one payroll transition or vendor consolidation into a shared services centre.
* Has run payroll for 10,000+ employees across several jurisdictions.
* Master's degree in HR, Finance, Business or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Payroll certification (CPP, FPC, CIPP or equivalent)
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or above
* Experience across Europe, Middle East, Africa or APAC payroll

  

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**

Hub Director, Global Reward and Payroll leadership, Finance and Tax, Internal Audit, country HR leads, payroll vendors, HRIS team, IT relevant.

b6005a51.title: Service Delivery Manager - HR Service Desk
b6005a51.description:
**Service Delivery Manager HR Service Desk**

*Global Process Owner, HR Service Desk & Case Management (Q2R)*

  

**Tower:** Query to Resolution (Q2R)

**Location:** Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

**Reports to:** HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

**Role type:** People manager

**Scope:** Multi-channel HR contact centre (Tier 02), case management, knowledge management and employee self-service

  

**ABOUT THE HUB**

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

  

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You own the front door of HR. You will turn country help desks, shared inboxes and informal routes into one-tiered, multilingual service desk. Employees will get fast, accurate answers, and every query will be tracked, measured and used to improve how HR works.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Map each country's current query channels, volumes, query types and resolution paths, and set the baseline.
* Design the Q2R tiered model: Tier 0 self-service and chatbot, Tier 1 hub desk, Tier 2 hub specialists, and Tier 3 CoE or country HR, with clear handoff rules.
* Set up the service desk for each transition wave, covering language coverage, time-zone rostering, channel setup and routing rules.
* Build the knowledge base before each go-live so that every in-scope query type has approved content from day one.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Act as Global Process Owner for Q2R. Own case categorisation, priority and SLA matrices, and escalation paths.
* Own the central knowledge base and keep it current. Target 95%+ coverage of Tier 1 queries and track content accuracy.
* Run weekly triage and trend reviews with HR business partners and GPOs. Turn repeat queries into process fixes in other towers.
* Plan workforce needs using volume forecasting and real-time management to meet service levels.
* Handle sensitive and VIP cases with discretion. Apply clear routing for ER, grievance and wellbeing matters.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Run a quality assurance framework covering random case audits, calibration sessions, customer-feedback sampling and SLA scoring.
* Enforce data-privacy controls on case content, access and retention.
* Maintain a service catalogue and SLA agreements with each receiving country and CoE.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Increase self-service and chatbot deflection through better content and design.
* Use case and sentiment analytics to find the top drivers of contact and remove them at source.
* Deploy generative-AI agent assist and knowledge tools, with human quality control.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: tier model, service catalogue, and case taxonomy with SLA matrix signed off.
* By go-live: service desk live for the first wave, with the knowledge base and QA framework running.
* Within 1218 months: rising self-service deflection, FCR and CSAT at target, and falling repeat contacts.

  

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

  

**First contact resolution:**  75% at Tier 1

**Employee CSAT:**  4.3 / 5

**SLA adherence (response and resolution):**  95%

**Self-service / chatbot deflection:** Increased quarter on quarter

**Knowledge base coverage:**  95% of Tier 1 query types

**QA score :**  90%

**Repeat contact rate** Reduced against baseline

  

*Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.*

  

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* HR service delivery and case management platforms (ServiceNow HRSD, Salesforce, Workday Help or similar, preferably Zendesk).
* Knowledge management covering content governance, article lifecycle and search optimisation.
* Contact-centre operations, including workforce management, forecasting, real-time management and multi-channel routing.
* ITIL v4 service management practices.
* Quality assurance and speech/text analytics.
* Conversational AI and chatbot design.

  

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

* Customer-centric leadership
* Builds teams from zero
* Drives change and adoption
* Sound judgement under pressure
* Influences without authority across countries
* Data-led decision making
* Coaches and develops talent
* Holds a high bar on control

  

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

**Essential**

* 15+ years in HR or employee services, including 7+ years leading a multi-country HR service desk.
* Has set up or transitioned an HR contact centre into shared services.
* Has led multilingual, multi-time-zone service operations.
* Master's degree in HR, Business or a related field.

**Preferred**

* ITIL v4 Foundation or higher
* COPC or similar contact-centre certification
* Experience implementing Zendesk HRSD

  

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**

Hub Director, other tower GPOs, HR business partners, CoEs, country HR, HR technology team, employee representatives where relevant.

40e836d3.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Position: GCP AI Senior Manager**
**Department: Technology Consulting, D&A**
**Title: AI Architect (GenAI)**
**Educational qualification: BTech/Masters/PhD**
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Manager – GenAI Architect with 14+ years of experience to own the end‑to‑end solution architecture of enterprise GenAI platforms. This role is heavily focused on solution design, PoC & MVP creation, architectural decision‑making, and production-grade implementation, while guiding teams and stakeholders from idea to scalable delivery.
  
  
You will act as the technical authority for GenAI, driving architectural excellence, evaluation strategies, and framework selection across enterprise use cases.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end‑to‑end GenAI solution architecture, covering ideation, feasibility analysis, PoC execution, MVP design, and production‑ready implementation.
* Lead solution design and architecture workshops, translating complex business problems into scalable and secure GenAI architectures.
* Design, implement, and validate PoCs and MVPs to assess technical feasibility, architectural choices, cost-performance trade‑offs, and enterprise fit.
* Define and standardize enterprise GenAI reference architectures for chatbots, copilots, analytics assistants, and workflow automation use cases.
* Architect advanced RAG pipelines, including chunking strategies, retrieval methods, embedding optimization, reranking, and grounding techniques.
* Drive prompt engineering standards across solutions, including system prompt design, instruction tuning, reasoning control, and consistency guidelines.
* Define and govern prompt evaluation frameworks, covering correctness, faithfulness, hallucination reduction, determinism, latency, cost efficiency, and regression management.
* Lead architectural decisions around Chain‑of‑Thought (CoT), structured reasoning, and explainability strategies.
* Architect and review agentic AI systems using LangChain, LangGraph, and custom orchestration layers, including multi‑agent coordination, tool usage, memory, routing, and fallback patterns.
* Own framework and technology evaluation, selecting appropriate GenAI frameworks based on scalability, reliability, observability, and enterprise constraints.
* Design scalable and secure FastAPI‑based service architectures to expose GenAI capabilities across enterprise platforms.
* Define enterprise security architecture, including JWT‑based authentication, authorization, data access controls, and LLM data protection.
* Lead AWS cloud architecture for GenAI workloads, ensuring scalability, reliability, cost optimization, and secure deployments.
* Architect and guide usage of DynamoDB, defining access patterns, performance optimization, and cost‑efficient designs.
* Define vector database architecture, embedding lifecycle management, similarity tuning, and retrieval performance optimization.
* Own LLM platform and model strategy, including evaluation and usage of AWS Bedrock and Azure OpenAI based on cost, latency, security, compliance, and roadmap alignment.
* Establish LLMOps practices, including prompt versioning, model versioning, evaluation pipelines, deployment strategies, monitoring, rollback mechanisms, and operational governance.
* Design observability and evaluation strategies for GenAI systems, covering logging, tracing, prompt metrics, retrieval metrics, agent behavior, and cost monitoring.
* Define and enforce guardrails and responsible AI practices to minimize hallucinations, prevent data leakage, and ensure compliant and safe GenAI behavior.
* Review and guide engineering teams through architecture reviews, PoC sign‑offs, MVP readiness, and production certification.
* Mentor senior engineers, architects, and managers on GenAI architecture, system design, and enterprise delivery best practices.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to leadership, providing clarity on feasibility, risks, timelines, and GenAI adoption strategy.

Mandatory Skills
  
  

* 14+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or AI platform design
* 5 years of GCP
* Strong expertise in Python Object‑Oriented Programming
* Deep hands‑on experience with RAG architectures, chunking strategies, retrieval optimization, CoT, and guardrails
* Advanced Prompt Engineering and prompt evaluation methodologies
* Strong experience with Agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph)
* Expertise in FastAPI and API‑led enterprise architecture
* Strong AWS architecture experience, including DynamoDB
* Secure system design using JWT authentication
* Deep understanding of vector databases and embedding optimization
* Hands‑on experience with AWS Bedrock and Azure OpenAI
* Strong knowledge of LLMOps, including evaluation pipelines, deployment, monitoring, versioning, and governance of GenAI systems

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with enterprise chatbot, copilot, or analytics‑driven GenAI platforms
* Exposure to compliance‑heavy or regulated enterprise environments
* Thought leadership in GenAI architecture, governance, or AI platform strategy
* Experience in Insurance domain

What we are looking for
  
  

* Strong architectural ownership with a builder’s mindset
* Proven ability to convert ambiguous ideas into working PoCs and MVPs
* Deep understanding of GenAI reliability, evaluation, and operationalization (LLMOps)
* Ability to balance innovation, cost, performance, and enterprise risk
* Strong stakeholder communication and technical influence
* Vision to scale GenAI solutions from experimentation to enterprise platforms

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

60dd2a73.title: Customer Success Manager - Marketing Cloud
60dd2a73.description:
**Description**
The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer's workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and advice to customer organizations.
  
  
The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and problems. The CSM serving Marketing Cloud customers acts as the primary Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical and operational configuration and needs of the customer.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
Customer Accountability and Value Alignment
  
  

* Single Point of Accountability: Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
* Signature Lifecycle Oversight: Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
* Value Delivery: Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
* Prioritization: Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Internal Resource Utilization: Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.

**Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management**

* Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer's business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
* Innovation Partnership: Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
* Customer Engagement: Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
* Collaborative Problem Solving: Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.

**Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management**

* AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
* Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
* AI Engagement Monitoring: Using AI-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
* Collaborative Learning: Actively seeking out "Agentblazer" training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
* Learning & Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask effective diagnosis questions and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
* Proactive Reviews: Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
* Incident Management: Act as the primary point of contact for major incidents, ensuring timely communications and resolution of issues.
* Cross-functional Relationships: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
* Client Engagement Planning: Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making.

**You're Our Person If...**

* Experience (Mandatory): Experienced business professional with 9+ years of relevant industry expertise, including a mandatory minimum of 4+ years of direct, hands-on experience working with the Salesforce Marketing Cloud platform (Marketing Cloud Engagement, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement / Pardot, or Marketing Cloud Next) in a customer success, administrator, consultant, or marketing operations capacity. Candidates without demonstrated Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience will not be considered for this role.
* Consulting Skills: Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C-level conversations.
* Domain Expertise: Possess industry-relevant expertise and begin honing skills in a relevant functional area. Should understand the broad impact of the industry on the customer's business.
* Communication: Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
* Learning & Development: Actively seek out relevant learning activities, approach obstacles as growth opportunities, and seek experienced mentors to accelerate personal development.

**Even Better If...**

* Marketing Cloud Engagement Administrator — hands-on experience configuring Marketing Cloud products using industry and product best practices.
* Marketing Cloud Email Specialist — proven knowledge of email marketing best practices, message design, subscriber & data management, and inbox delivery.
* Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist — skills in designing, building, and implementing marketing workflows through the Account Engagement (Pardot) platform.
* Marketing Cloud Engagement Consultant — ability to create multi-channel campaign solutions using the full suite of Marketing Cloud tools.

1c68a3f7.title: Program Manager, NA QC CO, RoW GSF & Now CO
1c68a3f7.description:
**Description**
Join our Global Specialty Fulfillment Central Operations team as a Program Manager I where you'll drive operational excellence for our quick commerce business in North America. In this high-impact role, you'll serve as the operational performance owner for the North America geographical region, identifying and eliminating defects that impact customer experience while collaborating with multiple stakeholders to optimize processes. You'll have the freedom to develop innovative solutions that reduce operational costs, eliminate quality issues, and enhance overall performance metrics.
  
  
This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of operations and strategic business improvements. You'll develop expertise in quick commerce business nuances specific to the North American market while exercising a high degree of ownership in identifying more efficient ways of working. Your analytical abilities will be crucial as you deep dive into operational data, identify root causes of performance issues, and implement effective solutions that directly impact customer satisfaction across North America.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Own operational performance metrics for the North America region, conducting regular deep dives into data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement Identify and eliminate operational defects leading to negative customer experiences through root cause analysis and implementing preventative measures Partner with North American operations teams to understand daily performance challenges, diagnose bottlenecks, and develop strategies to reduce quality issues and business waste Represent Central Operations in business stakeholder meetings focused on North America performance, effectively communicating operational status, challenges, and proposed solutions Transform raw data into clear documentation, requirements, and actionable insights that drive process improvements across the North American organization
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
A day in the life Your day begins with an in-depth analysis of the previous day's operational defects in North America, using data to identify patterns and root causes. You'll collaborate with North American operations teams to understand the current day's performance status and potential challenges. Throughout the day, you'll brainstorm strategies to reduce operational costs and business waste specific to the NA market, represent Central Operations in business calls with North American stakeholders, and coordinate with the central CO team to provide necessary support where needed. You'll balance analytical work with cross-functional collaboration, all focused on improving customer experience in North America.
  
  
**About The Team**
About the team Global Specialty Fulfillment Central Operations (GSF CO) functions as the Command-and-Control Center for Amazon Now (Quick Commerce) operations in North America. We partner strategically with North American Operations, business teams, ACES, and S&OP teams, providing expertise in capacity management, defect reduction, holiday planning, contingency management, and automation of redundant workflows.
  
  
Our team operates with a progressive mental model: Centralize processes, Standardize across the North America geography, Automate to reduce manual effort, and ultimately Eliminate unnecessary processes through hands-off-the-wheel automation. This creates an innovative environment where you'll have significant impact on improving customer experiences across North America.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of program or project management experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
* Experience in MS Access and SQL
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

b084a3d8.title: VP, eGRC Solution Architect (L12)
b084a3d8.description:
**Role Title: VP, eGRC Solution Architect (L12)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony’s risk-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks & providing effective challenge . Risk serves as Synchrony’s Second Line of Defense.
  
  
Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit & Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges.
  
  
**Role Summary/ Purpose**
The
**eGRC Solution Architect**
is an individual contributor who partners with one or more Agile teams within the Risk Infrastructure delivery team to support Risk & Compliance stakeholder s . This role translates enterprise GRC objectives into technology solutions that
**automate, standardize, and integrate**
governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance processes. The architect designs end-to-end solutions, decomposes complex objectives into actionable deliverables, evaluates and aligns technical standards and tools, and provides technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and deliver GRC solutions:  Serve as the GRC technical architecture lead supporting multiple concurrent initiatives, designing end-to-end solutions that span GRC functions, provide design guidance, conduct architecture reviews, and resolving complex technical decisions.
* Translate requirements into technical solutions: Work with stakeholders, including Risk and Compliance leaders , to understand GRC requirements and translate them into actionable, technology-based solutions .
* Lead technical implementations :  Guide and support development teams and related technical resources through the configuration and deployment of GRC software platforms.
* Provide technical and architectural guidance: Serve as the subject matter expert for GRC frameworks, processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments), enabling technologies, and industry best practices. Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions; lead architecture/design reviews; mentor teammates ; and maintain architecture diagrams and technical documentation.
* Manage project oversight: Oversee the technical vision of GRC projects, ensuring delivery excellence, security, and sustainability while also managing timelines, scope, and resources alongside project managers.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's Degree and 10 +years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience
* Deep GRC domain knowledge: Strong understanding of GRC concepts and core processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments) and how they align to risk and control objectives .
* GRC platform expertise : 5+ years of hands-on advanced configuration/development experience with leading GRC platforms , including ServiceNow IRM, Archer , SAI360 .
* Solution architecture experience: 5+ years designing and delivering end-to-end GRC solutions on ServiceNow, Archer, or SAI360, including target-state architecture, standards, and non-functional requirements.
* Problem-solving and analytical skills: Proven ability to assess business needs, evaluate risk and control impacts, identify trade-offs, and design scalable solutions that meet functional requirements.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Architectural and technical skills:  Proficiency in designing complex systems, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and enterprise integration via APIs and data pipelines.
* Communication and stakeholder management: The ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor's Degree and 10 +years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience

**Work Timings:**
**2:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST**
We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR.
  
  
Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.
  
  
**For Internal Applicants**

* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying.
* Inform your Manager or HRM before applying for any role on Workday.
* Ensure that your Professional Profile is updated (fields such as Education, Prior experience, Other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal LPP)
* L10+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible.
* L10+ Employees can apply

**Grade/Level: 12**
**Job Family Group**
Risk Management

d7691f83.description:

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As an Applied AI Specialist: Cloud FullStack, you will design, build, and evolve cloud-native and hybrid applications that translate client requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready solutions. This role involves collaborating with digital workers and intelligent agents to deliver solutions, applying an AI-First mindset and following established methodologies.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Solution Design: Designing and building cloud-native and hybrid applications that meet client requirements and are scalable, secure, and production-ready.
* Application Development: Applying an AI-First mindset to automate scaffolding, dependency management, API definition, and validation, as well as database design and validation.
* Pipeline Operation: Designing and operating CI/CD and GitOps pipelines with IaC and DevSecOps controls to ensure production readiness and cutover quality.
* Quality Engineering: Performing unit, module, and functional testing using testing agents and synthetic data to ensure quality and reliability.
* Incident Resolution: Analyzing logs and stack traces using AI agents to triage and resolve incidents and defects across different phases.

Master's Degree

* Cloud Application Development: Exposure to designing and building cloud-native and hybrid applications that meet client requirements and are scalable, secure, and production-ready.
* AI-First Mindset: Experience applying AI-First mindset to automate scaffolding, dependency management, API definition, and validation, as well as database design and validation.
* CI/CD Pipeline Operation: Exposure to designing and operating CI/CD and GitOps pipelines with IaC and DevSecOps controls to ensure production readiness and cutover quality.
* Quality Assurance: Experience performing unit, module, and functional testing using testing agents and synthetic data to ensure quality and reliability.
* Hyperscaler Platforms: Exposure to hyperscalers such as AWS, Azure, and Red Hat OpenShift, and deployment models to architect resilient and cost-optimized full-stack and integration patterns.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Advanced Testing Methods: Familiarity with advanced testing methods and techniques is desirable.

f7508dde.title: Service Delivery Manager - Payroll
f7508dde.description:
**BUREAU VERITAS | HR SHARED SERVICES HUB, NOIDA**
**Service Delivery Manager – Payroll**
*Global Process Owner, Payroll & Reward Operations (R2P)*
**Tower**
Reward to Pay (R2P)
  
  
**Location**
Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)
  
  
**Reports to**
HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida
  
  
**Role type**
People manager
  
  
**Scope**
Multi-country payroll, benefits administration, compensation changes, payroll accounting and tax filings
  
  
**Grade**
**About The Hub**
Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.
  
  
**ROLE PURPOSE**
You own payroll and reward delivery end to end for every country moving into Noida. You will move payroll from dozens of local vendors and in-country teams to a controlled, consolidated model. Employees must be paid accurately and on time, in every cycle and in every country, throughout the transition and after it.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Transition and shared services set-up
* Lead the payroll transition roadmap country by country, sequenced by risk, complexity, headcount and vendor contract dates.
* Run knowledge transfer from country payroll teams and vendors. This covers desk procedures, statutory calendars, pay elements and local exceptions.
* Plan and run parallel payroll runs for each country. Set clear go/no-go criteria based on variance thresholds, and use hypercare after cutover.
* Deliver the global payroll vendor consolidation programme. Rationalise the vendor portfolio, support selection, and manage exit and onboarding without disrupting pay.
* Design the target operating model for R2P, covering the split of work between hub, vendor and country HR, with RACI, handoffs and cut-off calendars.

b720204d.title: Senior Manager PLM Solutions
b720204d.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?
  
  
At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.
  
  
Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.
  
  
This role is responsible for driving the strategy, delivery, and ongoing operations of PLM systems and digital initiatives supporting product development, quality, and manufacturing functions. The individual will lead cross-functional efforts, manage critical stakeholder relationships, and architect enterprise-level solutions, including Teamcenter upgrades and integrations with systems like SAP, Loftware and Camstar. This position requires a combination of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and leadership to enable business transformation and operational excellence across global teams. This position will contribute to digital transformation initiatives and play a key role in strategic planning, change management, and team capability development.
  
  
Listed responsibilities are an essential, but not exhaustive list, of the usual duties associated with the position. Changes to individual responsibilities may occur due to business needs.
  
  
**Position Requirements**

* Provide strategic direction and leadership for PLM initiatives, ensuring alignment with business goals and enterprise architecture.
* Lead and mentor a geographically distributed team of developers, analysts, and solution architects in the implementation and support of Teamcenter and associated systems.
* Oversee the planning and execution of major upgrade projects (e.g., Teamcenter 2506), ensuring minimal disruption and maximum value delivery.
* Serve as solution architect for complex projects, ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability of implemented solutions.
* Act as the primary liaison with key stakeholders in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and IT to gather requirements, manage expectations, and ensure successful solution delivery.
* Define team objectives, track performance metrics, and support employee development through coaching and formal feedback.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and quality requirements in system design and data management.
* Support change management initiatives and contribute to the continuous improvement of business processes through automation and best practices.
* Represent PLM and Digital Solutions in leadership forums, audits, and global initiatives.
* Proven experience leading global cross-functional teams and managing large-scale, complex projects.
* Deep understanding of PLM processes, Change Management, BOM Management, and integrations with ERP, MES, and labeling systems.
* Strong solution architecture skills with hands-on experience in customizing and upgrading Teamcenter (preferably up to version 2412).
* Experience with Agile methodologies, ITIL practices, and project management tools.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment across functions.
* Demonstrated experience in coaching, mentoring, and developing team capabilities.

All listed requirements are deemed as essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodations for additional task and responsibilities

7f8d0d0e.description:
**Cloud Support Engineer**

**A high-growth, VC-backed SaaS company hiring its founding India cloud support team**

**Location:**
Remote (India)

**About the Company**

A high-growth, VC-backed SaaS company is hiring its founding India cloud support team and has partnered with Flexiple to bring on cloud support engineers. You will be one of the first cloud specialists on the ground, shaping how the company supports customers running its product across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high-performing teams and GCCs in India.

**Role Overview**

As a Cloud Support Engineer, you will troubleshoot cloud infrastructure and deployment issues for customers, working closely with engineering to keep their environments stable and performant.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cloud Troubleshooting & Support**

* Diagnose and resolve customer-reported issues across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments
* Investigate deployment failures, connectivity issues, and performance bottlenecks
* Reproduce issues in test environments and document root causes clearly

**Reliability & Product Partnership**

* Partner with engineering to escalate and close out complex cloud issues
* Contribute to runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and internal cloud documentation
* Share recurring customer patterns with product to influence the roadmap

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 2 to 6 years in cloud support, DevOps support, or site reliability roles
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Comfort with Linux administration and basic scripting in Python or Bash
* Clear written and spoken English and a reliable remote-work setup

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud certification (AWS, Azure, or GCP associate level or higher)
* Exposure to containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience supporting a SaaS or B2B software product

**What We Offer**

* A founding cloud-support seat with a high-growth, VC-backed SaaS company
* Remote-friendly, pan-India hiring with long-term placement
* Direct exposure to engineering leadership and product decisions
* One application considered for this and future matched roles

**Hiring Process**

HR Screening → Technical Assessment → Hiring Manager Round → Culture Fit

Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of the role is to ensure excellent customer service delivery of all technology solutions and products to clients, through effective project management, service metrics tracking, budget management, issue resolution, optimal resource allocation, and maintenance of a skilled team of all delivery resources for the client.

**͏**

**Do**

* **Oversee and manage service delivery by meeting all contractual/ SLA commitments**

6cc98cee.title: Operations Program Manager
6cc98cee.description:
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and pursue new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
As Stripe’s user base and global footprint grow dramatically, we face unique support problems resulting from our scale and the types of businesses we partner with. The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational support and expand Stripe’s portfolio of operational capabilities to meet the growing needs of external users and internal Stripe teams. Our support experience draws on a deep understanding of our products, the financial industry, money movement, and our customers’ products and users. Building this experience requires us to invest significant resources in talented teams of Stripes.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
We’re looking for dynamic and entrepreneurial leaders who will define our strategy for scaling the Core Payments team, improve operational workflows, and maintain a best-in-class Operations program. If you like hard problems, are analytical, are comfortable operating with ambiguity, and enjoy finding creative solutions, we want to hear from you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end product launches across multiple regions as an integrated program. Develop and maintain detailed launch plans that serve as the central point of coordination across globally distributed and highly cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Product Management, go-to-market, cross-functional review, Support, and other key partner teams.
* Drive operational excellence across the product launch lifecycle by designing, improving, and implementing scalable processes that strengthen stakeholder coordination, clarify dependencies, maintain alignment, and support consistent execution across regions.
* Monitor and report on progress through biweekly status updates to senior leadership while maintaining transparent documentation throughout.
* Support cross-functional collaboration by identifying and documenting teams’ responsibilities for product launches, proactively communicating blockers, and providing transparent status updates and relevant documentation, such as product launch Gantt charts, program plans, and scope details.
* Define and improve operating rhythms that support efficient collaboration across teams. Manage operational cadences for product launches and business reviews, and track Stripe Objectives and Key Results (SOKRs).
* Establish scalable launch frameworks and operational structures to simplify execution, improve cross-functional alignment, and support efficient multi-region product rollouts.

**Minimum Requirements**

* More than 7 years of total work experience, including 4 to 5 years in program management, consulting, or a similar role within a high-growth technology company, with a strong focus on managing strategic product initiatives from conception through implementation.
* A proven track record in process and project management, including creating operational processes, leading product roadmap reviews, and designing scalable systems in fast-paced environments.
* Skill in scheduling, prioritizing tasks, and meeting deadlines to support the timely delivery of products and features.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity and executing complex projects while building collaboration across diverse teams and functions.
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills, including high-level planning and ongoing communication to align project goals with operations.
* The ability to present ideas, product updates, and roadmaps clearly and persuasively to a range of stakeholders, including executives, to build alignment and understanding of project objectives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in program management, consulting, or a similar role within payments or fintech.
* Familiarity with roadmap management tools and planning frameworks, and knowledge of how to apply them to manage projects effectively.
* The ability to understand the company’s strategic goals and align the product roadmap accordingly.
* Skill in helping stakeholders prioritize product features and initiatives based on business value, customer needs, and resource availability.
* A deep understanding of global markets and the ability to contextualize decisions and processes to account for regional nuances.
* Experience implementing process improvements and change-management strategies to scale operations effectively.

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, we encourage you to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

924221b5.title: SERVICE DELIVERY MANAGER - TALENT ACQUISITION
924221b5.description:
**BUREAU VERITAS | HR SHARED SERVICES HUB, NOIDA**
**Service Delivery Manager – Talent Acquisition**
*Global Process Owner, Talent Acquisition Operations (R2H)*
**Tower**
Recruit to Hire (R2H)
  
  
**Location**
Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)
  
  
**Reports to**
HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida
  
  
**Role type**
People manager
  
  
**Scope**
Requisition management, sourcing support, interview scheduling, offer management, pre-employment checks and onboarding
  
  
**Grade**
As per BV grading framework
  
  
****ABOUT THE HUB****
Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.
  
  
**ROLE PURPOSE**
You own the recruitment and onboarding engine for every country moving into Noida. You will replace fragmented local practices with one standard, compliant and fast hiring process. Hiring managers should get the talent they need quickly, and every candidate should get a consistent, high-quality experience.
  
  
****KEY RESPONSIBILITIES****

* Transition and shared services set-up
* Map current recruitment and onboarding practice in each country, including steps, tools, vendors, volumes and cycle times, and set the baseline.
* Design the R2H target operating model. Define what moves to the hub, what stays with in-country recruiters and business partners, and what goes to vendors or RPO partners.
* Lead country-by-country transition, covering knowledge transfer, template and offer-letter harmonisation, and stabilisation after cutover.
* Set up the hub's scheduling, offer and onboarding desks, with capacity models tied to hiring forecasts.
* Process ownership and service delivery
* Act as Global Process Owner for R2H. Own the standard process from requisition to day one, including approval rules and local variations.
* Manage recruitment and background-check vendors across markets. Scorecard them on time-to-fill, quality of hire, diversity and cost.
* Map the candidate journey from end to end, remove friction points, and lift offer acceptance and employer-brand scores.
* Deliver a consistent onboarding experience. New joiners should have their systems, equipment and paperwork ready on day one.
* Act as the escalation point for hiring managers and TA partners on service issues.
* Governance, risk and controls
* Work with Legal, Compliance and country HR to keep every step compliant with local labour law, right-to-work rules and data privacy law.
* Own controls over offer approvals, compensation within band, and the retention and deletion of candidate data.
* Embed BV's DEI standards in sourcing, shortlisting and vendor contracts, and report on them regularly.
* Continuous improvement and digital
* Drive full ATS adoption and automate scheduling, offer generation and e-signature.
* Introduce AI-enabled tools for screening and scheduling, with fairness and privacy safeguards.
* Use funnel analytics to find where time is lost, and fix causes at their source.
* People leadership, performance and culture
* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.

09071c40.description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Job Purpose:**

Wipro is currently look for an experienced Program Manager to join our ranks. The Program Manager will be responsible for the overall technical transformation implementation at the client end.
  
 

͏

**Objectives of this role:**
- Strategize, implement, and maintain program initiatives that adhere to organizational and client objectives.
  
- Develop program assessment protocols for evaluation and improvement of Digital Transformation projects.
  
- Maintain organizational standards of satisfaction, quality, and performance.
  
- Oversee multiple project teams, ensuring program goals are reached.
  
- Manage budget and funding channels for maximum productivity.

͏

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders, including software engineers, data analysts, product managers, and operations teams, to design and improve end-to-end processes for operations.
  
- Lead process improvement initiatives by identifying areas for enhancement, conducting data analysis, and developing actionable recommendations as per the business and industry standards.
  
- Design and Drive large Transformation initiatives which may include automation, RPA, AI/GenAI, Chatbots, CX tools like agent assist, workflow orchestration, Quality management tools etc.
  
- Drive automation initiatives by leveraging technology and process optimization to streamline manual tasks and improve overall productivity.
  
- Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory changes related to banking operations and process optimization and apply this knowledge to improve business initiatives.
  
- Drive regular project meetings & ensure transformation initiatives are driven to completion.
  
- Manage discussions with required stakeholders for on various aspects of the program for timely follow up till closure.
  
- Performs Quality Control via reviews of the design created by Functional Consultant and Tech Architect
  
- Responsible for receiving the sign-off on the design, UAT and Hypercare from the customer 
  
- Establish working relationships and routinely interface with project sponsors, business stakeholders & technology partners.

͏

**Required skills and qualifications:**

- 5+ years of experience in an upper-management role, preferably in program management.
  
- Exceptional skills in leadership, time management, facilitation, and organization.
  
- Core experience in Digital Transformation in Telecom order management and front office processes with the tools/ solutions mentioned in role and responsibilities.
  
- Experience in managing stakeholders (internal and external).
  
- Outstanding knowledge of change management principles and performance evaluation processes.

͏

**Good to have skills and Experience:**

- PMP Certified is added advantage.
  
- Technical understanding of various Platform architecture and product features Genesys, SFDC, ServiceNow etc
  
- Current Technological landscape understanding and stays abreast of current technologies like AI/GenAI etc."

Mandatory Skills: Delivery Management
  
.

Experience: >10 YEARS
  
.

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

e003a78b.title: Engineering Team Leader, Industrial IoT & Digital Solutions- Husky(India)Guindy, Chennai
e003a78b.description:
**Job Description**
**Title:**
Engineering Team Leader, Industrial IoT & Digital Solutions- Husky(India)Guindy, Chennai
  
  
**Id:**
21208
  
  
**Type:**
FullTime
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai, India
  
  
At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.
  
  
Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.
  
  
Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.
  
  
Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!
  
  
****Job Description****
**Engineering Team Leader, Industrial IoT & Digital Solutions**
Lead and develop an engineering team made up of junior and senior engineers in the development of Industrial IoT, Edge Computing, Cloud Connectivity, Data Analytics, and Digital Solutions for Husky products and customer operations. Focus on innovation, scalability, cybersecurity, reliability, risk mitigation, and customer satisfaction while enabling data-driven manufacturing and Industry 4.0 initiatives.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities / Areas Of Accountability****

* Lead, manage, and develop the team, which includes but is not limited to coaching, mentoring, technical leadership, and cross-training.
* Oversee the design, development, deployment, and lifecycle management of Industrial IoT platforms, edge devices, cloud applications, and connected customer solutions.
* Ensure the team is effective in delivering scalable digital products and services that meet business and customer requirements and are aligned with product strategy and the Husky Operating Model.
* Plan and schedule development activities to ensure committed project milestones and release dates are achieved.
* Enforce Product Development Processes, cybersecurity standards, software quality requirements, architecture governance, and risk mitigation practices.
* Participate in and lead technical discussions, architecture reviews, design reviews, and executive updates to ensure implementation of high-quality digital solutions with stakeholder transparency.
* Influence and establish engineering standards, best practices, frameworks, and tools related to Industrial IoT, cloud computing, software engineering, and data platforms.
* Encourage team members to think, organize, innovate, and lead while providing career development opportunities and technical growth.
* Lead effective cross-disciplinary collaboration with Product Management, Software, Controls Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing, Service, IT, Cybersecurity, and Customer Success teams.
* Drive the development and adoption of edge-to-cloud architectures, industrial communications, device management, remote monitoring, predictive maintenance, and data analytics solutions.
* Support customer deployments and operational excellence initiatives through digital solutions that improve machine performance, uptime, quality, and operational visibility.
* Promote a culture of innovation, technical excellence, DevOps practices, cybersecurity awareness, and data-driven decision making.

****Critical Capabilities And Qualifications****

* Excellent communication skills (verbal, written, interpersonal, and presentation).
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate, coach, and develop a high-performing technical team.
* Strong decision-making, problem-solving, and strategic thinking capabilities.
* System-level thinking at both product and enterprise levels.
* Strong understanding of Industrial IoT architectures, edge computing, cloud platforms, and distributed systems.
* Strong knowledge of software engineering principles, system integration, and modern development methodologies.
* Experience with industrial communications and protocols including OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus TCP, Ethernet/IP, Profinet, and related technologies.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or equivalent.
* Experience with IoT device management, telemetry collection, data pipelines, analytics platforms, and monitoring solutions.
* Understanding of cybersecurity principles, secure software development practices, and industrial network security.
* Experience with DevOps tools, CI/CD pipelines, source control systems, and agile development methodologies.
* Demonstrates a high degree of flexibility and adaptability while embracing changing priorities.
* Knowledge of Husky products, manufacturing processes, tools, standards, and technologies is an asset.
* Experience with Edge Computing, AI/ML applications, predictive analytics, digital twins, and Industry 4.0 initiatives is an asset.
* Experience facilitating cybersecurity, safety, or technology risk assessments is an asset.
* Relevant cloud, cybersecurity, or industrial automation certifications are considered an asset.

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.

****Experience****

* 10+ years of relevant engineering experience in Industrial IoT, software development, industrial automation, connected products, or digital solutions.
* Proven leadership experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Experience delivering enterprise-scale software, cloud, or Industrial IoT solutions from concept through deployment.
* Experience in manufacturing, automation, machinery, packaging, injection molding, or industrial technology industries is an asset.
* Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams and collaborating across multiple functional disciplines is an asset.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.
