ebb35399.title: Technical Architect - AWS
ebb35399.description:
**About Us**
At Rhythm, our values form the foundation of our business. We are passionate about customer success, innovation, and our employees. They guide our actions, decisions, and interactions, ensuring that we consistently make a positive impact on the world around us.
  
  
**Job Description**
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking a rare, highly skilled hybrid AWS Solutions Architect & Software Developer to join our core product engineering team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between high-level cloud architecture and hands-on backend development. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and code-authoring the robust cloud infrastructure that powers our data core.
  
  
The primary focus of this position is architecting and developing the high-throughput pipelines that process raw "fleet exhaust data" (noise) in AWS and funnel actionable summaries (signals) into our enterprise presentation layer. You will heavily focus on complex data orchestrations and integrations across AWS, Salesforce Data Cloud, MuleSoft, and critical third-party fleet compliance ecosystems.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
As a hybrid Architect and Developer, your responsibilities will span architectural design, core systems programming, and cross-platform ecosystem integration:
  
  
Cloud Architecture & Strategy
  
  

* Design & Scale: Architect and optimize secure, scalable, and cost-effective cloud infrastructures capable of ingesting massive, high-velocity streaming data environments.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop and maintain production-ready CloudFormation or Terraform templates to ensure fully automated, repeatable environment deployments.
* CI/CD Leadership: Establish and govern standardized CI/CD pipelines that continuously decrease time-to-production for new backend features while enforcing rigorous quality and testing gates.
* Security & Trust: Design and implement a robust Cloud Trust Architecture ensuring compliance with stringent data protection best practices and role-based access control.

Backend Software Engineering
  
  

* Write Robust Backend Code: Write clean, highly performant, and scalable code (primarily utilizing Python or Node.js) to build core AWS backend services, APIs, and microservices.
* Data Processing & AI: Program state-of-the-art serverless workflows utilizing AWS Lambda, EventBridge, and Amazon Bedrock to compute derived risk indicators (e.g., speeding minutes per 100 miles, trend slope tracking).
* Database & Knowledge Lake Management: Optimize structured and unstructured data persistence strategies across Amazon S3, RDS instances, and managed Vector Databases.
* Testing & Quality Assurance: Author and run extensive unit and integration tests for AWS-based applications, lead code reviews, and aggressively improve core data processing algorithms.

Multi-Platform Ecosystem Integration
  
  

* Ecosystem Orchestration: Architect the ingestion paths for high-velocity telematics and IoT data, isolating massive volume processing in AWS before translating relevant indicators to executive CRM workflows.
* Telematics & Compliance Integration: Build and maintain direct API data pipelines integrating heavy enterprise platforms and third-party systems including:

+ Telematics Infrastructure: Deep integration with providers like Verizon Connect (VZC) to ingest real-time engine diagnostics, GPS, and harsh event data.
+ Regulatory Compliance: Integrations with FMCSA API systems (including SAFER, SMS, A&I, and DataQs datasets).
+ Risk & Personnel Platforms: Synchronized identity management pipelines with Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) monitoring and Learning Management Systems (LMS) such as Samba Safety, Sentix, or related Risk Cloud environments.

* Salesforce & MuleSoft Collaboration: Partner closely with application teams to orchestrate end-to-end event-driven flows using MuleSoft for bidirectional Roster CRUD logic, linking the AWS Knowledge Lake cleanly with Salesforce Data Cloud and AgentForce.

**Requirements**
What We're Looking For
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience:

+ Minimum of 5–7 years of proven hands-on software development experience writing clean production code.
+ Minimum of 2 years of dedicated experience acting as an AWS Solutions Architect designing complex, multi-system integration topographies.

* AWS Certifications: Valid AWS Certifications are strongly preferred (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, AWS Certified Developer – Associate).
* Technical Proficiency:

+ Languages: Advanced proficiency in Python or Node.js.
+ AWS Infrastructure: Deep knowledge of AWS S3, Lambda, EventBridge, Amazon Bedrock, Lex, Connect, SES, and native database layers (RDS, DynamoDB, or Vector DBs).
+ Integration Tech: Exceptional familiarity with building and consuming web services across API, REST, and RPC architectures.
+ Containers: Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes environments for containerized compute deployment.

* Domain Context: Prior experience writing applications that parse telematics data, cellular/IoT streams, geographic spatial boundaries, or government/compliance API interfaces is a significant advantage.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a dedicated approach to data-driven technical execution and clear, transparent team communication.

401ba4c7.description:
**Role Title: VP, eGRC Solution Architect (L12)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony’s risk-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks & providing effective challenge . Risk serves as Synchrony’s Second Line of Defense.
  
  
Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit & Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges.
  
  
**Role Summary/ Purpose**
The
**eGRC Solution Architect**
is an individual contributor who partners with one or more Agile teams within the Risk Infrastructure delivery team to support Risk & Compliance stakeholder s . This role translates enterprise GRC objectives into technology solutions that
**automate, standardize, and integrate**
governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance processes. The architect designs end-to-end solutions, decomposes complex objectives into actionable deliverables, evaluates and aligns technical standards and tools, and provides technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and deliver GRC solutions:  Serve as the GRC technical architecture lead supporting multiple concurrent initiatives, designing end-to-end solutions that span GRC functions, provide design guidance, conduct architecture reviews, and resolving complex technical decisions.
* Translate requirements into technical solutions: Work with stakeholders, including Risk and Compliance leaders , to understand GRC requirements and translate them into actionable, technology-based solutions .
* Lead technical implementations :  Guide and support development teams and related technical resources through the configuration and deployment of GRC software platforms.
* Provide technical and architectural guidance: Serve as the subject matter expert for GRC frameworks, processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments), enabling technologies, and industry best practices. Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions; lead architecture/design reviews; mentor teammates ; and maintain architecture diagrams and technical documentation.
* Manage project oversight: Oversee the technical vision of GRC projects, ensuring delivery excellence, security, and sustainability while also managing timelines, scope, and resources alongside project managers.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's Degree and 10 +years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience
* Deep GRC domain knowledge: Strong understanding of GRC concepts and core processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments) and how they align to risk and control objectives .
* GRC platform expertise : 5+ years of hands-on advanced configuration/development experience with leading GRC platforms , including ServiceNow IRM, Archer , SAI360 .
* Solution architecture experience: 5+ years designing and delivering end-to-end GRC solutions on ServiceNow, Archer, or SAI360, including target-state architecture, standards, and non-functional requirements.
* Problem-solving and analytical skills: Proven ability to assess business needs, evaluate risk and control impacts, identify trade-offs, and design scalable solutions that meet functional requirements.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Architectural and technical skills:  Proficiency in designing complex systems, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and enterprise integration via APIs and data pipelines.
* Communication and stakeholder management: The ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor's Degree and 10 +years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience

**Work Timings:**
**2:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST**
We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR.
  
  
Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.
  
  
**For Internal Applicants**

* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying.
* Inform your Manager or HRM before applying for any role on Workday.
* Ensure that your Professional Profile is updated (fields such as Education, Prior experience, Other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal LPP)
* L10+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible.
* L10+ Employees can apply

**Grade/Level: 12**

**About F9 Infotech**

F9 Infotech is a leading cloud consulting and managed services provider, helping enterprises accelerate their cloud transformation journeys. We specialize in cloud migration, modernization, infrastructure solutions, and managed services across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Nutanix environments.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a
**Cloud Migration Engineer**
with hands-on experience in migrating enterprise workloads to AWS, Azure, or Nutanix NC2.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems, cloud migration methodologies, and infrastructure fundamentals.

You will work closely with our Cloud Delivery and Project teams to plan, execute, troubleshoot, and successfully complete enterprise workload migrations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Execute enterprise workload migrations from on-premises or cloud environments to AWS, Azure, or Nutanix NC2.
* Participate in workload discovery, assessment, and migration planning.
* Support the development and execution of migration strategies.
* Perform server migrations using cloud-native or third-party migration tools.
* Coordinate with project teams during migration, testing, validation, and cutover activities.
* Troubleshoot migration-related issues and minimize downtime during workload transitions.
* Perform post-migration validation and support workload stabilization.
* Maintain migration documentation, execution checklists, and technical reports.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in IT infrastructure, cloud operations, or cloud migration.
* Hands-on experience migrating enterprise workloads to at least one of the following: AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Nutanix NC2.
* Strong knowledge of Windows Server and Linux operating systems.
* Understanding of cloud migration strategies, methodologies, and best practices.
* Familiarity with migration tools such as AWS Application Migration Service (MGN), Azure Migrate, Nutanix Move, or equivalent solutions.
* Good understanding of virtualization technologies, particularly VMware and Nutanix.
* Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including IP addressing, DNS, routing, and connectivity.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work collaboratively with technical teams and project stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

* AWS, Azure, or Nutanix certifications.
* Experience migrating VMware-based enterprise workloads.
* Exposure to large-scale data center or cloud migration projects.
* Understanding of backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity.

**Why Join F9 Infotech?**

Work on enterprise-scale cloud migration projects across multiple technologies, collaborate with experienced cloud architects and engineers, and develop your expertise in AWS, Azure, and Nutanix cloud platforms.

**Important:**
This is a full-time, on-site position based in Kochi, Kerala. Candidates must be willing to work from our Kochi office.

6ef5fc12.description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title: Senior Specialist – Cloud SRE**
**Educations: Any Graduate**
**Experience: 8 to 15years**
**Location: Mumbai**
**Key Skills: Experienced Senior SRE Engineer with 10-15 years of expertise in multi-cloud operations (AWS, Azure), reliability engineering, automation, and large-scale infrastructure management. Skilled in incident response, SLIs/SLOs, observability, CI/CD, IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation), cloud security, cost optimization, and architecting highly available and scalable systems. Strong customer leadership, problem-solving, and mentoring abilities with a focus on automation-first and resilience-driven engineering.**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Customer Leadership & Collaboration
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for assigned customer accounts.
* Provide regular updates and lead initiatives to improve customer environments.
* Be highly familiar with assigned accounts to make tactical decisions without escalation.
* Collaborate with customer development teams to align infrastructure with application requirements.

**Incident & Problem Management:**

* Lead incident response and postmortems, ensuring corrective and preventive measures.
* Be the Tier 3 escalation point for offshore/onshore SRE teams.
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and validate work quality of Tier-2 engineers.
* Develop and maintain incident response plans for security breaches and operational incidents.

**Reliability Engineering:**

* Define and maintain SLIs/SLOs, track error budgets, and monitor alignment.
* Participate in architecture discussions for high availability, disaster recovery, and scalability.
* Integrate resilience patterns such as circuit breakers, retries, and bulkheading.
* Use chaos engineering / fault injection practices where applicable.
* Automation & Infrastructure as Code
* Automate infrastructure and operations tasks using Terraform, CloudFormation, AWS CDK.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with canary deployments and blue/green strategies.
* Implement automation workflows with AWS Lambda, Step Functions, Azure Functions.

**Monitoring & Observability:**

* Implement observability systems: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK, Jaeger.
* Configure proactive monitoring and alerts using AWS CloudWatch / Azure Monitor.
* Ensure visibility into metrics, traces, and logs for troubleshooting.

**Cloud Infrastructure Management:**

* Provision and manage VMs, storage, networking, VPNs, and ExpressRoute/Peering.
* Manage patching, backups, encryption, decryption, and image management.
* Optimize performance and cost via rightsizing, autoscaling, and reserved instances.
* Manage identity and access controls (AWS IAM, Azure AD, RBAC).

**Security & Compliance:**

* Implement and enforce security best practices across multi-cloud environments.
* Ensure compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and industry regulations.
* Conduct regular audits and compliance reporting.

**Mentoring & Knowledge Sharing:**

* Coach and mentor Tier 2 and junior SREs.
* Conduct reliability-focused design reviews.
* Maintain up-to-date documentation, runbooks, and SOPs.

**About Us**
Datavail is a leading provider of data management, application development, analytics, and cloud services, with more than 1,000 professionals helping clients build and manage applications and data via a world-class tech-enabled delivery platform and software solutions across all leading technologies. For more than 17 years, Datavail has worked with thousands of companies spanning different industries and sizes, and is an AWS Advanced Tier Consulting Partner, a Microsoft Solutions Partner for Data & AI and Digital & App Innovation (Azure), an Oracle Partner, and a MySQL Partner.
  
  
**About The Team**
**Datavail’s Team of Cloud Experts Can Save You Time and Money**
Our Cloud experts are capable to overcome every obstacle in helping clients manage everything from databases, analytics, reporting, migrations, and upgrades to monitoring and overall data management.
  
  
You can free up your IT resources to focus on growing your business rather than fighting fires. Our Cloud experts can guide you through strategic initiatives or support routine database management.
  
  
**Cloud Managed Services**
Datavail’s business focuses on helping you use your data to drive business results through cost-saving services. The success of your business depends on how well you understand and manage your data. Our managed cloud services give you the power to unleash your organization’s potential. We provide comprehensive and technically advanced support for Cloud Operation to ensure that your infrastructure is safe, secure, and managed with the utmost level of care.
  
  
Our delivery performance in data management leads the industry. We offer highly trained Cloud administrators via a 24×7, always on, always available, global delivery model.
  
  
With the combination of a proven delivery model and top-notch experience ensures that Datavail will remain the Cloud experts on demand you desire. Datavail’s flexible and client focused services always add value to your organization.

6a93b725.title: Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead
6a93b725.description:
**Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead**

**Employment Type: Full-Time**

**Experience: 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML, LLM application development, Generative AI, platform architecture, solution architecture, or technical product development.**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced
**Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead**
to drive the development and evolution of the Fluid AIQ Platform and lead AI-powered application development for upcoming client projects.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building production-ready applications using LLMs, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, and modern AI frameworks.

This role goes beyond traditional chatbot development, focusing on building intelligent agentic applications capable of reasoning, planning, interacting with enterprise systems, using tools, and operating within defined guardrails.

The position combines AI architecture, hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and product commercialization. You will help transform platform capabilities into modular commercial offerings that can be deployed independently and expanded based on client requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Development

* Design scalable architectures for agentic AI applications, including single-agent and multi-agent systems.
* Define agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, state management, and workflow patterns.
* Establish reusable reference architectures, implementation guides, client onboarding playbooks, and engineering standards.
* Evaluate AI technologies, models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on business and technical requirements.
* Contribute to the evolution and architecture of the Fluid AIQ Platform.

2. AI Application Development

* Build production-ready applications using AI agents, LLMs, RAG, and workflow automation.
* Implement tool/function calling, planning and reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop processes.
* Develop integrations with enterprise APIs, business applications, and external systems.
* Implement MCP Server/Client integrations and autonomous or semi-autonomous workflows.
* Build AI-powered decision-support solutions and reusable platform components.

3. LLM & Generative AI Engineering

* Work with LLM providers and models, including OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, and open-source or local models.
* Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, function calling, and model fallback strategies.
* Evaluate and benchmark models based on cost, performance, latency, privacy, and business use cases.
* Ensure flexibility in model and framework selection without unnecessary platform dependency on a single provider.

4. Product Leadership & Commercialization

* Take technical and product ownership of Fluid platform components and client AI programs.
* Help package platform capabilities into independent, commercially viable modules.
* Support the commercialization of reusable platform capabilities and technical IP.
* Develop sales-enablement materials and implementation guidance.
* Track and report platform health, adoption, and delivery metrics to leadership.

5. AI Safety, Reliability & Governance

* Implement guardrails and validation mechanisms to reduce hallucinations, incorrect tool usage, unauthorized actions, and unsafe outputs.
* Design human-approval workflows where required.
* Build reliable agent workflows with error handling, retries, fallback mechanisms, and observability.
* Support release management, environment management, service-level objectives, and production support models.
* Address security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI requirements.

6. Technical Leadership & Collaboration

* Lead and mentor architects and engineers working on agentic AI solutions.
* Collaborate with architecture, development, and cross-functional teams.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and build proof of concepts (POCs).
* Ensure solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and delivery timelines.

Mandatory Technical Skills

**Agentic AI & Generative AI**

* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and agentic AI architectures.
* Hands-on experience with RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, context management, and AI evaluation.
* Experience with agent orchestration, tool/function calling, multi-agent systems, agent memory and state, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Understanding of agent guardrails, reliability, and observability.

**Programming & Application Development**

* Strong programming skills in at least one of the following: Python or Node.js/TypeScript.
* Experience with REST APIs, microservices, authentication and authorization, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and database integration.

**AI Frameworks & SDKs**

* Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, Claude Agents SDK, or equivalent agent SDKs.
* Ability to evaluate and select frameworks based on solution requirements rather than relying on a single technology.

**LLM Integration**

* Experience integrating multiple LLM providers, preferably OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Ollama/open-source LLMs.

**Data Engineering & RAG**

* Experience with PostgreSQL, vector databases, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of embedding models, document processing, semantic search, and hybrid search.
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs and ontology design, including Neo4j, RDF/OWL, or GraphRAG.
* Understanding of multi-tenant data architecture.

**Cloud Platforms**

* Strong experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

Good-to-Have Skills

* Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
* Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other AI coding tools.
* Ollama and open-source LLMs.
* Multimodal AI, Voice AI, and AI workflow automation.
* AI observability, evaluation platforms, and model evaluation.
* Fine-tuning, AI security, prompt-injection protection, and PII/data protection.
* Enterprise SaaS, CRM, and ERP integrations.
* AI FinOps and FinOps Foundation practices.
* Cloud marketplace listings, including Azure Marketplace and AWS Marketplace.
* Product management experience and experience commercializing consulting IP as licensed software.
* Experience replacing or complementing traditional RPA solutions with AI-agent-based approaches.

What We're Looking For

* A hands-on technical leader who can translate business requirements into scalable agentic AI solutions.
* Someone who can combine architecture, engineering, platform development, and product thinking.
* A professional capable of taking AI capabilities from proof of concept to production-ready and commercially deployable solutions.
* Strong communication, technical decision-making, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills.

**Interested in building production-grade Agentic AI platforms and bringing AI-powered products to market? Apply now!**

This role requires strong technical credibility, executive presence, commercial acumen and the ability to translate complex technology initiatives into
**measurable business and financial outcomes**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Executive Customer Leadership & CXO Engagement


+ Serve as the senior technical and strategic point of contact for assigned enterprise and strategic accounts.

+ Understand customer business priorities and translate them into technology and business strategies.

+ Govern disaster recovery readiness, business continuity, capacity management and operational resilience.
+ Drive automation and proactive monitoring to reduce recurring incidents and manual operational effort.
+ Establish service improvement plans with measurable outcomes and executive visibility.

* FinOps, P&L, Revenue & Commercial Management


+ Demonstrate strong understanding of FinOps principles, practices and operating models across cloud environments.
+ Drive cloud financial management covering cost visibility, allocation, optimization, forecasting, budgeting and governance.
+ Identify opportunities to optimize cloud consumption and improve customer technology economics without compromising performance, security or resilience.

+ Manage account-level revenue, gross margin, cost base and profitability in partnership with business and finance teams.
+ Own revenue management and forecasting, including actuals, run-rate revenue, pipeline, renewals and growth opportunities.

+ Identify opportunities for upsell, cross-sell, expansion and transformation-led revenue growth.

+ Proactively identify and resolve billing disputes, revenue leakage and invoicing discrepancies.

+ Track customer satisfaction, executive engagement, service performance and commercial health.

* Evaluate designs and pull requests spanning Commerce, services, and storefront layers, and trace complex cross-layer defects back to their root cause
* Offer guidance on capacity planning, caching strategies, search, and failure handling for a high-traffic B2B storefront
* Mentor senior engineers and leads, capturing architecture decisions along with their context, options considered, and consequences to maintain continuity
* Pinpoint major obstacles and use structured problem-solving techniques to tackle complex, multi-system issues

**Requirements**

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Between 12 and 20 years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 5 years serving as an architect or in an equivalent principal/staff design capacity on large-scale commerce or comparably complex multi-tier systems
* At least 8 years of hands-on expertise with HCL Commerce and/or IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS) 8.x, including store customization, commands/tasks, tools, catalog/order/user/organization workflows, and back-end integration
* At least 8 years of expertise in Java / J2EE and object-oriented design for large IT systems, with a strong preference for WebSphere Application Server experience
* At least 5 years working with Spring / Spring MVC, with practical Spring Boot architecture experience covering service boundaries, APIs, resilience, and authentication
* At least 5 years of experience building web services (REST and SOAP), including the ability to define contracts that other teams can implement against
* Hands-on production architecture experience with Next.js and React, covering routing, data fetching, BFF/API integration, and storefront performance optimization; TypeScript experience is preferred
* At least 5 years using source control systems, with Git experience required
* Preferred background in designing B2B commerce architecture, including punchout functionality, organization/user models, and complex contract/pricing logic
* Experience delivering work through Agile methods using Atlassian tooling (Jira, Bitbucket/Git, Confluence)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for engaging both technical and non-technical audiences

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with headless/composable commerce concepts (API-first storefronts, BFF, packaged capabilities) and iPaaS platforms such as MuleSoft
* Exposure to search technologies (Solr or similar), caching systems (Redis or similar), and CMS-powered storefronts (Optimizely or similar) working alongside a commerce engine
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (GKE/Kubernetes or similar) supporting storefront and Spring Boot deployments, plus WAS/IHS for Commerce
* Solid grasp of security practices, PCI-adjacent payment flows, and session/identity management spanning legacy and modern storefronts
* Prior involvement in dual-run initiatives or large-scale commerce migration efforts

ec2381ae.title: Director, HR Domain Architect
ec2381ae.description:
**About the Team:**

  

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Our HR Digital & Tech team transforms how GSK attracts, develops, and retains talent through innovative technology solutions. From managing global HR platforms to delivering data-driven insights, this function ensures our people have the tools and experiences they need to thrive. Partnering closely with HR business teams, we create solutions that simplify processes, enhance employee engagement, and enable strategic workforce planning. If you’re passionate about technology that empowers people, this is where you can make an impact.

**Job Purpose:**

  

The Director, HR Domain Architect defines and governs the architectural framework for the HR Digital & Tech Domain, ensuring that technology decisions support business goals and enable the successful delivery of domain Products, such as Workday, Payroll & Time, etc. The role partners with senior stakeholders to guide solution direction, establish domain standards and principles, and provide architectural leadership across solutions delivered within the domain. The HR Digital & Tech Domain Architect ensures that products are designed in a way that is scalable, interoperable, and aligned to agreed business and technology objectives.

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Define and maintain the architectural framework, standards, and schematics for the HR Digital & Tech Domain, including domain-specific principles, patterns, data flows, and interface models.
* Introduce and govern a Domain Standards Catalogue (e.g., principles, reference patterns, SLAs, reusable assets), ensuring lifecycle ownership, version control, and adoption across delivery teams.
* Partner with senior Business and IT stakeholders to guide domain technology decisions, ensuring alignment to business goals, risk appetite, and product delivery priorities.
* Partner with VP Global HR D&T, Data and Digital Enablement Director and HR Tech Tower Leads to define long term architecture simplification and consolidation strategy
* Partner with HR Tech Delivery Director on key architecture decisions and delivery of top priority projects
* Lead business case development for new technology investments, ensuring alignment with key stakeholders and funding submission.
* Provide architectural guidance to Solution Architects and delivery teams, enabling consistent design approaches; define reusable domain contracts and interface specifications with versioning, observability, and interoperability requirements.
* Produce and maintain architecture artefacts for the domain (e.g., reference architectures, models, integration schematics, contract definitions, security patterns) required to support delivery and operational readiness.
* Support compliance and governance processes (e.g. Architecture Review Board, Change Advisory Board), including architecture review checkpoints, exemption criteria, design sign-off, and updates to the domain technical debt register.
* Assess architectural compliance and technical debt trends within the domain, contributing actionable recommendations to improve scalability, reliability, maintainability, and product lifecycle sustainability.
* Maintain a regular cadence with Enterprise Architecture, Enterprise AI, Cyber Security, and Product Teams to align on standards, resolve cross-domain design challenges, and support enterprise-level use cases and digital ecosystem interoperability.
* Track and report key architecture KPIs for the domain (e.g., pattern adoption, application rationalisation, exemptions closed, technical debt reduction, readiness score, contract/interface reuse index).
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
  

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 19 to 25 years in architecture or technical design roles, including experience applying architecture principles within a product or domain context.
* Demonstrated ability to define architectural patterns, standards, or frameworks.
* Experience reviewing and guiding solution designs to ensure alignment with architectural requirements.
* Practical experience documenting domain models, interface specifications, and other architectural artefacts.
* Exposure to evaluating technology decisions and advising stakeholders with clear architectural rationale.
* Experience collaborating with business and product teams to anchor architecture to value and delivery needs.
* HR Domain experience
* Experience on workday, skills platform, learning platforms, SAP SuccessFactors, Microsoft azure.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g., TOGAF, cloud certifications).
  

**Preferred Skills:**

  

* Strong analytical and conceptual modelling skills.
* Ability to communicate architectural concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to challenge and influence design decisions constructively.
* Strong documentation and design-modelling skills.
* Awareness of emerging technologies and ability to apply them within the context.
* Ability to work in a very fast-paced and fluid environment
* Comfortable with ambiguity and change
* Very detailed oriented
  

**Skills**

Architecture Governance, HR Systems Implementation, Human Resources (HR) Technology Solution Integrations, Human Resources Integration, Reference Architectures, Solution Architecture, Stakeholder Management, The Open Group Architecture Framework (TOGAF), Workday HCM  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. 54f55fe6.title: Presales Solutions Architect
54f55fe6.description:
**About SmartWinnr**

 

SmartWinnr is an enterprise-grade sales enablement platform that helps organizations build sales readiness through AI sales roleplay, coaching, and certification at scale. The platform serves Fortune 500 clients including Boston Scientific, Johnson & Johnson, and AstraZeneca, along with other major companies such as Abbott, Medtronic, HDFC Life, SBI Life, ICICI Prudential, and Aditya Birla to boost sales productivity. SmartWinnr has earned recognition from G2 as one of the top 50 sales products for two consecutive years, based on authentic customer reviews and feedback.

**Job Role:**

Pre-Sales Solutions Architect

**Job Location:**

Hyderabad (On-site)

**About the role**

SmartWinnr is looking for a Pre-Sales Solutions Architect who can bridge the gap between customer business requirements and our product capabilities. This role requires excellent communication and presentation skills, along with strong expertise in sales documentation and proposal development.

You will work closely with the sales team to demonstrate SmartWinnr's platform to prospective customers, including senior leadership, understand their requirements, and prepare compelling proposals, commercial documents, and responses to RFPs/RFQs.

The role also involves coordinating the review of customer agreements, setting up demo accounts, and creating customized presentations and other sales materials based on business discussions. We are looking for someone who can communicate confidently with enterprise customers, manage documentation accurately, and support the sales team throughout the sales cycle.

**What you will own**

* **Product demonstrations and presentations.**

  Deliver engaging product demos to prospective customers, including senior leadership. Understand customer requirements and tailor demonstrations to relevant business use cases and expected outcomes.

* **Demo account setup.**

  Set up, configure, and maintain demo accounts and environments before customer meetings. Ensure the product is ready for demonstrations and aligned with the prospect's requirements

* **Proposal documentation.**

  Prepare professional proposals, solution documents, presentations, commercial proposals, and other sales-related documentation based on customer discussions and business requirements.

* **RFP/RFQ responses.**

  Review Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Quotations (RFQs), and customer questionnaires. Coordinate with internal teams to gather accurate information and ensure complete, high-quality submissions within deadlines.

* **MSA/NDA vetting and coordination.**

  Review customer Master Service Agreements (MSAs) and Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) for completeness, identify non-standard clauses or deviations, and coordinate with the Legal team and relevant stakeholders for review and approval.

* **Commercial documentation.**

  Prepare quotations, pricing summaries, commercial proposals, and supporting documents in coordination with the sales and finance teams. Ensure accuracy and alignment with approved commercial terms.

* **Sales decks and supporting materials.**

  Create and customize presentation decks, solution overviews, and other sales collateral based on business discussions, prospect requirements, and sales opportunities.

﻿

* **Cross-functional collaboration.**

  Work closely with Sales, Product, Customer Success, Legal, Finance, and other internal teams to gather information, validate product capabilities, address customer queries, and support deal progression.

**What we are looking for**

* 2+ years of relevant experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, sales enablement, sales support, or a similar role.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present confidently to enterprise customers and senior leadership.
* Strong presentation skills and the ability to explain product features, use cases, and business value clearly.
* Experience preparing proposals, presentations, commercial documents, and other customer-facing sales materials.
* Ability to understand business discussions and translate customer requirements into structured documentation and compelling presentations.
* Strong attention to detail when preparing and reviewing documents.
* Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and other tools used for sales documentation.
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate documentation within tight deadlines.
* A proactive, organized, and ownership-driven approach to work.

**Useful but not required**

* Experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, sales enablement, or enterprise SaaS sales.
* Experience conducting software product demonstrations for enterprise customers.
* Familiarity with RFP/RFQ processes, commercial proposals, and enterprise procurement requirements.
* Exposure to MSA/NDA review and contract coordination.
* Experience with CRM platforms, proposal management tools, and document collaboration systems.
* Understanding of SaaS business models and enterprise sales cycles.

**What this role is not**

This is not purely a product demonstration or presentation role. It requires equal attention to sales documentation, commercial proposals, RFP/RFQ responses, and coordination of customer agreements.

The person will be expected to contribute hands-on to preparing documents, setting up demo accounts, coordinating with internal teams, and supporting the sales team in moving opportunities forward.

**Things worth knowing before you apply**

You will work closely with the sales team and engage with prospective enterprise customers. Strong communication, presentation skills, documentation accuracy, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple sales-related activities are essential to succeeding in this role.

The position is based in Hyderabad and requires working on-site.

a9fa097f.title: Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead
a9fa097f.description:
**Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead**

**Employment Type: Full-Time**

**Experience: 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML, LLM application development, Generative AI, platform architecture, solution architecture, or technical product development.**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced
**Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead**
to drive the development and evolution of the Fluid AIQ Platform and lead AI-powered application development for upcoming client projects.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building production-ready applications using LLMs, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, and modern AI frameworks.

This role goes beyond traditional chatbot development, focusing on building intelligent agentic applications capable of reasoning, planning, interacting with enterprise systems, using tools, and operating within defined guardrails.

The position combines AI architecture, hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and product commercialization. You will help transform platform capabilities into modular commercial offerings that can be deployed independently and expanded based on client requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Development

* Design scalable architectures for agentic AI applications, including single-agent and multi-agent systems.
* Define agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, state management, and workflow patterns.
* Establish reusable reference architectures, implementation guides, client onboarding playbooks, and engineering standards.
* Evaluate AI technologies, models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on business and technical requirements.
* Contribute to the evolution and architecture of the Fluid AIQ Platform.

2. AI Application Development

* Build production-ready applications using AI agents, LLMs, RAG, and workflow automation.
* Implement tool/function calling, planning and reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop processes.
* Develop integrations with enterprise APIs, business applications, and external systems.
* Implement MCP Server/Client integrations and autonomous or semi-autonomous workflows.
* Build AI-powered decision-support solutions and reusable platform components.

3. LLM & Generative AI Engineering

* Work with LLM providers and models, including OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, and open-source or local models.
* Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, function calling, and model fallback strategies.
* Evaluate and benchmark models based on cost, performance, latency, privacy, and business use cases.
* Ensure flexibility in model and framework selection without unnecessary platform dependency on a single provider.

4. Product Leadership & Commercialization

* Take technical and product ownership of Fluid platform components and client AI programs.
* Help package platform capabilities into independent, commercially viable modules.
* Support the commercialization of reusable platform capabilities and technical IP.
* Develop sales-enablement materials and implementation guidance.
* Track and report platform health, adoption, and delivery metrics to leadership.

5. AI Safety, Reliability & Governance

* Implement guardrails and validation mechanisms to reduce hallucinations, incorrect tool usage, unauthorized actions, and unsafe outputs.
* Design human-approval workflows where required.
* Build reliable agent workflows with error handling, retries, fallback mechanisms, and observability.
* Support release management, environment management, service-level objectives, and production support models.
* Address security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI requirements.

6. Technical Leadership & Collaboration

* Lead and mentor architects and engineers working on agentic AI solutions.
* Collaborate with architecture, development, and cross-functional teams.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and build proof of concepts (POCs).
* Ensure solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and delivery timelines.

Mandatory Technical Skills

**Agentic AI & Generative AI**

* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and agentic AI architectures.
* Hands-on experience with RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, context management, and AI evaluation.
* Experience with agent orchestration, tool/function calling, multi-agent systems, agent memory and state, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Understanding of agent guardrails, reliability, and observability.

**Programming & Application Development**

* Strong programming skills in at least one of the following: Python or Node.js/TypeScript.
* Experience with REST APIs, microservices, authentication and authorization, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and database integration.

**AI Frameworks & SDKs**

* Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, Claude Agents SDK, or equivalent agent SDKs.
* Ability to evaluate and select frameworks based on solution requirements rather than relying on a single technology.

**LLM Integration**

* Experience integrating multiple LLM providers, preferably OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Ollama/open-source LLMs.

**Data Engineering & RAG**

* Experience with PostgreSQL, vector databases, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of embedding models, document processing, semantic search, and hybrid search.
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs and ontology design, including Neo4j, RDF/OWL, or GraphRAG.
* Understanding of multi-tenant data architecture.

**Cloud Platforms**

* Strong experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

Good-to-Have Skills

* Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
* Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other AI coding tools.
* Ollama and open-source LLMs.
* Multimodal AI, Voice AI, and AI workflow automation.
* AI observability, evaluation platforms, and model evaluation.
* Fine-tuning, AI security, prompt-injection protection, and PII/data protection.
* Enterprise SaaS, CRM, and ERP integrations.
* AI FinOps and FinOps Foundation practices.
* Cloud marketplace listings, including Azure Marketplace and AWS Marketplace.
* Product management experience and experience commercializing consulting IP as licensed software.
* Experience replacing or complementing traditional RPA solutions with AI-agent-based approaches.

What We're Looking For

* A hands-on technical leader who can translate business requirements into scalable agentic AI solutions.
* Someone who can combine architecture, engineering, platform development, and product thinking.
* A professional capable of taking AI capabilities from proof of concept to production-ready and commercially deployable solutions.
* Strong communication, technical decision-making, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills.

**Interested in building production-grade Agentic AI platforms and bringing AI-powered products to market? Apply now!**

a72241fb.title: Technical Support Engineer (Cloud), India
a72241fb.description:
At AlgoSec, what you do matters!
  
  
AlgoSec helps the world’s leading organizations secure application connectivity across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Trusted by more than 2,200 global organizations, our platform delivers visibility, security policy management, risk reduction, and compliance automation across complex enterprise networks.
  
  
AlgoSec is looking for an experienced Technical Support Engineer to join our global Support organization.
  
  
For this position, we are specifically looking for a candidate with strong Cloud, Linux, and automation experience who can complement the networking and firewall expertise already existing within the team and support AlgoSec's continued evolution toward SaaS, cloud-based capabilities, and AI integrations.
  
  
**Reporting to:**
Support Team Leader / Support Manager
  
  
**Location:**
Gurgaon, India – office-based preferred; remote work may be considered
  
  
**Employment:**
Direct employment
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide technical support to AlgoSec customers and partners worldwide via email, phone, and web sessions.
* Troubleshoot technical issues related to product installation, configuration, operation, cloud infrastructure, applications, networking, and security environments.
* Guide customers, partners, and Sales Engineers through technical issues and product-related questions.
* Investigate complex technical problems across cloud, Linux, application, and network environments.
* Work closely with global Support teams, R&D, Delivery, and Product Management to drive issues to resolution.
* Take ownership of customer issues and manage them through resolution.
* Develop and maintain operational scripts and automations to improve Support efficiency, reduce manual effort, and increase service reliability.
* Document technical findings and maintain and improve the AlgoSec knowledge base.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of Support processes, methodologies, tools, and automation.

**What We're Looking For**

* At least 3 years of experience in Technical Support or a similar customer-facing technical role within a software company.
* Practical experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Microsoft Azure, including troubleshooting cloud infrastructure, networking, security, and platform services.
* Strong hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting Linux/Unix environments.
* Experience with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, PowerShell, Shell scripting, or similar technologies.
* Experience building or maintaining operational automations to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, or enhance service reliability.
* Experience supporting network security, infrastructure, or other complex enterprise software products.
* Good understanding of networking and security concepts.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex technical issues across cloud and application environments.
* Ability to independently investigate technical issues and take ownership through resolution.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities.
* Willingness to work flexible hours as part of a 24x7 global Support organization.

**Nice-to-have**

* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automation platforms such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins.
* Experience implementing AI-powered operational workflows, predictive analytics, intelligent alerting, or GenAI-based Support automation solutions.
* Experience with SaaS products or cloud-native application environments.
* Experience with firewall technologies such as Check Point, Palo Alto, Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, or similar platforms.

**Personal attributes**

* Independent, resourceful, and results-oriented.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset.
* Fast learner with a strong interest in emerging technologies, cloud platforms, automation, and AI-driven operations.

7731a530.title: Sr IT Delivery Manager
7731a530.description:
Blend is a premier AI services provider, committed to co-creating meaningful impact for its clients through the power of data science, AI, technology, and people. With a mission to fuel bold visions, Blend tackles significant challenges by seamlessly aligning human expertise with artificial intelligence. The company is dedicated to unlocking value and fostering innovation for its clients by harnessing world-class people and data-driven strategy. We believe that the power of people and AI can have a meaningful impact on your world, creating more fulfilling work and projects for our people and clients. For more information, visit www.blend360.com.

**Job Description**

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Delivery Manager with 8–12 years of experience in delivering Analytics, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Business Intelligence programs. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing end-to-end delivery for multiple data-driven projects while partnering closely with internal client stakeholders and senior technical leaders.

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring successful project execution, resource optimization, and stakeholder satisfaction. You will act as a bridge between business and technical teams, ensuring smooth delivery, proactive risk management, and efficient utilization of internal talent across engagements.

Key Responsibilities

• Own end-to-end delivery of Analytics, Data Science, Data Engineering, and BI projects across multiple client engagements.

• Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, budget, and quality expectations.

• Partner closely with internal client partners, senior technical managers, and engineering leads to ensure seamless execution.

• Manage delivery governance including project planning, tracking, reporting, and escalation management.

• Identify project risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks early and drive mitigation plans proactively.

• Oversee and optimize resource allocation by identifying internal talent based on project demand and skill requirements.

• Ensure effective utilization of delivery teams while balancing multiple priorities and changing requirements.

• Facilitate cross-functional collaboration between data scientists, data engineers, BI developers, and platform teams.

• Drive continuous improvement in delivery processes, best practices, and operational efficiency.

• Act as a point of contact for delivery-related communication with stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment.

• Support pre-sales or transition activities by providing delivery inputs, estimates, and execution plans when required.

**Qualifications**

Delivery & Leadership

* 15+ years of delivery, program, or project management experience (consulting, tech, or product scale preferred).
* Proven track record managing multi-million-dollar projects and complex stakeholder landscapes.
* Deep expertise in financial management: budget tracking, variance analysis, forecasting, and cost control.
* Fluency with Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheets, or equivalent planning and tracking tools.

Technical Acumen (Data, AI, & Cloud)

* Data Engineering Fundamentals: Understand Python, SQL, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data architecture patterns.
* Cloud Platforms: Working knowledge of Azure, AWS, GCP; comfort with platform selection and cost optimization.
* Data & Analytics Stack: Familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks, and BI tools (Tableau, Power BI).
* Data Science & ML: Basic understanding of exploratory data analysis (EDA), modeling workflows, and model deployment.
* Gen AI & Agentic AI: Knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, token economics, RAG systems, and GPU cost optimization.
* Ability to translate technical concepts into business outcomes and validate feasibility with engineering teams.

Leadership & Collaboration

* Executive Presence: Comfortable presenting to C-suite and managing high-stakes conversations.
* Requirements Clarity: Skilled at running discovery workshops, translating ambiguity into actionable stories, and saying 'no' with grace.
* Adaptability: Thrive in startup speed or enterprise rigor; comfortable with ambiguity and rapid pivots.
* Ownership Mentality: You don't delegate away responsibility; you solve problems with the team.

This role requires strong relationships with business stakeholders and key staff members to clearly understand the overall business objectives and functional process requirements. c6e77ebc.title: Program Manager - Technology
c6e77ebc.description:
**Company Description**

AbhiBus is a leading online bus-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators - including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3.5 lakh (350,000+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.

AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms - ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

**Job Description**

**The Role**

We are looking for a Technology Program Manager who can drive complex, cross-functional technology initiatives from problem definition to execution and delivery.

This is not a traditional Scrum Master / Agile Project Manager role.

You will work in an environment where requirements evolve, priorities change, teams may not be co-located, and there isn't always a well-defined process or single owner for every dependency.

Your job will be to bring clarity, structure and momentum to these situations.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations and external technology partners to ensure that complex initiatives move forward and eventually reach production.

**What You Will Do**

* Drive end-to-end technology programs — translate high-level objectives into clear plans, milestones, dependencies and execution paths.
* Navigate complex technical dependencies across multiple engineering teams, services, platforms and third-party systems.
* Work closely with engineering leads to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, system dependencies and technical constraints well enough to identify execution risks early.
* Identify the critical path for programs and continuously remove blockers that could impact delivery.
* Coordinate execution across distributed and non-co-located teams, ensuring alignment without relying purely on formal processes.
* Bring structure to ambiguous problems — figure out what needs to happen, who needs to be involved and how we get from where we are today to the desired outcome.
* Identify risks, dependencies and decisions proactively rather than waiting for issues to surface.
* Facilitate discussions between teams when there are conflicting priorities, unclear ownership or competing technical approaches.
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering Managers to convert product/business objectives into executable technology plans.
* Maintain program visibility for leadership — what is on track, what is blocked, why it is blocked and what decisions are required.
* Manage execution across multiple parallel workstreams without becoming a task tracker.
* Work with external vendors/partners where technology integration or operational dependencies are involved.
* Establish lightweight processes where needed — but avoid adding process for the sake of process.

**Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in Technical Program Management, Product Operations, Engineering Program Management, Technology Consulting or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of software development and technology systems. You don't need to be a coder, but you should be comfortable discussing APIs, databases, services, integrations, data flows, releases and system dependencies with engineers.
* Demonstrated experience driving cross-functional technology initiatives involving multiple teams.
* Strong ability to understand technical dependencies and identify risks before they become delivery problems.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity, changing priorities and incomplete information.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly across teams with different priorities.
* Ability to operate effectively with distributed / geographically dispersed engineering teams.
* Strong ownership mindset — you see a problem through to resolution rather than simply escalating it.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to operate in a high-paced startup environment where processes are evolving continuously.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working in a consumer internet, marketplace, OTA, fintech, mobility or other high-scale technology environment.
* Experience working with microservices, APIs, cloud infrastructure or data platforms.
* Engineering / Computer Science background.
* Experience working with external technology vendors or partners.
* Experience managing programs involving multiple engineering teams and complex integrations.
* Experience in an environment where Product and Engineering operate with high autonomy and lightweight processes.

**What Success Looks Like**

After 6 months, you should be the person teams rely on to answer:

* What exactly are we trying to deliver?
* Which teams and systems are involved?
* What are the critical dependencies?
* What is blocking us?
* Who needs to make a decision?
* What can derail the program?
* What needs to happen next?

**You don't need to create more meetings or more status reports.**

**You need to make complex things happen.**

**Additional Information**

Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

c544ce7b.title: Backend - Associate Technical Architect /Lead
c544ce7b.description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer with strong expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL, AWS, and Kubernetes to design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance microservices supporting consumer-facing applications.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience building GraphQL APIs using Apollo Server/Federation, modernizing legacy applications, integrating third-party services, and managing production workloads on AWS EKS.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

Responsibilities

* **GraphQL subgraphs:** Design, build and own Apollo Federation subgraphs for realtor.com consumer experiences such as home search, listing and property details, saved homes and leads. They plug into a company-wide supergraph used by web and mobile apps.
* **Modernization:** Move legacy services onto TypeScript microservices and federated GraphQL without changing behaviour. Use data-compare testing and feature-flagged rollouts.
* **Integrations:** Connect with listing and property-data providers, geo and location services, identity (Auth0), messaging platforms and lead partners. Build in strong validation, retries and idempotency.
* **Data and caching:** Model and tune relational data access, including read/write splits. Use Redis/Valkey for caching and rate limiting so high-traffic consumer experiences and marketing campaigns stay fast and resilient.
* **Async workflows:** Build event-driven and background processing with Kafka and job schedulers.
* **Production ownership:** Run services on Kubernetes (K8s) on AWS EKS using the platform team's paved paths: Docker images, CircleCI builds, Helm charts and ArgoCD GitOps deployments. Own K8s Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps/Secrets, Ingress, liveness/readiness probes, resource requests/limits, PodDisruptionBudgets and HPA/KEDA autoscaling. Monitor with New Relic and Splunk, join the on-call and incident rotation, and keep quality gates green.

Must have

* 5+ years of backend engineering, including 3+ years of TypeScript/Node.js in production.
* Strong GraphQL experience (Apollo Server; Federation preferred), schema design, DataLoader and avoiding N+1 queries.
* Hands-on Kubernetes (K8s) experience running production services on AWS EKS: Docker, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps/Secrets, probes, resource limits and autoscaling (HPA).
* Comfortable debugging in K8s with kubectl: pod logs, restarts, OOMKills, rollouts and rollbacks.
* Experience with Helm charts and GitOps deployment (ArgoCD or similar) through CI/CD pipelines (CircleCI or similar).
* Strong SQL: MySQL or similar relational databases, query tuning, transactions, primary/replica patterns.
* Hands-on caching experience with Redis or Valkey: key design, TTLs, cache stampede and failure handling.
* REST and third-party API integration; JWT/OAuth; secure handling of PII.
* Testing discipline (Jest or similar) and CI/CD experience.
* Able to debug distributed systems under production load.

Good to have

* Experience modernizing legacy services (e.g. Java) into microservices.
* Kafka or other event streaming; event-driven autoscaling with KEDA.
* Real-estate, marketplace or lead-generation domain experience.
* Exposure to AI/LLM integrations or ML-powered features (search, recommendations).
* Data platforms and pipelines (Snowflake, dbt, Airflow).
* AWS Lambda/serverless; infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation.
* New Relic or other APM, distributed tracing, SonarCloud.
* API gateways (Tyk or similar), Traefik ingress, ExternalDNS.
* Experience working on an internal developer platform / paved-path model (shared Helm library charts, service templates, self-service deployments).
* Splunk log analysis; dependency automation with Renovate; Artifactory.
* Experimentation and analytics tooling (Amplitude, Optimizely).

255b5fc9.title: Senior Presales Consultant
255b5fc9.description:
Join us at Orange Business!
  
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Presales Department is a dynamic and strategic team that plays a crucial role in bridging the gap between customer needs and our technical solutions. Focused on delivering tailored proposals and demonstrations, the department supports sales efforts by showcasing the value and capabilities of our network security, cybersecurity, and managed services offerings. Operating in a fast-paced environment, the team collaborates closely with clients and internal stakeholders to ensure solutions are aligned with business objectives and market demands.
  
  
**Description Of The Missions**
Lead digital transformation as a trusted partner delivering innovative solutions.
  
  

* You will lead the presales process by understanding customer requirements and designing tailored network security and cybersecurity solutions.
* You will collaborate with sales teams to prepare and deliver compelling presentations and demonstrations that highlight our managed services.
* You will act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing expert guidance on security architectures and best practices.
* You will coordinate with technical teams to ensure feasibility and smooth handover from presales to delivery.
* You will monitor market trends and competitor offerings to continuously refine our presales strategies.

**Occasional missions and projects:**

* You will lead major client proposals, coordinating cross-functional teams to deliver winning solutions that meet complex security requirements.
* You will drive the implementation and adoption of new presales tools and methodologies to enhance efficiency and customer engagement.
* You will represent the company at industry events and conferences, sharing insights and building relationships with key stakeholders.

Skills you will have the opportunity to develop through this position:
  
  
In this role, you will deepen your expertise in advanced network security and cybersecurity solutions while mastering the art of crafting tailored presales strategies. You will enhance your leadership and stakeholder management skills by leading cross-functional teams and engaging with high-profile clients. Additionally, you will gain valuable experience in market analysis and competitive positioning, sharpening your strategic thinking. This position also offers the opportunity to stay at the forefront of emerging technologies and industry trends, fostering continuous professional growth.
  
  
**Desired Profile/skills**
**About you**
You hold a Bachelor of Engineering or a graduate degree and bring 15+ years of experience in presales, network security, cybersecurity, and managed services.
  
  

* Deep knowledge of network security technologies and architectures
* Expertise in cybersecurity solutions and threat management
* Experience with managed services delivery and operations
* Proficiency in preparing technical proposals and presentations
* Strong adherence to processes and compliance standards

**About Zuora**
At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.
  
  
We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The solution architect is a key member of the professional services team responsible for the design and architecture of Zuora solutions. The position requires strong consulting skills with the ability to effectively command a room. The solution architect plays a lead role during the implementation, identifying and documenting client business requirements, mapping and configuring the Zuora solution to meet the client’s requirements and providing guidance to the client to achieve a successful implementation. They must identify potential issues and risks early in an implementation to develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans. A solid candidate will have an innate ability to simplify complex technology concepts and to plan, prioritize and seamlessly integrate all moving parts to deploy successful solutions.
  
  
This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely while occasionally getting together with your team for office visits, events, or offsites. Of course, you’re welcome to come into the office more often if you’re nearby.
  
  
**What You’ll Achieve**

* Solution design using the full Zuora product portfolio
* Design and validate that the proposed solution architecture supports the stated and implied business requirements
* Review technical team deliverables for compliance with architecture standards, guidelines and leverages best practices
* Articulate and present different point of views on various technologies
* Present Architecture deliverables such as Ecosystem and Integration diagrams, ERD, Business Process Flows, Swim lanes, Visio and Mock-ups
* Exhibit strong executive presence and ability to interact and effectively communicate with key project sponsors from CXO to end users.
* Deliver Expert Services to the Zuora Partners

* Demonstrated leadership abilities to lead business discussions with customers and architect the value of our solution and the best practices to implement it
* Experience in requirements gathering, use cases documentation, business analysis, systems design and integration, user interface design and implementation
* Experience in data analysis, conversion and migration, interfaces and reports
* Experience with system design using configuration and/or customization, integration, testing and support
* Experience in delivering end to end solutions through the entire SDLC - right from running the client facing workshops, design, build, test, deployment, UAT and handover
* Experience in Waterfall and Agile methodologies
* Must be a strong team player with excellent communication skills at the business and technical level, able to collaborate as part of a diverse and distributed team to deliver exceptional customer results in a rapid paced implementation environment
* Experience with accounting and be able to converse effectively with Finance teams
* Experience managing tasks on multiple projects simultaneously

* Competitive compensation, variable bonus and performance-based reward opportunities, and retirement programs

**Responsibilities**

Coordinate with cross-functional teams to gather inputs, define solution scope, and ensure timely submission of proposals. * Strong written and verbal communication skills.

8efc1474.title: Senior Solution Architect AI Solutions PreSales
