deeda464.description:
**Job Description: Sales & Marketing Executive**

**Location:** Kolkata, West Bengal  
 **Designation:** Sales & Marketing Executive  
 **Industry:** Clinical Nutrition / Healthcare Wellness / Training & Education  
 **Employment Type:** Full-Time  
 **Required Experience:** 13 Years  
 **Salary:** Up to 20,000 per month for the first 6 months, depending on experience and calibre; thereafter, 23,000 per month.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a dynamic, enthusiastic, and result-oriented Sales & Marketing Executive to support business development, promote professional services and training programmes, generate leads, and develop strong relationships with prospective clients and stakeholders.

The role involves identifying business opportunities in the clinical nutrition, healthcare, hospital-associated wellness, and training sectors. The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, a proactive approach to lead generation, and the ability to convert prospects into business opportunities.

Candidates with prior experience in healthcare, nutrition, wellness, hospital services, educational or professional training, or related sectors will be preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and generate potential leads through telephone calls, emails, online research, networking, referrals, and other marketing activities.
* Promote the organisation’s services, training programmes, and professional offerings to prospective clients and participants.
* Identify and approach hospitals, healthcare professionals, nutritionists, dietitians, wellness centres, educational institutions, and other relevant stakeholders, as appropriate to the organisation’s offerings.
* Explain available services and training programmes to prospective clients and address their queries professionally.
* Follow up with leads, enquiries, and prospective customers to generate interest and convert opportunities.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with existing and prospective clients.
* Support the planning and execution of sales campaigns, promotional activities, outreach initiatives, and marketing programmes.
* Assist in identifying new markets, customer segments, and opportunities for business expansion.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely responses to enquiries and smooth execution of sales and marketing activities.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, customer interactions, follow-ups, conversions, and other sales activities.
* Prepare periodic sales and marketing reports for management.
* Monitor market developments, competitor activities, and customer feedback to identify potential business opportunities.
* Work towards achieving assigned sales, lead generation, and business development targets.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline; a qualification in Marketing, Sales, Business Administration, Healthcare Management, Nutrition, or a related field will be preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience in sales, marketing, business development, lead generation, or a related role.
* Experience in healthcare, clinical nutrition, wellness, hospital services, training, or education-related services will be an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building abilities.
* Good follow-up skills and the ability to convert enquiries into business opportunities.
* Basic proficiency in MS Office, email, internet research, and sales reporting.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple leads, and meet assigned targets.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Confident, energetic, and comfortable interacting with clients and professional stakeholders.
* Proactive in identifying new leads and exploring business opportunities.

592db603.title: Solution Architect, Process Intelligence (Celonis)
592db603.description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care.

  

The Solution Architect, Process Intelligence is the senior technical owner of Edwards Lifesciences enterprise Process Intelligence capability on the Celonis platform. This role has endtoend technical accountability across both Celonis platform pillars: Process Mining (data integration, objectcentric data models, analytical assets, and execution solutions) and Celonis Process Management (Process Designer, Navigator, and the governed process repository). The architect defines the event log architecture, ERP data extraction strategy, pipeline reliability, platform administration, and the technical standards that enable scalable, accurate, and auditready process insights. While OrdertoCash (O2C) is the initial scope, the architecture is designed to extend across additional enterprise process domains including ProcuretoPay, manufacturing operations, and IdeatoMarket. This role acts as the primary knowledge transfer recipient from the Celonis SI engagement (896 hours, ending September 2026) and serves as the Indiaside technical leader for the BPM execution team. Upon SI handover, this role leads the maintenance, evolution, and scaling of the Celonis platform independently.

  

**How you’ll make an impact:**

* Define and maintain the enterprise event log architecture, objectcentric data models (OCDM), Perspectives, and Knowledge Model that enable process mining, conformance analysis, variant detection, and KPI measurement across enterprise processes. Own the technical design decisions that determine how business objects, events, and relationships are modeled within the platform (25%).
* Own the endtoend data integration strategy from source ERP systems (Oracle JDE) into the Celonis platform, including connector configuration, extraction method selection (JDBC, REST, batch vs. realtime), transformation scripts (PQL), data integration scheduling, and pipeline orchestration. Ensure stable, performant, and governed data flows that meet SLA requirements (20%).
* Serve as the technical owner of the Celonis Process Management (CPM) environment, including Process Designer, Navigator, and the enterprise process repository. Manage platform administration including SSO configuration, user roles and permissions, Home Site configuration, and release cycle governance. Ensure the CPM environment is operationally ready for enterprisescale BPMN modeling and process catalog consumption (15%).
* Serve as the primary technical counterpart to the Celonis SI team during the implementation engagement (May–September 2026). Lead knowledge transfer activities across all SOW phases (Connect, Data Ready, Analyze, Execute, Handover) and ensure internal capability is built to sustain, operate, and evolve the platform independently postengagement. Shadow SI consultants during OCDM configuration, Studio asset development, and Action Flow design (15%).
* Establish and govern the data quality framework — including validation rules, reconciliation procedures, data scorecards, and rootcause resolution workflows — to ensure mining outputs are accurate, consistent, and auditready. Define acceptance criteria for event logs and analytical assets before publication to business stakeholders (10%).
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the Process Intelligence Data Engineer (P3), Senior Analyst, Process Excellence (P3), and broader Pune BPM execution team. Define technical standards, conduct architecture reviews, establish reusable templates and patterns, and ensure alignment with Edwards enterprise IT governance and security requirements (10%).
* Evaluate and recommend adoption paths for emerging Celonis capabilities (e.g., Process Sphere, Action Flows, AgentC, AIdriven insights) aligned to Edwards’ process intelligence roadmap. Configure and validate execution solutions including Action Flows and Business Apps for prioritized value opportunities (5%).

  

**What you’ll need (Required):**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* 8+ years of experience in data architecture, solution architecture, or analytics platform architecture roles.
* Handson experience with the Celonis platform, including data integration, PQL (Process Query Language), objectcentric data modeling, and Studio asset development.
* Strong expertise in SQL, relational database design, and ERP data schemas (Oracle JDE, SAP, or equivalent).
* Experience designing and operating ETL/ELT data pipelines at enterprise scale.
* Demonstrated ability to define data governance frameworks, quality standards, and architectural documentation.
* Experience with platform administration including SSO, user provisioning, and rolebased access control.
* Ability to lead technical delivery in a global, matrixed organization and serve as a technical mentor for colleagues with less experience.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical audiences, including executive stakeholders.
* High level of independence, sound judgment, and ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, greenfield environments.

  

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Celonis certification(s) such as Celonis Data Engineer, Celonis Analyst, or Celonis Solution Architect.
* Experience with Celonis Process Management (CPM/Symbio), including Process Designer and Navigator.
* Experience implementing Celonis from greenfield (not just operating an existing deployment).
* Experience with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS) and modern data stack tooling.
* Python or other scripting language proficiency for data automation, validation, and pipeline orchestration.
* Experience operating in regulated industries (e.g., medical device, pharmaceuticals) requiring data integrity, audit readiness, and SOX compliance.
* Familiarity with BPMN 2.0 process modeling standards and process excellence methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma).
* Experience with Action Flows, Business Apps, or similar execution/automation solutions within process mining platforms.

As a specialist in electronics and software for the past 20 years, in-tech is a dynamic, fast-growing engineering company headquartered in Munich, Germany employing around 2350 employees globally across 20 project locations in 8 countries.in-tech develops innovative engineering solutions for the automotive, rail, aerospace, defence, and industrial sectors.

We are committed to a flexible, modern work culture and work-life balance. Our colour orange stands for liveliness, warmth, and dynamism. We value a strong team spirit, fresh ideas and a positive work culture. We call it the “Orange Spirit”!

Since 2024, in-tech became a subsidiary of Infosys Ltd. This strategic partnership enables us to offer our customers even more comprehensive development and digitalisation services and a greater offshore capability.

We are seeking a motivated
**Technical Program Manager – Android Device Testing**
to lead end-to-end device testing and collaborate with OEM partners, vendors, and cross-functional teams. The role demands strong testing skills, stakeholder management, and project coordination to ensure timely delivery. The candidate will work with global teams, track test progress, manage dependencies, and drive issue resolution for successful program execution. The goal is not only the sourcing of materials and services but also support with further administrative tasks such as licences and contract management.

**Responsibilities**

1. Design, develop, and execute test scenarios, test cases, and test plans based on product requirements.
2. Perform Android device testing including functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end validation.
3. Coordinate testing activities with OEM partners, vendors, and external stakeholders.
4. Track project milestones, dependencies, risks, and test progress; provide regular status updates.
5. Analyze issues, collect and review device logs, and support defect investigation and resolution.
6. Manage the complete defect lifecycle including reporting, tracking, retesting, and regression validation.
7. Drive stakeholder discussions, follow-ups, escalations, and action item closure across multiple teams.
8. Collaborate effectively with geographically distributed teams, including US time zone stakeholders.
9. Maintain clear documentation for test execution, project status, risks, and key decisions.
10. Ensure high-quality deliverables through effective planning, execution, and coordination of testing activities.

**Requirements**

1. Strong hands-on experience in Android device testing.
2. Solid understanding of software testing fundamentals, including test case design and defect lifecycle.
3. Proficiency in functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
4. Experience in defect tracking, log analysis, troubleshooting, and issue validation.
5. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
6. Ability to independently drive discussions, follow-ups, escalations, and issue resolution.
7. Experience coordinating with global teams, especially US stakeholders.
8. Prior experience working with OEM partners, device vendors, or external vendors is preferred.
9. Good understanding of the Android device ecosystem and vendor management.

**Apply with us**

If you have experience and team spirit and are looking for a great place to work, then start your job with us.

As part of our dedication to the diversity of our workforce, in-tech is committed to equal employment opportunity without regard for age, race, colour, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion

Apply Now

b1889cfb.title: Pre-Sales Solution Consultant
b1889cfb.description:
**Overview**
**About Certara**
Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.
  
  
Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.
  
  
Certara is hiring a Pre-Sales Solution Consultant based in India focusing on driving growth for Certara’s existing and future solutions, supporting the Enterprise Account Managers provide valuable solutions to our Enterprise Life Sciences customers. In this role, he or she will build and maintain a thorough understanding of Certara products and services and work closely with the team locally and globally to manage and grow our existing business through our direct sales model, but also leveraging other Certara strategic partners as needed in the process. The successful candidate will be involved in early discussions with our prospective customers to understand their business objectives and design a technical solution that would meet and exceed their expectations both as a business solution, short and long term, as well as adopting the technical infrastructure required for such implementation.
  
  

* This is a highly customer facing position and requires a unique mix of scientific, technical, business process, presentation, and communication skills in the technical sales process.
* Travel to customer and partner sites is required.
* This position is based in India.
* Scientific industry knowledge including competitive landscape, solution linkage, understanding and uncovering key requirements, in order to properly position our software and service solutions within the assigned accounts is required.
* This role requires strong initiative, self-motivation and collaborative skills to work with other team members within and externally to Certara.
* The ideal candidate for this position will possess a strong complex technical sales aptitude and a willingness to grow our business utilizing complex sales methodologies and approaches.

The candidate must be keenly aware of organizational growth initiatives related to the life science market and target customer segments, as well as Certara’s potential to meet customer needs with our software products and services. Ultimately, the Solution Consultant is also responsible for bookings and revenue growth through the use of value creation for our customers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**
**include and is not limited to :**

* Actively supports the sales team and business partners as an expert on the technical, functional and integration of Certara Enterprise Solutions and Services.
* Technical Subject matter expert and lead for responses to Requests For Information (RFIs) and Requests For Proposal (RFPs).
* Understand and influence customer’s short term and long-term initiatives that align with Certara software and services solutions.
* Support Marketing Activities as needed as the Technical Subject Matter Expert on Certara Solution and Services.
* Serves as a point-of-contact for technical and functional questions and drives the resolutions of said concerns by the clients and or partners.
* Develops and maintains relationships with clients, partners and internal groups with the common goal of increasing market share for Certara enterprise solutions and services.
* Participate in professional trade shows and clinical conferences, or the equivalent, (or as practically possible), supporting client meetings and or solution demonstrations.
* Deliver presentations and product seminar tours at scientific conferences as required.
* Develop sales material, presentations, software demonstrations and evaluation materials.
* Deliver product training to marketing & sales on new functionalities for designated products to clarify the features and the benefits to our customers.
* Utilize market knowledge and industry contacts to grow the Certara business in line with agreed commercial goals.
* Meet and exceed sales quota on a quarterly, and annual basis.
* Follow Certara processes and best practices for properly working Marketing Qualified Leads ( MQL’s ).

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years as a Solution Specialist, within the pharmaceutical and enterprise B2B SaaS and or Services industries.
* Bachelor’s degree or above (in a science discipline) or advanced business degree preferred.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written in English.
* Exceptional presentation skills, both in customer meetings, face to face and or on-line, as well as at trade shows and or large audiences.
* Attention to detail and uncovering hidden customer requirements.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to multi-task and set priorities.
* Ability to work in a high energy team environment.
* Able to fully utilize the MS Office suite (Excel/Word/PPT)

**Values:**

* High degree of professionalism: Lives the values of transparency, authenticity, collaboration, respect and accountability
* Is a “Continuous Learner”
* Team Player who will always find a path to success

*Certara bases all employment-related decision on merit, taking into consideration qualifications, skills, achievement, and performance. We treat all applicants and employees without regard to personal characteristics such as race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, nationality, marital status, pregnancy, physical or mental condition, genetic information, military service, or other characteristic protected by law.*

51adf425.title: Presales & Solution Architect
51adf425.description:
Pre-Sales Consultant / Solution Architect

**Department:**
Sales & Business Development

**Reports To:**
Chief of Growth

**Location:**
Remote, India

**Compensation:**
Up to ₹15 LPA total annual compensation, including fixed and variable pay, if applicable. This is a firm ceiling and cannot be stretched.

About Kambaa

Kambaa is an AI-first digital transformation company, Freshworks Gold Partner, and HubSpot Platinum Partner. Our ecosystem includes Salesforce, Zoho, Make.com, Monday.com, Zendesk, WebEngage, Razorpay, Ozonetel, Shopify, MyOperator, Amazon, Microsoft, and other technology companies.

Our clients include India’s largest e-commerce platform, conglomerate, and intracity logistics provider; a leading jobs platform; major D2C brands; a leading real estate company; and the Government of Tamil Nadu.

We help organizations unlock the full potential of their technology stack through implementation and managed services.

AI-First Culture

Gain hands-on exposure to intelligent workflows, copilots, and data-driven decision-making. Within two months, one of our interns trained a client’s employees on AI. We welcome candidates who understand AI or are eager to learn and apply it to business problems.

Role Snapshot

Own the technical win and help deliver the solution.

Run discovery, architect solutions, deliver tailored demos, author proposals, and advise customers through implementation.

For selected key enterprise projects, own delivery solution architecture and guide implementation against agreed requirements. On designated engagements, also coordinate scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication with Implementation and Technical leads.

**Deep, hands-on expertise in Freshdesk or Freshservice is strongly preferred. Experience across both is an advantage.**

The Kambaa Pre-Sales Difference

Design solutions across Freshworks, HubSpot, Zendesk, Make.com, Zoho, and our wider ecosystem to meet customer needs and budgets. Work directly with our in-house developers on custom apps, integrations, and extensions for tailored demos and successful implementations.

Key Responsibilities

1. Discovery & Requirements Engineering

* Conduct discovery calls to understand business workflows, pain points, desired outcomes, and technical constraints.
* Translate findings into clear functional and technical requirements.
* Collaborate with Sales on qualification and capture the context needed for accurate scoping.
* Identify integration needs, dependencies, assumptions, and delivery risks early.

2. Solution Design & Demo Delivery

* Design solutions and tailored demos with Implementation and Technical teams across suitable platforms.
* Define workflows, integrations, data flows, and custom development requirements.
* Work with developers on custom apps, integrations, and extensions where needed.
* Validate demos end to end using realistic data and customer workflows.
* Coordinate with Sales to deliver demos and address solution-fit questions and technical objections.
* Validate feasibility and effort estimates with delivery teams before making commitments.

3. Bespoke Proposal Authoring

* Author customized proposals for integrations, non-standard scope, and multi-platform architectures.
* Document the solution, scope, deliverables, assumptions, dependencies, exclusions, and delivery approach.
* Collaborate with delivery teams on effort estimates and timelines.
* Follow Kambaa’s process standards and hand finalized proposals to Sales for commercial review and dispatch.

4. Enterprise Delivery Solution Architecture

* Own architecture for selected enterprise implementations from discovery through delivery.
* Join delivery kickoffs to align teams on scope, design, and outcomes.
* Document designs and guide configuration, integrations, custom development, and data migration.
* Review key deliverables and design decisions against agreed requirements.
* Address scalability, security, access controls, reporting, and maintainability with the relevant specialists.
* Support testing, user acceptance, go-live readiness, and handover.
* Assess change requests and explain impacts on architecture, scope, effort, and timelines.

5. Project Management for Assigned Enterprise Projects

* Coordinate project plans, milestones, responsibilities, and dependencies with Implementation and Technical leads.
* Align client stakeholders, implementation teams, developers, and relevant vendor teams.
* Track progress against agreed scope, timelines, and effort budgets; flag deviations early.
* Track risks, issues, decisions, and changes; follow through on actions.
* Lead or support status meetings and provide clear client and internal updates.
* Coordinate sign-offs, testing, acceptance, and handover; escalate blockers promptly.

6. Delivery-Phase Escalation Support

* Provide business and technical best-practice guidance during project escalations.
* Help resolve gaps between customer expectations, agreed scope, and implementation.
* Explain effort estimates and change-request hours to clients when required.
* Support a smooth transition to ongoing support or managed services.

Requirements

Communication

* Exceptional spoken and written English is mandatory.
* Ability to explain technical solutions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Confidence leading discovery, demos, architecture discussions, and project reviews.
* Working knowledge of Hindi is a strong plus.

Experience

* Minimum two years of professional experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, or SaaS implementation.
* Experience designing solutions, guiding implementations, and coordinating timelines, stakeholders, risks, or changes.
* **Deep Freshdesk or Freshservice expertise is strongly preferred**
  , including configuration, workflows, automation, integrations, and implementation.
* Experience running demos or POCs for Freshworks products and/or HubSpot is strongly preferred.
* Enterprise implementation experience and a B2B IT services or SaaS partner background are significant advantages.

Technical & Product Aptitude

* Hands-on knowledge of CRM, ITSM, or customer service platforms.
* Ability to translate business workflows into working demos and implementable solutions.
* Comfortable with marketplace apps, native integrations, APIs, and defining custom development requirements.
* Ability to document architecture and requirements, brief developers, and review solutions against business needs.

Sales Collaboration & Learning Agility

* Experience working with Sales from discovery through proposal and close.
* Ability to write bespoke proposals, handle objections, and balance customer needs with feasibility and delivery effort.
* Quick to learn SaaS platforms and apply them to customer problems.
* Enthusiasm for AI-driven workflows, automation, and new tools.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, multi-product environment.

Location & Work Setup

* Fully remote, open to candidates across India.
* Occasional travel to client sites or Kambaa offices in Coimbatore or Kodaikanal may be required for key deals, enterprise delivery milestones, or quarterly business reviews.

Perks & Growth Opportunities

* **Freedom in solution design:**
  Recommend products that solve the customer’s problem within budget.
* **Direct development team access:**
  Build custom apps, integrations, and extensions for demos and delivery.
* **Evolving tool stack:**
  Work with Freshworks, HubSpot, Zendesk, Make.com, Kroolo, Merlin AI, ChatGPT, and more.
* **Multi-platform expertise:**
  Build depth across Freshdesk, Freshservice, Freshsales, HubSpot CRM, Sales Hub, Service Hub, and the wider SaaS ecosystem.
* **AI-first culture:**
  Apply AI to discovery documentation, workflows, demo environments, and productivity.
* **High-impact visibility:**
  Work with enterprise decision-makers and contribute to both winning opportunities and delivering outcomes.

Career Growth Path

* **Year 0–1: Pre-Sales Consultant / Solution Architect.**
  Build multi-product expertise, advise Sales and Delivery, and lead architecture and assigned project coordination.
* **Year 1+: Senior Solution Architect for high performers.**
  Lead complex enterprise deals and delivery, mentor colleagues, and shape solution strategy.
* **Years 2–3: Accelerated tracks for exceptional talent.**
* **Pre-Sales Practice Lead:**
  Build a team, define discovery and demo standards, and collaborate with vendor partners on co-selling.
* **Technical Consultant / Solutions Principal:**
  Expand architecture and advisory ownership across enterprise accounts and establish reusable delivery standards.
* **Beyond Year 3:**
  Progress toward Senior Management or Practice Lead roles, shaping go-to-market strategy and delivery capabilities.

Evaluation Process

**Round 1 — Intro Call with the Chief of Growth (30 minutes)**

Discuss your background, pre-sales and delivery experience, and mutual fit.

**Round 2 — Case Study Demo**

Analyse a business scenario, choose a platform, and present a working demo. Explain your architecture, delivery plan, and risks. Show Freshdesk or Freshservice expertise where relevant.

**Round 3 — Final Round with the CEO**

Discuss customer outcomes, role expectations, and fit.

0bf8100e.title: Presales Executive
0bf8100e.description:

Creating innovative, high-quality living spaces, the company is dedicated to enriching communities and improving the lives of its residents. It aims to be a trusted leader in real estate by consistently delivering long-term value and excellence. The organization focuses on thoughtful design, reliable construction, and customer-centric services. Team members join a culture that values integrity, collaboration, and continuous improvement, with a strong emphasis on resident satisfaction. This commitment to quality and community impact drives all projects and operations.

The role involves conducting product or project presentations, addressing customer queries, and providing timely information to help prospects make informed decisions. The Presales Executive collaborates closely with sales, marketing, and customer service teams to ensure accurate communication of project features, pricing, and timelines. * Candidates should possess excellent Communication and Customer Service skills to engage clients professionally and build long-term relationships.

1eba1130.title: Security Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
1eba1130.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on application security, secure Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices, and vulnerability management, particularly within cloud-native or hybrid environments.
* Experience with cloud and software development.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related technical field.
* Experience with AI-powered security tools for automated vulnerability detection, exploit generation, and code fix remediation.
* Experience in a customer-facing technical role, delivering product and solution briefings, partnering with security leaders and technical teams, and optimizing for production results.
* Understanding of the impact of AI on both offensive and defensive security strategies, including how AI can be leveraged to exploit binaries and firmware as source code.
* Familiarity with platforms for deploying and managing security agents or AI models for security applications, particularly in code analysis and remediation workflows.

**About The Job**
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
  
  
As a Customer Engineer, you will help grow our cyber security business by building and expanding relationships with new and existing customers. You will be a trusted advisor to customers and an advocate for our security solutions. You will provide support to C-level, security leaders, cloud security architects and security analysts, using both technical and business skill sets to lead projects forward. You will accompany customers in discovering the technology/solution and consult around the best way to secure and ensure compliance. You will optimize for results when in production, leading with empathy, while identifying innovative ways to multiply the impact of the team.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Work with the team to identify and qualify business opportunities, understand customer technical objections, and develop the strategy to resolve technical blockers.
* Work directly with customers to demonstrate and prototype Google Cloud product integrations in customer/partner environments.
* Recommend integration strategies, enterprise architectures, platforms, and application infrastructure required to complete solutions using best practices on Google Cloud.
* Share security experience to support the technical relationship with customers, including product and solution briefings and proof-of-concept work, partnering with product management to prioritize solutions impacting customer engagement with Google Cloud.
* Support customer-facing presentations and conduct workshops to share the experience and be a subject matter expert on cyber security.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

09be84b5.title: Security Solution Architect
09be84b5.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
**About The Role**
At Qualys, we’re redefining how organizations secure their IT environments through a unified SaaS platform. Our platform uniquely combines detection, response, and remediation, enabling customers to not only identify threats but actively eliminate them.
  
  
We are looking for a Security Solutions Architect who blends deep technical expertise with business acumen. This role is ideal for someone who can operate as a trusted advisor, influence technical strategy, and drive measurable customer outcomes across security, compliance, and risk domains.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Act as a strategic technical advisor to enterprise customers across vulnerability management, threat detection & response, compliance, and cloud/app security
* Partner with Sales, TAMs, and customer stakeholders to drive technical wins and expansion opportunities
* Architect end-to-end security solutions aligned to customer environments and business goals
* Lead high-impact Proof of Value (PoV) engagements to demonstrate platform capabilities
* Translate customer requirements into scalable architectures and deployment strategies
* Identify gaps between current and desired security posture, and position solutions to bridge them
* Deliver executive-level workshops, architecture sessions, and technical briefings
* Create reusable assets such as reference architectures, onboarding playbooks, and best practices
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap based on field insights
* Stay ahead of evolving threats, technologies, and market trends

**What We’re Looking For**
We want someone who can connect deep technical expertise with real-world business impact.
  
  

* Strong experience in customer-facing roles (pre-sales, post-sales, or advisory)
* Proven ability to design and articulate complex security architectures
* Experience driving technical wins and handling high-stakes customer scenarios
* Excellent communication skills—able to engage both engineers and executives
* High ownership, curiosity, and ability to operate in fast-paced environments

**Technical Expertise (One or More Areas)**
Infrastructure & Endpoint Security
  
  

* Vulnerability management, patching, asset discovery
* Policy compliance, configuration management
* Endpoint detection & response (EDR)

Cloud Security
  
  

* AWS / Azure / GCP architecture
* Cloud posture management, misconfigurations, and risk mitigation
* Identity, workload, and container security

Application Security
  
  

* SAST, DAST, API security
* Container security and DevSecOps practices
* Familiarity with OWASP and MITRE frameworks

**Additional Experience**

* Hands-on experience with Qualys or similar platforms
* Understanding of industry standards (ISO, NIST, CIS, etc.)
* Ability to map security controls to compliance frameworks
* Experience influencing product direction through customer feedback

04ecad84.title: Presales Consultant- Product Cyber Security
04ecad84.description:
We are looking for an experienced **Enterprise Pre-Sales Architect Cybersecurity Techno Commercial skills** to lead enterprise-level cybersecurity solution architecture, consultative engagements, technical strategy and pre-sales activities including Proactive and Reactive opportunity generations for complex transformation opportunities.

The role will work closely with **CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, Enterprise Architects, Business Stakeholders, Sales, Delivery, Cybersecurity SMEs and OEM/Technology Partners** to understand enterprise challenges and design integrated cybersecurity architectures aligned with business objectives, risk, regulatory requirements and technology strategy.

The candidate should be capable of connecting multiple cybersecurity domains into a **unified enterprise security architecture**, rather than positioning individual security products.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise Cybersecurity Architecture**

* Lead architecture and solution design for complex, multi-tower enterprise cybersecurity engagements.
* Translate business objectives, risk requirements and technology challenges into **enterprise security architectures and transformation roadmaps**.
* Develop **current-state, target-state and transition architectures**.
* Design integrated solutions covering network, endpoint, cloud, identity, application, data, SOC and emerging security technologies.
* Develop HLDs, conceptual architectures, logical architectures, integration models, data flows and technology roadmaps.
* Ensure proposed architectures are scalable, resilient, interoperable, secure and commercially viable.
* Align solutions with enterprise architecture principles and security frameworks.

**2. Consultative Pre-Sales & Customer Engagement**

* Lead strategic discovery workshops, cybersecurity assessments and architecture discussions.
* Engage with **CISO/CIO/CTO and senior technology stakeholders** to understand business priorities and security challenges.
* Convert customer requirements into measurable security outcomes and transformation initiatives.
* Present enterprise security strategies, architecture and roadmaps to technical and executive audiences.
* Position cybersecurity as a **business risk, resilience and digital trust capability**, rather than only a technology function.
* Support account teams in developing strategic technology and cybersecurity roadmaps.

**3. Solution Strategy & Opportunity Development**

* Support Sales in qualification and development of strategic enterprise opportunities.
* Define technical win strategies, solution positioning and competitive differentiation.
* Identify opportunities for cybersecurity transformation, managed security services and technology consolidation.
* Develop multi-year cybersecurity transformation proposals and phased implementation approaches.
* Identify cross-sell and up-sell opportunities across cybersecurity domains.
* Contribute to strategic account planning and customer technology roadmaps.

**4. RFP / RFI / RFQ & Large Deal Support**

* Lead technical solutioning for complex enterprise RFPs, RFIs and RFQs.
* Develop solution narratives, architecture diagrams, compliance matrices and technical responses.
* Define solution scope, assumptions, dependencies, exclusions and customer responsibilities.
* Provide inputs for **BoM/BoQ, sizing, licensing, implementation effort and TCO**.
* Coordinate technical responses across internal SMEs, delivery teams and OEM/technology partners.
* Support technical negotiations, customer clarifications and final solution presentations.

**5. Cybersecurity Technology Architecture**

Provide broad architectural expertise across multiple domains, including:

* **Security Architecture:** Zero Trust, Defense-in-Depth, Security Controls
* **Network Security:** NGFW, IPS/IDS, NAC, DDoS, SD-WAN, SASE/SSE, ZTNA
* **SOC & Detection:** SIEM, SOAR, XDR, EDR, NDR, UEBA, MDR, Threat Intelligence
* **Identity Security:** IAM, PAM, MFA, IGA, CIEM
* **Cloud Security:** CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, CIEM, DSPM
* **Application Security:** SAST, DAST, SCA, API Security, WAAP, DevSecOps, SBOM
* **Data Security:** DLP, Data Classification, DSPM, Encryption, Key Management
* **Offensive Security:** VAPT, Red Teaming, Threat Hunting, ASM
* **OT/IoT Security:** Industrial and critical infrastructure security
* **Emerging Technologies:** AI Security, LLM Security, AI Governance and Security Automation

The architect should be able to determine **when and how these technologies should work together as an enterprise security ecosystem**.

**6. PoC / PoV & Technical Validation**

* Define PoC/PoV objectives, architecture, use cases and success criteria.
* Lead technical validation of strategic cybersecurity technologies.
* Coordinate with OEMs, engineering teams and customers during PoC execution.
* Evaluate technical results, identify gaps and provide recommendations.
* Develop technical evaluation and selection frameworks for competing solutions.

**7. OEM / Partner & Ecosystem Management**

* Engage with strategic cybersecurity OEMs and technology partners.
* Evaluate products and technologies against enterprise requirements.
* Develop reference architectures and integrated solutions across multiple OEMs.
* Maintain awareness of cybersecurity technology trends, market developments and competitive offerings.
* Support joint customer engagements, workshops and solution demonstrations.

**8. Delivery Governance & Handover**

* Ensure proposed architectures are technically implementable and aligned with delivery capabilities.
* Conduct structured pre-sales-to-delivery architecture handovers.
* Validate scope, architecture, BoM/BoQ, assumptions, dependencies and implementation requirements.
* Support resolution of architecture-related issues during transition and implementation.
* Minimize solution gaps, scope ambiguity and delivery risks.

  

**Pre-Sales & Business**

* Strong consultative selling and strategic solution-positioning skills.
* Ability to independently lead complex enterprise opportunities.
* Strong commercial awareness covering apability.
* Strong commercial awareness covering **TCO, licensing, sizing, implementation effort and solution economics**.
* Strong competitive analysis and technical win-strategy capabilities.

**Leadership & Communication**

* Excellent communication, presentation and executive engagement skills.
* Ability to communicate complex cybersecurity concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management across Sales, Delivery, OEMs and customers.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple strategic opportunities simultaneously.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.

  

**Regards**,

Lakshmi D

4a7dbf57.title: Program Manager - Digital delivery
4a7dbf57.description:
**Who we are**

Konrad Group is a next generation digital consultancy. We are dedicated to solving complex business problems for our global clients with creative and forward-thinking solutions. Our employees enjoy a culture built on innovation and a commitment to creating best-in-class digital products in use by hundreds of millions of consumers around the world. We hire exceptionally smart, analytical, and hard working people who are lifelong learners.

**About The Role**

As a Senior Consultant, you will lead cross-functional teams of consultants, designers, and developers through medium and large-scale digital projects to deliver cutting edge user experiences.  
As a senior member of the team, you have previously worked with clients from a diverse set of industries. You will use your experience to solve complex business problems and you will collaborate with and lead our clients through early brainstorming, the creation of impactful user experiences, through to technical delivery and implementation. The ideal candidate will bring to the table a demonstrable experience in leading teams and mentoring junior team members. In this multifaceted role you will be exposed to and will work in collaboration with our  
Strategy, Project Management, User Experience (UX) Design, and Technology teams.

**What You'll Do**

* As a senior member of the Consulting team you will support the engagement lead on projects varying in size – from smaller rapid-to-market initiatives through to large-scale digital transformations
* You will use your experience to strategize and create digital solutions for a variety of clients and verticals
* Play a key role in understanding and interpreting our clients business challenges and goals, and working with our design and technology teams to deliver elegant user experiences
* Ensure client goals and project timelines are met
* Be a design and technology thought leader on existing and emerging technology trends
* Structure presentations, documentation, request for proposal responses, and other collateral

* Mentor junior members of the team

**Qualifications**

* 5 to 7 years of relevant experience
* Experience in leading strategy, design, and technology teams through medium and large-scale digital projects
* A clear understanding of management, business, and finance processes
* Strong track record in liaising with and collaborating with clients
* A demonstrable passion for user experience, digital design, and technology
* A constant desire to learn more about the latest technologies
* A keen eye for great digital design
* Excellent writing competency and communication skills in English is a must-have
* Strong track record of public speaking
* An analytical mindset
* Strong problem-solving ability
* Ability to work in a team environment and independently
* Experience in mentoring other team members

**Perks and Benefits**

* Socials, Outings & Retreats
* One day per week Work From Home Flexibility
* Culture of Learning & Development

*Konrad Group is committed to maintaining a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status will receive consideration for employment. If you have any accessibility requirements or concerns regarding the hiring process or employment with us, please notify us so we can provide suitable accommodation.*

While we sincerely appreciate all applications, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

5ef4358d.title: Sr. Solution Consultant, Enterprise Scheduling
5ef4358d.description:
**About Kinaxis**
Elevate your career journey by embracing a new challenge with Kinaxis. We are experts in tech, but it’s really our people who give us passion to always seek ways to do things better. As such, we’re serious about your career growth and professional development, because People matter at Kinaxis.
  
  
In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers based in Ottawa, Canada. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, and support 40,000+ users in over 100 countries. As a global leader in end-to-end supply chain management, we enable supply chain excellence for all industries. We are expanding our team in Chennai and around the world as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
  
  
Our journey in India began in 2020 and we have been growing steadily since then! Building a high-trust and high-performance culture is important to us and we are proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified TM . Our state-of-the-art office, located in the World Trade Centre in Chennai, offers our growing team space for expansion and collaboration.
  
  
**Location**
Chennai, India
  
  
**About The Team**
As a member of our Consulting Team, you understand our customers’ most pressing business performance challenges and you are committed to helping our customers solve complex challenges in the distributed value chain that is prevalent in manufacturing today.
  
  
****What you will do****

* Participate in in the end-to-end deployment of production scheduling tool including deep-dive customer business requirements discovery sessions and develop requirements specifications documentation.
* Collaborates closely with agile team members to support the configuration, implementation of Maestro software to enable the solution according to our customers distinct needs
* Translate business requirements into Kinaxis Maestro software specifications, following supply chain industry trends and best practices.
* Support senior team members in providing creative solutions to complex business problems while maintaining best practices.
* Participate in data management and data integration activities, including source systems data transformation, data loading, data cleanup and validation.
* Perform training of customer end users on the configured solution.
* Provide technical support to end users and resolve issues of the configured solutions, escalating to senior team members as needed.
* Support the validation and testing of the solution and capture user feedback.
* Actively engage, guide and mentor to develop the skills of junior consultants on projects.
* Any other reasonable project related tasks as assigned by the Project Manager.

****What we are looking for****

* Candidates with results-oriented mindset, focusing on improving client satisfaction and providing a very high standard of service, driving towards Kinaxis’s success.
* Sound knowledge in Supply Chain concepts especially scheduling with 6+ years of experience.
* Strong intent to learn our first in class product “Maestro”
* Work in a fast-paced project environment and co-ordinate with members at all levels in an organization
* Highly adaptable professional, able to embrace teamwork in diverse and evolving work environments.
* Capability to lead by example, having the drive to think in an innovative way and have passion about new challenges
* Ability to solve complex problems, think critically and make sound judgement decisions.
* A passion for working in customer facing roles that require high level of interpersonal, communication, facilitation and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively in English, both verbally and in writing
* Technical skills such as SQL, R, Java Script, Python, etc.
* Experience with manufacturing planning solutions such as Kinaxis, SAP, JDA, etc. is an added advantage

#Senior
  
  
**Work With Impact:**
Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day—when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
  
  
**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:**
Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Ford, Unilever, Yamaha, P&G, Lockheed-Martin, and more.
  
  
**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:**
Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to net-zero operations strategy for the long term. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
  
  
People matter at Kinaxis and these are some of the perks and benefits we created for our team:
  
  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide day off on the last Friday of every month)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs and training and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis web site at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .
  
  
Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. Please note that this contact information is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used to inquire about application statuses.
  
  
Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description, to identify candidates whose education, experience and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

5c731a9c.title: Lead Consultant - Oracle Cloud Financials Functional
5c731a9c.description:
**Job Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Oracle Cloud Modules**

* General Ledger
* Account Receivables
* Account Payables
* Fixed Assets
* Accounting Hub
* Advance Collections and Credits
* Cash Management
* Expenses

**What We Are Looking For**
We are seeking an Oracle Cloud Financials Consultant.The ideal candidate will be a consummate professional who can thrive in an upbeat and innovative environment and collaborate with clients to deliver a state-of-the-art solution. The individual will excel at delivering high-quality service and cutting-edge solutions to our clients in the Oracle community.
  
  
The Oracle Cloud Financial Consultant will focus on guiding and assisting clients through all phases of Oracle Cloud Financials implementation.The Functional Consultant is expected to have expertise in multiple Oracle Cloud Financial modules.The successful candidate will have completed three or more end-to-end implementations in Oracle Cloud Financials. This individual will identify and apply creative and innovative approaches to resolving product implementation and integration obstacles.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Using in-depth knowledge of the Oracle Financials Applications, as well as industry best practice expertise, consults with clients to provide cost effective solutions to client business scenarios.
* Works collaboratively with project team and client employees to develop, test, and implement Oracle Clouds solutions.
* Refine customer requirements in detail, document and present to the client for approval
* Identifies and applies creative and innovative approaches to resolving product implementation and integration obstacles and problems.
* Analyze current systems and data to identify new requirements, recognizing the need for systems enhancements or modifications if necessary
* Develop unit test scripts and coordinate with the client to perform the User Acceptance Testing of the system enhancements or custom solutions
* Work with Oracle to resolve service requests
* Lead and direct the following phases of system life cycle:
* Gather business requirements through business process workshops,
* Analysis, design, configure and development solutions for Oracle Financial applications,
* Conference Room Pilots (CRP) and User Acceptance Testing,
* Go-Live preparation and cut-over support,
* Post-production support

**Required Skills**

* Minimum 10 years of experience as Oracle Functional consultant with 3+ years of experience in implementing or supporting Oracle Cloud projects and upgrades
* CPA certification or an equivalent is a plus
* Strong consulting experience and business analytical skills to gather and document business requirements, leading fit-gap analysis, business process designs, managing conference room pilots (CRPs), perform functional configuration, and manage testing of procurement ERP solutions
* Proven experience with guiding clients through business process improvements
* Wide range of accounting experiences such as Chart of accounts redesign, proven financial
* reporting experience and MultiOrg / Mutli Currency experience
* Ability to lead a team, work independently and manage multiple task assignments
* Prior experience leading or managing projects
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills
* High commitment to exceed performance expectations
* Ability to write functional specification based on user requirements
* Senior enough to be able to independently handle client expectations
* Professional approach when dealing with internal and external customers
* Ability to maintain a positive attitude under stressful circumstances
* Proficient with MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Willingness to travel as needed
* Even though this is an individual contributor role, ability to coach / mentor the team is expected.

**Education Requirements**
Bachelor’s Degree required or equivalent work experience.
  
  
**About Us**
Argano is the first of its kind: a digital consultancy totally immersed in high-performance operations. We steward enterprises through ever-evolving markets, empowering them with transformative strategies and technologies to exceed customer expectations, unlock commercial innovation, and drive optimal efficiency and growth.
  
  
Argano is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

9cc558bf.description:

**Join the global leader in responsible marketing activation services**

At HH Global, we help the world’s most recognized brands turn their growth ideas into measurable impact through responsible marketing activation.

We are a global marketing activation partner that connects brands to their customers and delivers sustainable marketing execution at scale.

With over 4,000 colleagues across more than 55 countries, you’ll join a diverse, high-performing community, empowered to deliver sustainable, innovative solutions for our clients.

**Purpose of the Job**

As a Hybrid Cloud Engineer, you will be responsible for deploying and maintaining our hybrid cloud infrastructure to meet the evolving needs of our clients. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including software developers, system administrators, and network engineers, to ensure seamless integration and superior performance of our hybrid cloud solutions. Your expertise of infrastructure, cloud technologies and automation will be instrumental in delivering reliable, scalable, and secure hybrid cloud environments.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with stakeholders to assess infrastructure requirements to maintain and support hybrid cloud solutions that align with client needs and business goals.
* Plan, implement, and manage the deployment of hybrid cloud infrastructure, utilizing a combination of on-premises and cloud resources.
* Configure, monitor, and optimize virtualized environments, including virtual machines, containers, and microservices.
* Oversee the integration of various cloud services and technologies, ensuring seamless interoperability and optimal performance.
* Implement security best practices, including identity and access management, encryption, and vulnerability assessments, to maintain a secure hybrid cloud environment.
* Collaborate with network engineers to monitor and maintain networking components, ensuring robust connectivity between on-premises and cloud resources.
* Understand, automate deployment, scaling, and management tasks using infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools and methodologies.
* Monitor and analyze system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement proactive measures to ensure high availability and reliability.
* Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices related to hybrid cloud, infrastructure, and automation.
* Participate in the IT On call Rota & Patching Rota where needed to support the server estates and business.
* Undertake BAU activities to support the 3rd Line BAU Team, working on incidents calls and escalations, providing expert technical troubleshooting skills to resolve complex issues and providing root cause analysis reports.
* Create and maintain accurate operational documentation, including SOPs, service catalogues (SCs) and supporting technical records, while following ITIL best practices for incident, problem and change management.
* Hybrid Virtual Machine Builds & Maintenance, Assist with the deployment and maintenance of virtual machines in both Azure and on-premise environments (VMware, Hyper-V), including template-based configurations, patching, and day-to-day operational support.
* Monitoring, Alerting, & Security Support for Hybrid Systems, Monitor Azure and on-premise infrastructures (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V), manage alerts and perform security checks using tools like Azure Security Center, Windows Defender, and on-premise monitoring solutions, escalating issues when necessary.
* Hybrid Endpoint Configuration & Device Management, Support the deployment, configuration, and monitoring of devices using Microsoft Intune for both cloud and on-premise systems, ensuring devices meet organizational security standards. Assist with managing endpoint protection using Windows Defender and on-premise solutions.
* Networking & Traffic Management Support (Cloud & On-Premise), Assist with the configuration and operational management of networking components in both Azure (Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Front Door, DNS) and on-premise environments (e.g., VMware NSX, physical network components), ensuring consistent availability and performance.
* Access & Identity Management Support (Hybrid), Support the day-to-day management of Azure SSO, App Registrations, and key management tasks, as well as identity access controls for on-premise systems (VMware, Active Directory), ensuring secure access to both cloud and on-premise services.
* Support for Secure Infrastructure & PKI (Hybrid), Assist with the maintenance and support of Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and security solutions across both Azure and on-premise environments, ensuring secure communication and compliance.
  

**Knowledge, Skills + Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; relevant certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect) are a plus.
* Proven experience in infrastructure engineering, or related roles within the IT industry.
* Solid understanding of hybrid cloud concepts, virtualization, and cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.).
* Solid understanding of VMware, Hyper V, Azure HCI technologies
* Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automation and infrastructure management.
* Desirable experience and familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
* Desirable experience with containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of networking concepts, including VPN, VPC, subnets, and security groups, in a hybrid cloud environment.
* Strong security mindset and knowledge of security best practices in hybrid cloud environments.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven experience in managing and supporting a diverse range of operating systems and platforms, including Windows and Linux environments, as well as containerization technologies like Docker, Kubernetes, and related orchestration tools. Familiarity with system administration, configuration management, and troubleshooting in these ecosystems is essential.

6a388ac9.title: Cloud Architect
6a388ac9.description:
**Job Title**

Cloud Architect

  

**About the Role**

We are building an internal, JSON-driven, policy-governed cloud provisioning and governance platform for a regulated financial services environment. As Cloud Architect, you will define the target architecture, landing-zone standards and multi-cloud strategy that this platform enforces, with GCP as the primary cloud and AWS as the second. You will work closely with the platform engineering team, security, risk and senior business stakeholders.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and own the reference deployment architecture for cloud environments: landing zones, network topology, identity, security and resource hierarchy, starting with GCP and then mapped to AWS.
* Design the cloud-neutral patterns, standards and environment archetypes (pre-approved templates) that automation will provision.
* Guide the Infrastructure-as-Code approach: Terraform module design, versioning, state management and registry-driven provisioning.
* Architect for security and compliance in a regulated setting: IAM, org policies/SCPs, encryption, private connectivity, logging and audit trail.
* Define networking architecture: Shared VPC, hub-and-spoke, hybrid connectivity (Interconnect/VPN), DNS, firewalling and segmentation.
* Design for resilience, DR, cost optimization and FinOps (labelling/tagging, budgets, rightsizing).
* Review designs from engineering and application teams, and run architecture review boards.
* Partner with governance and policy teams so regulatory requirements translate into enforceable cloud controls.
* Support AI/ML workload architecture (Vertex AI, GPU/TPU capacity, data access patterns) on the platform.
* Mentor engineers, create architecture documentation and present to director-level stakeholders.

  

**Required Skills**

* Deep, hands-on **GCP** architecture experience: resource hierarchy and organization policies, VPC/Shared VPC, IAM, GKE, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Cloud KMS, VPC Service Controls, Cloud Logging/Monitoring.
* Strong **AWS** experience: Organizations/Control Tower, VPC, IAM, EC2, EKS, S3, KMS, CloudTrail/Config.
* Expert-level Terraform and an understanding of IaC governance (module registries, policy-as-code, drift control).
* Strong networking and security fundamentals for regulated environments.
* Experience designing multi-account/multi-project landing zones at enterprise scale.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD, Git-based workflows and configuration management (Ansible).
* Excellent communication, with the ability to present trade-offs and decisions to senior stakeholders.

  

**Good to Have**

* Azure architecture familiarity (management groups, VNets, Entra ID).
* Python scripting, and understanding of JSON-schema-driven automation.
* Policy-as-code tools (OPA/Rego, Sentinel, Checkov) and cloud governance frameworks.
* Experience with banking or financial services regulations and audit requirements.
* Cloud-native AI/ML platform experience (Vertex AI, SageMaker).

  

**Certifications:**

Google Professional Cloud Architect (strongly preferred), AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Terraform Associate/Professional

**Overview**

The HCM Technical Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the end-to-end analysis, configuration, technical design, delivery and ongoing optimisation of Oracle Cloud HCM solutions across the organisation. The role partners with stakeholders to understand business strategy, processes, pain points and requirements, and translates these needs into secure, scalable and supportable solutions. Key areas of focus include Core HR, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence Management, integrations, reporting, data migration and emerging Oracle AI capabilities.

Working closely with HR Systems team, People teams, Technology, Security, vendors and implementation partners, the role provides business, functional and technical leadership across the complete solution delivery lifecycle. This includes facilitating requirements analysis, documenting and validating requirements, designing and configuring Oracle HCM solutions, overseeing technical builds and integrations, leading testing and migration activities, managing releases and cutover, supporting production stabilisation, and maintaining solution documentation. The role is accountable for controlling technical risks, dependencies and delivery quality throughout each implementation.

  

**Key Accountabilities and Main Responsibilities**

Strategic Focus

* Provide technical leadership for the Oracle Cloud HCM roadmap, ensuring solutions align with People strategy, enterprise architecture, security standards and operational priorities.
* Analyse business strategy, processes, services and roadmaps, and translate business needs into practical HCM solution options that clearly identify assumptions, constraints, dependencies, risks, support impacts and expected benefits.
* Identify opportunities to simplify and automate HR processes through Oracle platform capabilities, integrations, reporting, digital assistants and approved AI features.
* Build a sustainable technical capability through reusable design standards, documentation, knowledge transfer and effective vendor management.
* Solution Delivery and Technical Leadership
* Lead end-to-end delivery of Oracle Cloud HCM initiatives, enhancements and releases, including requirements elicitation and validation, fit-gap analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, cutover and hypercare.
* Own or guide solution architecture, configuration and technical design across Core HR, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence and, where in scope, Payroll, Talent Management and Workforce Compensation.
* Design and oversee integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, REST and SOAP services, file-based interfaces and related middleware patterns.
* Lead reporting and analytics solutions using OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts and approved enterprise reporting platforms.
* Plan and oversee data conversion, reconciliation and migration activities, including mapping, cleansing, validation, cutover and post-load assurance.
* Act as a liaison between People Operations and Technology, partnering closely with functional SMEs, developers and vendors to ensure business processes, functional designs and technical components are coherent, supportable and fit for purpose.
* Provide estimates, delivery plans and technical work packages, and actively manage scope, milestones, resources, dependencies and issues.
* Lead design reviews, code and configuration reviews, defect triage and root-cause analysis for complex system issues.
* Coordinate environment management, quarterly Oracle updates, regression testing, deployment readiness and controlled production releases.
* Evaluate new Oracle HCM and Oracle Fusion AI capabilities through structured assessment, proof of concept and risk review before adoption.

Operational Management

* Act as a senior escalation point for complex Oracle HCM incidents, integrations, security, reporting and data issues.
* Ensure production support is timely and disciplined, with clear incident ownership, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis and preventative actions.
* Monitor interface health, scheduled processes, technical debt and recurring defects, and prioritise remediation based on business impact and risk.
* Maintain accurate business requirements, functional and technical specifications, configuration workbooks, solution diagrams, test evidence, runbooks, release records and support documentation.
* Define and support service transition to internal teams and vendors, including operating and support models, knowledge transfer, service documentation and measurable acceptance criteria.

People Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership

* Provide day-to-day technical direction, coaching and quality oversight to technical consultants, analysts and delivery partners.
* Build trusted relationships with People, Payroll, Technology, Security, Finance, Risk and external vendors.
* Communicate complex technical matters in clear business language and support informed decision-making without overstating certainty or benefits.
* Promote collaborative delivery, constructive challenge, accountability and continuous learning across project and operational teams.

Governance, Security and Risk

* Ensure solutions comply with approved architecture, privacy, security, access control, change management and data governance requirements.
* Design and review role-based security, data access and segregation-of-duties controls in partnership with relevant control owners.
* Maintain traceability from requirements through design, testing, approval and deployment, with complete evidence for audit and operational assurance.
* Identify and escalate delivery, data, control and operational risks early, with clear impact assessments and practical mitigation options.
* Ensure third-party delivery is governed through defined outcomes, quality standards, documentation requirements and knowledge transfer.

The above list of key accountabilities is not exhaustive and may change from time to time based on business needs.

  

**Experience & Personal Attributes**

* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typically 10+ years of enterprise applications or IT consulting experience, including substantial hands-on experience delivering Oracle Cloud HCM implementations, enhancements and transformation programmes from requirements gathering through configuration, testing, deployment and post-production support.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex Oracle HCM technical workstreams or end-to-end delivery in a large, regulated or multinational organisation.
* Strong technical and functional understanding of Oracle Cloud HCM, with depth across Core HR and experience in modules such as Recruiting, Time and Labour and Absence Management. Exposure to Payroll, Talent Management or Workforce Compensation is advantageous.
* Hands-on capability with Oracle Integration Cloud, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, REST and SOAP web services, BI Publisher and OTBI.
* Experience with business process analysis, functional consulting, solution architecture, integrations, data migration, reporting, security, environments, release management and production support.

* Understanding and experience with Oracle E-Business Suite is advantageous.
* Experience managing Oracle quarterly updates, regression impacts, deployment planning and post-production stabilisation.
* Ability to evaluate Oracle AI and automation capabilities pragmatically, with appropriate attention to data quality, privacy, security, control and human review.
* Oracle Cloud HCM certifications are highly regarded. Relevant certifications may include Global Human Resources, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence Management, Integration or Oracle Fusion AI capabilities.
* Proven ability to lead technical teams and vendors, set quality expectations and deliver through influence in a matrix environment.
